documents.t: Measured in the real use of v7.0.0: "Iniciar ideação" records agent.activated (and agent.status), the Criativo only speaks after the first message, and the invitation — with the hint "Comece contando o que você quer construir…" — vanished on the click, because the question "has the conversation started?" was events.length > 0. The thread stayed empty for ~25 s. The rule: agent LIFECYCLE events (agent.activated, agent.status) do not count as conversation. Any other event still counts, so the invitation does not cover the git-bootstrap session nor the execution one (RN-131). With the Criativo active and no message, the invitation stays without the "Iniciar ideação" button and with the hint; the first message removes it. And the composer and the text fields of the structured questions carry autocomplete="off" and the attributes password managers respect (data-1p-ignore, data-lpignore="true", data-bwignore, data-form-type="other"): each focus opened the browser's autofill popup. documents.t: The conversational agents with their own loop (Criativo, PO, Arquiteto, Dev Lead, UX Designer, Staff and Infra Lead) kept in the history the assistant's message WITHOUT the response's toolCalls and, right after, the role: "tool" message with the toolCallId. On the wire, the provider received a result that answered no call and discarded it: the model never saw what the tool returned and repeated the same call up to the loop ceiling (measured in v7.0.0: the PO called listar_regras_de_negocio 12 of 12 times in two turns). The assistant's message now carries the response's NATIVE toolCalls when there are any — the same format the ToolLoop already kept and that the ContextManager groups on compaction —, assembled in a single place. A response without toolCalls does not get the key. A call recovered from text (ToolCallRecovery, null id) stays out: there is no id to match. The api already passed the field on to the providers (toWireMessage in OpenAI-compatible, tool_use in Anthropic); the rehydration still brings tools as text. documents.t: Three shortcuts over actions that already existed, no new endpoint (AT-357): Search. The catalog has a search field that matches the display name, the name or the id of the model, case-insensitively. With a term, every hub group and subgroup with a result opens by itself; a search with no result STATES that nothing matched, with the term — never a mute empty list. Sync next to the credential. The credential card whose provider has a key and NO model in the catalog says so and offers "Atualizar catálogo" — the SAME action as the catalog (POST .../models/sync). The button only appears for owner (the endpoint's minimum, RN-102); reading the catalog requires maintainer. The predicate is ONE, providersSemCatalogo, also used by the catalog's notice. Activate and apply to the team. When NO model is active and ONE is checked, the batch bar offers "Ativar e aplicar aos N agentes": it activates (POST .../models/activate) and, if activation passed, applies it to each agent through the same path as RN-476, with its overwrite notice and the partial report of RN-469. A refused activation applies nothing. Only with the click, never on its own, and only for owner (the higher of the two minimums); below that the control stays inert and the reason is stated in text. Curation stays manual (ADR 0042). documents.t: The turn that confirm_readiness triggers consolidates the rules into a summary and records the product_brief. In real use (v7.0.0, Haiku 4.5) it took 25 s and recorded four more artifact.business_rule and a chat.structured_question that nobody would answer: the PO had already joined through the implicit acceptance (RN-658). The turn now goes to the model WITHOUT a tool catalog, and no call is served in it — not even one the model copies from the history. The catalog comes back intact on the following turn; the normal turn keeps emit_artifact and ask_structured_questions. documents.t: With tools, the model writes in pieces — a stretch before the call, another on the next round, often continuing the same sentence. Each round became its own agent.response, and the thread collapses the earlier ones into "Passos do turno": on show stayed only the last piece (" histórias e tarefas que cubram tudo.", starting with a space). The transport lost nothing — the api's final frame carries the whole text of the ROUND —; what was split was the TURN. In the seven conversational agents, the text of a round with a tool is accumulated in the turn's process and recorded in a single agent.response only when the turn closes (no tool, ceiling, failure, Dev Lead suspension, Infra PR). A piece that starts or ends with a space goes in as it came; two pieces stuck together become paragraphs. The conversational agents' toolloop.limit_reached (RN-166) now becomes a line in the thread, in the failure bubble, origin modelo, stating the ceiling ("parou no teto de N passos sem terminar o turno"); without the number in the payload the line says ?. The turn's agent.response carries modelName (RN-146) in EVERY outcome, not only in the tool-less closing: when the turn closes without a final call that brings it (it delivered an ask_structured_questions form, exhausted the ceiling, failed), the model of the last accumulated round applies. With no LLM call having returned a model, the field stays nil — never an invented model (AT-384; the Infra Lead records modelName in no outcome and stays out). Revision (owner decision, 10/03, AT-395): only the turn's closing in the bubble. In real use (loja-teste-2, 10/02) the single answer joined the text of ALL the rounds ("Vou registrar… Excelente! Registrei…", two summaries in a row in the PO). The turn's agent.response is still ONE, but content now is only the CLOSING — the text of the last round that wrote something (a turn that ends in a form, with no text in the last round, keeps the previous one) — and the text of the earlier rounds goes, in order, in the passos field, absent when there are none. Nothing vanishes: the thread draws each step as narration of the same turn+author before the closing, and the "Passos do turno" collapse that already existed folds them, closed by default; the steps do not count in the thread's message cut (RN-644). The rehydration (RN-580) returns passos BEFORE content, in the same assistant, so the model does not lose what it said mid-turn. It applies to the seven conversational agents (the Infra Lead too, without modelName). No ceiling of its own for passos: the accumulation was already recorded whole before the revision. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/texto_do_turno.ex:83 (descarregar); :111 (juntar); :51 (descarregar_com_modelo); :65 (payload_do_turno); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/reidratacao.ex:177 (acumular); apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:809 (passos) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/texto_do_turno_test.exs:43 (three rounds: closing and two steps), :56 (one round, without passos), :60 (ends in a form); apps/engine/test/engine/agents/reidratacao_test.exs (steps before the closing); apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.ordenacao-e-avisos.test.tsx:502 (only the closing on show, steps on expanding) and :524 (no steps, nothing extra); apps/engine/test/engine/agents/criativo_server_test.exs:209 (two rounds, one whole answer; no second one), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/texto_do_turno_test.exs and apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.falha-de-turno.test.tsx:85 (the ceiling line; without a number, it does not invent one); the model in the form in apps/engine/test/engine/agents/criativo_server_test.exs:703 (with model) and :724 (without model, nil) Origin: AT-354, AT-384, AT-395

documents.t: In real use the PO wrote "Handoff ao Arquiteto" and ended the turn without calling offer_handoff (violating RN-163), and delivered five ready stories with zero tasks — the Dev Lead had nothing to distribute. At the end of every PO turn, if the server has not yet recorded an offer to the Arquiteto in that process, it reads the project's rules (uncoveredCount, the same coverage as the automatic acceptance of RN-660) and the backlog: with every rule covered and every story with ≥ 1 task, the SERVER offers the handoff (the mold of the Infra that proposes on its own, ADR 0190, RN-671/672), and RN-660 keeps deciding the acceptance. With rules covered and a story without tasks, it does not offer and records backlog.handoff_not_offered (origin modelo) naming the stories; a read or offer that fails records the same event with origin infra. An uncovered rule, or a backlog without rules/stories, is not judged. The PO's instruction now requires a task per story. The one who creates the tasks is the PO (decision of the main agent in AT-364: he already has create_task). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:475 (fechar_handoff); :502 (oferecer_handoff) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:592 (offers and does not repeat), :610 (story without tasks: does not offer, names) Origin: AT-364
documents.s: RN-700 — The PO does not announce the handoff to the Arquiteto without doing it, and a story without tasks is not delivered

documents.t: Measured in real use (10/02): with the Dev Lead accepted, he replied that the module_map was missing — and the map existed. The kickoff looked for the architecture.module_map_created event, which NO code emits (the Arquiteto records the map through the api), and always fell into "(sem module_map)". The map now comes from the SAME project read the AppSec uses (get_infra_context, the api's current one), never from a session event; without a map, the kickoff says there is none. In the same use, the tasks were born AFTER the kickoff, the Dev Lead invented a task_id, the api refused the plan and the turn ended without a new attempt. He gets read_backlog: a CONTAINED read, without parameters, scoped to the project (the pending tasks through the same route as the PO's listar_backlog, a ceiling of 200 lines stating the real total, and the current module_map). The api's refusal goes back to the loop saying to call read_backlog and fix it; and only a successful propose_execution_plan ends the turn — before, any successful tool in the last call (a read, an emit_artifact) ended it. The kickoff instruction forbids inventing task_id and asks him to only say he assessed the stories on which he called assess_implementability. documents.t: Measured in a real installation of v7.0.0 (AT-351): every business rule recorded backlog.semantic_duplicate_check_skipped with getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN ollama, because the installation from a Release starts without the llm profile and the installer never asked; switching it on by hand hit address already in use on 11434, the port of a NATIVE Ollama on the host. The rule: after the broker question (RN-575), the installer states the COST (disk for the image and for the models the ollama-model-loader downloads, RAM with a model loaded) and what is LOST without it (the semantic duplicate check of RN-681 and a local model for the agents), and only a typed "s" switches it on; without a terminal it stays off SAYING so. Switching on MEASURES the host port before writing anything — 11434, or the first free one up to 11443, through bash's own /dev/tcp (3.2 included) — and the whole range being taken is a NAMED refusal, with nothing written, never an address already in use on startup. The .env gets OLLAMA_PORT and the llm profile; the consented profiles go out in a SINGLE COMPOSE_PROFILES line (container-broker,llm), because two lines do not add up — the last one would win and the broker would silently vanish. Left OUT, declared: the session stating ONCE that the semantic check was skipped (api side, another front); and the tag's E2E answers NO (switching on would download GBs of models), so startup with the llm profile is not proven end to end. Where: install.sh:1128 (consentir_llm), :1113 (escolher_porta_do_ollama), :1103 (porta_em_uso), :800 (escrever_env_do_llm), :821 (escrever_env_dos_profiles) Test: scripts/dev/install-llm.spec.ts (without a terminal it stays off stating the cost; 11434 taken picks the next one; whole range taken fails — failure case; a listening server is measured as in use; broker and models in a single line); scripts/dev/install-e2e.spec.ts (the answer to the new question is in the TTY driver's list, in order) Origin: AT-351
documents.s: RN-691 — install.sh ASKS whether to switch on the local models (profile llm), measures the Ollama port before writing, and composes ONE COMPOSE_PROFILES line

documents.t: detectar_por_sinais matched "Name":"brabo[^"]*", and the DEV compose (brabo-dev, ADR 0170) counted as a previous installation — the installer offered to migrate the development environment. Now it matches only the EXACT name brabo. And the migration confirmation gets a third answer: z reinstalls FROM SCRATCH. The order of ADR 0150 does not change — backup, PROOF, question, delete, install —, but the old data is NOT restored: the proven backup stays in the folder, and restoring it later is the runbook's #restore. s keeps restoring, and Enter still deletes nothing. Along with it, the wrap-up stops saying that pairing a folder through the project screen "still exists (ADR 0118)": that flow left in ADR 0203 (RN-687). documents.s: RN-692 — Only the brabo compose project is a previous installation, and migration offers reinstalling FROM SCRATCH after the proven backup

documents.t: Rule: the seven conversational agents (Criativo, PO, Arquiteto, Infra, Dev Lead, UX Designer, Staff) receive on every LLM call an EPHEMERAL system message with the delivery flow — the seven stages in order (Criativo → PO → Arquiteto → Infra → Dev Lead → dev agents → QA/SecOps → manual merge), WHERE the agent is, the real NEXT step and WHO triggers it (human × system) —, through the EngineApiClient facade, after the environment (RN-706) and before the profile (RN-680) and the language (RN-622, always the last). The source is ONE, Engine.Harness.FluxoDoTime, checked by a test against docs/fluxo.yml: every role cited exists there as active, and the text does not cite a stage outside it (deploy, pipeline, Dockerfile, InfraAgent). The Criativo records the user's EXPLICIT technical restriction (language, "no dependency", "no network", "a single module") as a decision_record (emit_artifact, RN-505), without a lecture; the Arquiteto's kickoff reads the session's artifact.decision_record (the same read by type, RN-580) and says to respect them, stating WHICH and WHY when going against one. The Arquiteto's wrap-up does not ask again for a confirmation already given, and the Infra does not paste the files into the chat nor promise deploy. Measurement (AT-369/AT-370, 10/02, loja-teste): the Criativo announced the Arquiteto as next (it is the PO); the PO said the Arquiteto would "implement"; the Arquiteto, that "dev agents start" after the ADRs, and asked "Confirme: Arquitetura pronta" after the confirmation; the Infra dumped ~80 lines of compose into the thread. The request "Node puro, nenhuma dependência, sem rede, um módulo só" did not become an artifact and the Arquiteto created three modules. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/fluxo_do_time.ex:107 (texto), :97 (anexar), apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/engine_api_client.ex:647 :97 (anexar), apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/engine_api_client.ex:700 (llm_turn), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/agents.ex:23 (identity), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/arquiteto_server.ex:388 (build_kickoff) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/fluxo_do_time_test.exs ("todo papel citado existe no fluxo.yml como ativo"; failure case: "nenhum texto cita etapa/agente fora do fluxo"), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/arquiteto_server_test.exs ("kickoff lê os decision_record e manda respeitar "um módulo só""), apps/engine/test/engine/harness/agents_test.exs Declared gap: the Arquiteto's decision_record read is the SESSION's (like the kickoff's rules and stories), not the whole project's; and nothing REFUSES a create_module_map that goes against the restriction — the instruction asks for the justification, it does not impose it. Origin: AT-369, AT-370
documents.s: RN-711 — The conversational agent knows where it is in the flow, and the user's technical restriction becomes a decision_record

documents.t: Rule: the dev agents (dev-*) and the QA subagents (qa-*) receive on every LLM call an EPHEMERAL environment system message, through the same path as the language (RN-622) and the author's profile (RN-680) — never in state.messages, never per server. It states the real folder in which the terminal runs (the loop's workspace_root, translated to /work by the same rule as TerminalExecutor when there is a REGISTERED running container), the image and network of the last artifact.project_image, that git is not run in the terminal (use git_commit/git_push/pr_open) and, for the dev agent, ITS MODULE: what it consumes from another module comes from the contract (listar_contratos_de_modulos) and is used through stub/mock, never reimplemented, and root files that already exist on dev (package.json, lockfile) are not recreated. Without a running container, the message SAYS so and does not assert /work. Ceiling of 1,200 characters; a read failure becomes an absent message, never a crashed turn. Measurement (AT-379/AT-378, 10/02, loja-teste): dev-api and qa-automacao ran cd /workspace (no prompt cites that folder); git status gave exit 127 in an image without git; dev-api (module api) created src/catalog.js and package.json, the same as dev-catalog's, and the merge conflicted. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/ambiente_do_agente.ex:102 (montar), :48 (com_ambiente), :65 (anexar), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tool_loop.ex:87 (com_ambiente) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/ambiente_do_agente_test.exs ("caminho feliz: com container running, a pasta é /work/.worktrees/"; failure case: "sem container running, não afirma /work") Declared gap: no notice in the git_commit result for a file of another module (the module_map does not say which paths belong to each module, so the notice would not be deterministic) and no commit block, by owner decision. Origin: AT-379, AT-378
documents.s: RN-706 — The execution agent knows where it is: folder, image, network, typed git and its own module

documents.t: Rule: when the approved merge of a PR is refused due to a conflict with dev (GitMergeConflictError, RN-704), each task of the PR that is in_review goes back to in_progress with gate_status reset (the old QA/SecOps verdicts do not apply to the branch that is going to change), records backlog.task_status_changed with cause: merge_conflict and puts task.merge_conflict in the outbox, with the agent that proposed the pr_open (the OWNER), the PR and the conflicting files. The engine delivers it to the owner through Engine.Dev.Wake; if free, he READOPTS the PR's branch (WorktreeManager.adopt/3, the same garantir_base, without losing the commits) and runs the CORRECTION loop with the reason in the text: bring in origin/dev through git fetch/git merge, resolve the files, run the suite. On report_done he proposes commit and push through the usual path (the current approval policy decides) and the gate RESTARTS from QA (open_gate + QA), without a new pr_open — the PR is the same branch. No new task state: in_progress with the cause in the event. Named outcomes: owner without a row in dev_agent_states — the task is BLOCKED (conflito de merge sem dev agent para resolvê-lo, origin infra); owner with the breaker open (idle_tripped) — blocked, origin politica; the branch does not come back (adopt fails) — blocked, origin infra. A busy owner (working/awaiting_gate/awaiting_approval) gets the conflict again in 30 s. The merge refusal (RN-705) does not depend on any of this: the action is already failed, with the reason, before the engine acts. A task that is no longer in_review (repeated merge) is not reopened nor wakes anyone, and a PR opened by a human has no owner to wake. Measurement (AT-383, 10/02, loja-teste): #6 ended failed due to a conflict in package.json, and the task stayed in_review with nobody to resolve it. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.ts:392 (devolverAoDono), apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/backlog.repository.ts:490 (reabrirPorConflitoDeMerge), apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/dev_agent_wake_worker.ex:151 (task.merge_conflict), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:350 (handle_info), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:831 (trigger_gate_recheck), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:47 (adopt) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.spec.ts ("conflito de merge → kind git_merge, arquivos no resultado e evento na tarefa"; failure: "RN-715: tarefa que já não está em revisão não é reaberta nem acorda ninguém"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs (describe "conflito de merge (RN-715)": readopts, reason in the turn, commit+push without a new PR, gate reopens from QA; failures: branch that does not come back and open breaker), apps/engine/test/engine/workers/dev_agent_wake_worker_test.exs ("dono que não existe: bloqueia a task com motivo nomeado, nada calado"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/worktree_manager_test.exs ("readotar a branch da PR preserva os commits dela") Declared gap: redelivery to a busy owner lives in memory — an engine restart in that window loses it, and the task stays in_progress until intervention (same family as the Engine.Dev.Wake gap, ADR 0045). The agent integrates dev by MERGE, not rebase: the forced push that rebase would require does not exist in the git executor. The NoopDevAgentServer does not handle the conflict. Origin: AT-383
documents.s: RN-715 — A merge conflict returns the task to the owning dev agent, and the gates judge again

documents.t: Rule: a failing git action records execution_result with the action's OWN kind (git_merge, pr_open, git_commit, git_push), failed: true, the error and, for git_merge, the pullRequestId; before, every failure recorded {kind: 'git_push', branch: ''}. A merge conflict (GitMergeConflictError, RN-704) also records conflictingFiles and a backlog.task_merge_conflict event on each task of the PR. GET projects/:projectId/actions accepts status=failed (only with actionType), and the PRs tab reads from there the last merge refusal of each open PR: the reason, the files and the sentence that the conflict needs to be resolved first. It is a text NOTICE, like the pending gate one (RN-663): the "Merge" button stays active and the decision remains human. Approving the merge invalidates the PR list, and so does the channel's action.git_merge/action.failed notice; the "PRs em revisão" list in Aprovações stops showing done tasks. The merge card names the human actor through the members read (RN-655) and shows the PR NUMBER (#3, not #pr-3), and the local provider records the PR's author (<agente>[bot]). Measurement (AT-383/AT-382, 10/02, loja-teste): #6 ended failed with the conflict in package.json and the PRs tab kept showing "ABERTA" with the "Merge" button, with no text at all; the action recorded kind: git_push. After an executed merge, the PR stayed in "Abertas" until reload, the card showed the user's UUID and #pr-3, and every local PR was "autor desconhecido". Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.ts:72 (resultadoDaFalha), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/list-project-pending-actions.use-case.ts:22 (execute), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.tsx:65 (ultimaRecusaDeMerge), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.ts:134 (alvosDoEvento) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.spec.ts ("conflito de merge → kind git_merge, arquivos no resultado e evento na tarefa"; failure case: "falha que não é conflito não grava arquivos nem evento de conflito"), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.test.tsx ("conflito de merge: mostra motivo e arquivos..."; "recusa de OUTRA PR não aparece nesta"), apps/api/test/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.contract.spec.ts ("grava o autor ao abrir...") Declared gap (closed in RN-715): the conflict does NOT wake the task's dev agent to rebase and resubmit. The path QA uses (DevAgentServer.correct/3) only acts with the agent in :awaiting_gate ON THE SAME task, and at merge time the gate has already finished (task.gate_resolved with done takes the agent to finish_task, which resets task, worktree and branch and claims another). Reusing it requires deciding how the agent readopts an in_review task on the existing branch and whether the gate runs again after the rebase — a design decision, not taken here. The task stays in_review, with the durable backlog.task_merge_conflict. Origin: AT-383, AT-382
documents.s: RN-705 — The merge refusal appears in the PRs tab, and the failure records the action's type

documents.t: Rule: the local provider's mergePullRequest fast-forwards only when the target is an ancestor of the source; with the two diverged, it builds a merge commit with both parents (git merge-tree --write-tree + commit-tree, without a worktree, message Merge pull request #N from <branch>, identity Brabo Bot). The target ref is moved by update-ref with the expected old value, so a concurrent merge fails instead of overwriting. A conflict throws GitMergeConflictError with the conflicting files: the ref stays intact, the PR stays open, the git_merge action ends failed with the reason in action.failed, and over HTTP the error is 409 merge_conflict. Measurement (AT-377): two PRs from the same base commit (#3 and #4) merged in sequence: dev ended up with only #4, and #3's commits stopped being its ancestors. The old update-ref was a forced reset. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.ts:783 (mergeShas), apps/api/src/domain/git/git-errors.ts:89 (GitMergeConflictError), apps/api/src/interfaces/http/shared/git-provider-error.filter.ts Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.contract.spec.ts ("duas PRs divergentes sem conflito: os dois commits ficam no alvo, por commit de merge"; failure case: "conflito: recusa nomeada com os arquivos, alvo intacto e PR aberta") Declared gap: GitHub and GitLab refuse the conflicting merge through their own API (405/406), without translation to GitMergeConflictError. Origin: AT-377
documents.s: RN-704 — The local repository's merge is a real merge, and a conflict is a named refusal

documents.t: Rule: in the production and installation composes, the engine's tmpfs /home/engine is born owned by the image's user (/home/engine:uid=1000,gid=1000,mode=0700). SemgrepDetector.Live distinguishes exit 1 with JSON (findings) from exit 0/1 with empty stdout, which becomes {:error, {:sem_saida, exit_code}} instead of :invalid_output. The gate's verdict does NOT change: a scanner that did not run is still "skipped" in the verdict's summary. Measurement (AT-380): inside brabo-engine-1 (production image, read_only: true), the tmpfs /home/engine was born root 2755; the gate's semgrep scan exited 1 with empty stdout and PermissionError: '/home/engine/.semgrep' on stderr, and the parser called that :invalid_output. With the tmpfs uid=1000 the same command returns the JSON (exit 0). Kubernetes did not have the defect (fsGroup: 1000 on the emptyDir). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/actions/semgrep_detector.ex:73 (interpretar), docker/docker-compose.prod.yml, docker/docker-compose.install.yml Test: apps/engine/test/engine/actions/semgrep_detector_test.exs ("JSON com results vira findings, inclusive com exit 1 (achou algo)"; failure case: "exit 1 com stdout vazio é falha de execução nomeada, não :invalid_output") Decision (revised by RN-714): the sentence "the gate's verdict does NOT change" no longer applies: the owner decided (10/02) that SAST that did not run leaves the gate PENDING and blocking. Origin: AT-380
documents.s: RN-707 — The SecOps gate's semgrep has a writable $HOME, and the output-less failure is named

documents.t: Rule: when the SecOps gate's semgrep does not run — missing binary, invalid output (:invalid_output), :sem_saida, exception or time ceiling —, no verdict is recorded: the PR stays in awaiting_secops, the gate stays PENDING and blocking, and the PR does not reach the user as approved by SecOps. The reason goes to the thread as an agent.error of origin infra ("SAST não rodou: — … reexecute o gate depois de corrigir"). The external contract does not change: the usual two verdicts remain (approved/changes_requested), one per gate. A missing gitleaks is still only "skipped" in the summary. Re-run: the cycle stays in_progress in gate_states, and the GateRescuer re-runs it at engine boot and after the staleness threshold (gate_rescue_stale_after_seconds, 15 min). There is no re-run gate button on screen. No repetition (AT-386): a rescue that finds the SAME reason again does not record another agent.error: if the SecOps's last event for that task (agent.error or artifact.secops_verdict, read by type, tail with a ceiling) is already this error with the same reason, only the server's Logger line remains. A different reason, a verdict in between or a failing read record again; the agent.error now carries taskId. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/secops_agent_server.ex:116 (run_secops), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/secops_agent_server.ex:144 (sast_nao_rodou), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/secops_agent_server.ex:194 (erro_ja_registrado?) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/secops_agent_server_test.exs ("sem achados (gitleaks e semgrep limpos): approved"; failure cases: "semgrep com saída inválida: gate pendente, sem veredito, motivo nomeado" and "semgrep com binário ausente: gate pendente, sem veredito, motivo nomeado"; AT-386: "primeiro resgate grava; o segundo, com o mesmo motivo, não", "motivo diferente, ou veredito depois do erro, grava de novo", "o SAST que volta a rodar aprova como sempre") Revises: RN-707 ("o veredito do gate NÃO muda") Origin: AT-380
documents.s: RN-714 — SAST that did not run leaves the SecOps gate pending, never approved

documents.t: Rule: without context_window in the context (the conversational agents do not declare it), the compaction window is DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW, whose default went from 8,192 to 128,000, the same value the gate and dev agents declare. When the summarizer (context-manager) fails or returns empty text, the summary is DETERMINISTIC (an excerpt of up to 300 characters of each replaced turn) and context.compacted records summaryOrigin: "deterministico" and falha with origem and motivo (RN-059). With the summarizer responding, summaryOrigin: "modelo" and falha: null. Measurement (AT-366): session 17d41c20, Arquiteto on anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5 (200k window): 6,799 tokens exceeded 0.7 × 8,192 = 5,734 and compacted 35 turns; the summarizer failed and the recorded summary was the marker "(35 turnos anteriores omitidos)". On the next turn the Arquiteto asked again for a confirmation it had already received. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/context_manager.ex:157 (summarize), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/context_manager.ex:188 (resumo_deterministico), apps/engine/config/runtime.exs (default_context_window) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/context_manager_test.exs ("sem context_window declarado: 6,8k tokens NÃO compactam"; "sumarizador respondendo: summaryOrigin modelo, sem falha"; failure case: "sumarizador falhando: falha NOMEADA com origem e resumo determinístico com o conteúdo") Declared gap: the window is still not read from the per-model catalog (the engine does not receive the binding's context_window); 128k is the installation default, adjustable through DEFAULT_CONTEXT_WINDOW. Origin: AT-366
documents.s: RN-702 — Context compaction respects the default 128k window and never swaps turns for an empty marker

documents.t: The "Contexto da sessão" panel reads the events already downloaded (RN-180). In a session with more events than the window, the business rules emitted at the start fall BEFORE it, and the counter said 0 with "Nada ainda." — asserting about what it did not read (measured in the 268-event session of 10/02: 5 rules became 0). With events prior to the window, the counter now says "N na janela · há mais antes" and the empty section says there are none IN THE LOADED EVENTS. No new read: the number of earlier ones still comes from subtraction over the seq. The other half of AT-365 — the already executed approval card asking for a decision again — was NOT fixed here: the thread card already decides by the ACTION's status (ApprovalCard, isPending), and the actions read is the tail plus the pending ones (RN-637); the defect does not reproduce through the web code. Measurement (10/02, in the AT-015 environment): GET .../actions?latest=true of session 17d41c20 returns both open_adr_pr as executed, and reloading the session (with the collapsed blocks opened) shows no "Aprovar". The pending card only appeared DURING the live session — a transient state of the screen, not of the api nor of the window. The next AT-015 round captures the network at the moment it appears, before any fix. Where: apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:393 (trailing), :415 (nadaNaJanela) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.painel-e-agrupamento.test.tsx ("RN-701 (AT-365): com as regras fora da janela, o contador não afirma 0"; the avoided failure case is the "alcançando o começo da sessão" next to it) Origin: AT-365
documents.s: RN-701 — The context panel does not assert "0" about rules that left the window

documents.t: The Visão geral of a freshly created project did not say what to do: with no provider key, no model and no session, nothing on screen pointed the way, and the credential and the catalog lived at the end of Configurações (measured in the real test of 10/02, fresh installation). Since AT-372 the Visão geral opens with the "Primeiros passos" card, with THREE steps, each with the link to the exact place: credential — the account has at least one LLM credential (the same ['credentials'] read as the Credenciais section, with configuration freshness and no poll, RN-645). The Visão geral did not make that read, and its load has a budget: it only runs when the team still has no model; with a resolved model, the step counts as covered; model — the Criativo's resolved binding is not null (the batch of RN-654, the same queryKey as Configurações); ideation — the project has at least one session (the list the page already polls). No new route. An input not read yet (or with an error) is "I don't know" (RN-470), and the card does NOT appear while there is one — asserting "credential missing" without having read it would be the screen lying. With all three done, it disappears. Along with it, the Configurações tab now opens on the models group, with the credential in front, and the summary follows the order. Where: apps/web/src/lib/primeiros-passos.ts:37 (derivarPrimeirosPassos), apps/web/src/components/PrimeirosPassos.tsx:22 (PrimeirosPassos) Test: apps/web/src/lib/primeiros-passos.test.ts (happy path and "insumo não lido não vira pendente") and apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.test.tsx ("primeiros passos (RN-708, AT-372)") Origin: AT-372
documents.s: RN-708 — A new project states the next step, derived from what is already read

documents.t: On the Infra's acceptance, infra-workflows replied with a question ("what is the project repository's provider?") that no human receives — a subagent does not converse —, and the delegation ended failed with origin modelo and a generic dev.error in the thread (measured in loja-teste, 10/02). The project was local: a bare repository on the server, with no CI runner. Provider local or absent: delegation to Workflows is dispensed (delegation dispensed, with the named justification — "repositório local … não tem CI que rode"), and the infra PR goes out with only what the Lead produced. Only github and gitlab delegate. When it delegates, the prompt says that the received provider ALREADY is the project's and forbids asking. A subagent that stops with TEXT instead of calling the tool is still a named failure reported to the lead, but the diagnosis says what it asked for: "pediu informação que não recebeu, em vez de chamar emit_infra_delegation_result: " (up to 300 characters). The infra PR's title carries the infra: prefix only when the model's summary does not already start with it (case-insensitively) — before, it came out "infra: infra: Dockerfile…" (AT-396). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/workflows_agent.ex:61 (dispensa), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead.ex:69 (com_prefixo), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/workflows_agent.ex:184 (parada_sem_ferramenta), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:1217 (finalize) apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:1217 (finalize) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/infra/workflows_agent_test.exs ("RN-710: …") and apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_server_test.exs ("RN-710: repositório local dispensa o Workflows …") and apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_test.exs ("com_prefixo/1 (AT-396)") Origin: AT-368, AT-396
documents.s: RN-710 — Workflows is not delegated without a CI that runs, and asks no one

documents.t: Measured in the real test of 10/02 (loja-teste): the turn strip showed raw Markdown, the structured form's answer appeared twice, the manual handoff selector offered Dev Lead, QA and Infra from the first minute of ideation, the "Para" stayed on the PO with the Arquiteto already working, the "Iniciar ideação" button reappeared mid-session and an 80-line docker-compose pushed the conversation off screen. Since AT-375: turn strip — the preview and the expanded lines go through textoPlanoDoMarkdown: **, ##, rules, tables and backticks become running text. The strip is a preview; the rendered answer is still the bubble at the end of the turn (RN-460), and the streaming store does not change (RN-639); answered form — the api resends the answers to the agent as the user's chat.message; the bubble whose text is EXACTLY what the api assembles ("<n>. <rótulo>: <resposta>"), the first user message after the answer, leaves the thread, because the answered card already shows them. A typed message that merely looks like a list stays; recipient — the choice made in the composer's SELECTOR is manual and is never overwritten. One that came from a gesture (accepting a handoff on this screen, "Estou pronto") follows the target of the last ACCEPTED handoff, including one accepted by the system (RN-660). It revises the RN-631 clause that an acceptance through another path "only adds the option" — only for a choice that was not manual. With no choice at all and two options, sending stays locked; manual handoff — the selector is born collapsed behind a button; the list of agents did not change; "Iniciar ideação" — disappears from the header as soon as some agent has joined the session (agent event or handoff); header — the time becomes "iniciada às HH:MM:SS", and the language origin wraps into up to two lines before ellipsizing, with the full text in title; code block — above 20 lines it is born collapsed to the first 8, with "Mostrar as N linhas". Left out, measured: the Criativo's first "modelo não registrado" bubble comes from the ENGINE — criativo_server.ex records the accumulated text with a null modelName when the turn ends by delivering a form (gravar_texto_do_turno(state, "", nil)), not from the screen. Where: apps/web/src/lib/texto-plano.ts:7 (textoPlanoDoMarkdown), apps/web/src/lib/eco-de-formulario.ts:17 (ecosDeRespostaEstruturada), apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.ts:237 (resolverDestinatario), apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.tsx:74 (CodeFence) Test: apps/web/src/lib/texto-plano.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/eco-de-formulario.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.test.ts ("RN-712"), apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.test.tsx ("RN-712") Origin: AT-375
documents.s: RN-712 — The session thread shows what just happened, once and legibly

documents.t: Measured in the test project of 10/02. Four defects of the same decision card, closed together: The verb follows the action's state (AT-371). The pending PR card said "abriu pull request (de ADR)" before opening. VERBO_DA_ACAO speaks of the PROPOSAL ("quer abrir pull request…") and VERBO_DA_ACAO_EXECUTADA gives the verb of what already happened, only for the types whose tense changes; verboDaAcao receives the status and is the single source. ADR and infra PRs are an RN-418 ceiling (AT-371). open_adr_pr and open_infra_pr enter TIPOS_SEM_SEMPRE_PERMITIR (api and the web copy, checked by test), like pr_open — "sempre permitir" refuses to record the pattern and the card offers neither the button nor "Modo automático". Outside the terminal, the notes no longer speak of a command ("npm test", "roda qualquer comando"): the typed type has its own note. The plan shows the estimate (AT-381). On proposing propose_execution_plan the api adds to the payload orcamentoPorTarefaMicros — the CURRENT per-task budget, the same one activation uses (project setting or the default of US$ 0.50) —, and the card's sentence says "até US$ X (N tarefas × US$ Y) — é o teto por tarefa, não o preço". No new route. A module without tasks gets no agent (AT-381). Applying the plan passes to the activation the modules with ≥ 1 task (modulosDoPlano); those of the module_map without tasks stay out and are stated in the result (modulosSemTarefa), next to tarefasPorModulo. The "Ativar execução" button (without a plan) and a plan without tarefas still start the whole map. The computed summary reaches the Dev Lead in the tool result text (resumo_do_plano/1), so he can cite the numbers instead of recounting. Where: apps/web/src/lib/aprovacoes.ts:428 (verboDaAcao), apps/api/src/domain/actions/sempre-permitir.ts:33 (TIPOS_SEM_SEMPRE_PERMITIR), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/propose-action.use-case.ts:84 (execute), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/execute-execution-plan.use-case.ts:89 (execute), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/activate-execution.use-case.ts:123 (execute), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools.ex:587 (resumo_do_plano) Test: apps/web/src/lib/aprovacoes.test.ts ("AT-371 — o verbo segue o estado da ação", "AT-381 — o plano mostra a estimativa de gasto"), apps/web/src/components/ApprovalCard.test.tsx ("open_adr_pr pendente"), apps/api/test/domain/actions/sempre-permitir.spec.ts, apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/activate-execution.use-case.spec.ts ("módulos do plano"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/execute-execution-plan.use-case.spec.ts, apps/engine/test/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools_test.exs (resumo_do_plano/1) Origin: AT-371, AT-381
documents.s: RN-709 — The card uses the right verb tense, the ceiling does not offer "sempre permitir", and the plan states how much it costs and only starts agents with tasks

documents.t: Rule: a proficiency profile is only recorded when the evidence includes at least one event written by the profiled person THEMSELVES that is not an approval click (proposed_action.approved, handoff.accepted, readiness.confirmed). Evidence only from other actors is "not observed" — absence of opportunity, never little knowledge —, and "not observed" is its own state: the batch is refused with a named reason, nothing is recorded and no anamnese.profile_updated is born. Approval alongside an interaction of the person is still accepted. The person's message that repairs an agent failure is a deviation of the AGENT and not a trait of theirs: the prompt says so, and the record lives in RN-717. Measurement (AT-376): in the loja-teste of 10/02, "Git → iniciante" and "Infra → iniciante" without the person having interacted with either of the two, and "aprova 2 ADRs sem hesitar" as advanced architecture. Where: apps/api/src/domain/anamnese/proficiency-validation.ts:53 (ehEvidenciaObservadaDaPessoa), apps/api/src/domain/anamnese/proficiency-validation.ts:74 (validateProficiencyBatch), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/anamnese/record-proficiency.use-case.ts:189 (resolveKnownEventIds), rules in the kickoff (prompts/anamnese-kickoff.md v3 and the inline fallback of anamnese_worker.ex) Test: apps/api/test/domain/anamnese/proficiency-validation.spec.ts ("RN-716: aprovação ao lado de interação da pessoa passa"; failures: "só evidência de outro ator é "não observado"", "aprovação sem leitura não é evidência"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/anamnese/record-proficiency.use-case.spec.ts ("evidência só de aprovação não grava perfil nem profile_updated") Declared gap: recognizing the REPAIR message in the profile batch is up to the model (prompt); the code does not classify message text. Origin: AT-376
documents.s: RN-716 — The Anamnese does not record a level about what it did not observe, and approving is not mastering

documents.t: Rule: an agent loop, a turn cancelled by the user and a user message that repairs an agent failure are recorded by the Anamnese as anamnese.agent_deviation (tool report_agent_deviation), never as the person's profile. The payload is assembled in the engine by an allowlist — agente, tipo (laco | cancelamento_pelo_usuario | reparo_pelo_usuario) and evidenceEventIds (deduplicated, ceiling of 20) —, without free text and without the user's id, name, e-mail or trait; an extra field is discarded. The type is not projected into the user's graph. A type outside the vocabulary or without evidence is refused, without recording. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/anamnese/tools/report_agent_deviation.ex:73 (payload), apps/engine/lib/engine/anamnese/tools/report_agent_deviation.ex:52 (run), apps/engine/lib/engine/anamnese/tools.ex, rule in the kickoff (prompts/anamnese-kickoff.md v4) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/anamnese/report_agent_deviation_test.exs ("reparo do usuário vira anamnese.agent_deviation do AGENTE, só com agente, tipo e evidência"; failures: "tipo fora do vocabulário é recusado e nada é gravado", "sem evidência é recusado"), apps/api/test/application/graph-projection/desvio-do-agente-fora-do-grafo.spec.ts Declared gap: the api does not check that the evidence exists; reading is by querying the event log, without a screen (ADR 0205). Origin: AT-356 (part 2), owner decision of 10/02
documents.s: RN-717 — The agent deviation the Anamnese observes becomes a product signal, without personal data

documents.t: Revises RN-418 and RN-689, only in the push and PR half, by owner decision (10/02, AT-385). With the agent_autonomy wildcard actionType: "*" in auto_approve (auto mode, RN-153, the autopilot of RN-670), typed git_push and pr_open and the same effect through the terminal command (git push, git remote add/set-url, gh pr create, glab mr create) come out auto_approve, with the reason "modo automático (RN-713)" in proposed_action.created (RN-567). Only the wildcard unlocks: a specific auto_approve rule without it, "Sempre permitir" (refused at the source, RN-642) and allow in permissions.json stay under the RN-418 ceiling, and activation still seeds only git_commit. Still an absolute ceiling even in auto mode: merge (typed into a protected branch, and git merge/gh pr merge through the terminal), deploy, sudo/doas, container_remove, instruction_patch and parallelism. The toggle in manual restores approval. Where: apps/api/src/domain/actions/decide.ts:296 (modoAutomaticoDoAgente), :311 (decide); apps/api/src/domain/actions/external-effect.ts:294 (mensagemDoModoAutomaticoNoEfeitoExterno); apps/web/src/components/OQueOPilotoLibera.tsx Test: apps/api/test/domain/actions/decide.spec.ts (the autopilot unlocks git push/gh pr create and the typed ones; git merge, gh pr merge and sudo stay require_approval; specific and allow without the wildcard stay under the ceiling; wildcard in require_approval asks for approval — failure cases); apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/propose-action.use-case.spec.ts (with Postgres: auto-approved and executed, reason in the event; a specific one alone is born pending); apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.test.tsx, AgentCard.test.tsx, ApprovalCard.test.tsx (the screen says push and PR are unlocked) Architectural decision: ADR 0204 Origin: AT-385, owner decision on 10/02

documents.t: ['session-actions', projectId, sessionId] is ONE TanStack Query cache entry, and the Sessões tab wrote into it the result of another question: the FIRST ascending page (listActions({ limit: 200 }), without latest), while the Session thread reads the tail of the 200 newest plus the pending ones it pushed out (RN-637). The two screens swapped each other's cut — after opening the tab, the thread could draw the session's 200 OLDEST actions, the defect RN-637 closed, reopened through the cache door (AT-365). The rule: key and function go together, in consultaDasAcoesDaSessao (apps/web/src/lib/acoes-da-sessao.ts). Whoever READS a session's actions to put them in the cache uses that pair — usePendingActions and the per-session summary of the Sessões tab. A key of its own for the tab was considered and discarded: it would stop the cache swap, but keep the tab summarizing the wrong cut. With the same read, the summary gains — a long session's new pending one now counts in "aguardando". Whoever only INVALIDATES the key (decision on the approval screens, the live channel) still writes the list by hand: invalidating writes no data. Where: apps/web/src/lib/acoes-da-sessao.ts:76 (chaveDasAcoesDaSessao), :80 (consultaDasAcoesDaSessao); apps/web/src/lib/hooks.ts:432 (usePendingActions); apps/web/src/routes/ProjectSessionsTab.tsx:270 (acoesPorSessao) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectSessionsTab.test.tsx (describe "a leitura de ações é a mesma do fio": with the thread having written the tail, mounting the tab leaves tail + pending in the cache and no call without latest — fails on the old code, which wrote the 200 oldest; and the pending one pushed out of the tail counts in "aguardando") Declared gap: the card of an action whose proposed_action.created left the 200-event window still JUMPS to the top of the thread (ordemDaAcaoNaTimeline degrades to createdAt and anchors at 0.5) — locked as current behavior in apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.acao-fora-da-janela.test.tsx, whose fix is a separate decision. The same test proves that the decided card does not ask for a decision again: what seemed to "come back" in AT-365 was ANOTHER action. Origin: AT-365
documents.s: RN-718 — Whoever writes a session's actions into the cache makes the SAME read as the thread

documents.t: Context: measured live (10/02, Haiku 4.5 via OpenRouter), the model sends lists and objects as a JSON STRING ("business_rule_ids": "[\"01M…\"]"). Three outcomes: create_story silently discarded the ids (the story stayed draft), other tools refused and cost rounds, and create_c4_diagram did Enum.map on a string and brought down the Arquiteto's turn with agent.error. The rule: every tool of the seven conversational agents and of the ToolLoop runs through ONE point, Engine.Harness.ArgumentosDeFerramenta.executar/4. An argument whose schema declares array/object and arrives as a valid JSON string of the type becomes the value; a string that is not is a NAMED refusal ("o campo X precisa ser uma lista"), before the tool runs. A field declared string is never touched. An exception raised inside the tool becomes tool.result ok: false with origem: "codigo", and the error enters the loop like any other (RN-163): the turn continues. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:26 (executar), :73 (coagir), :52 (falha_interna?); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/resultado_de_ferramenta.ex:29 (payload); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tool_loop.ex:348 (run_direct); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/arquiteto_server.ex:331 (executar_ferramenta, the same helper in the other six servers) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta_test.exs (create_story with ids in a JSON string records the ids; create_c4_diagram with actors in a JSON string works; a non-JSON string in an array field is a named refusal; a tool that throws does not end the ToolLoop turn and records tool.result ok: false) Origin: AT-387
documents.s: RN-719 — An agent tool accepts a list sent as JSON text, and an exception inside it goes back to the loop

documents.t: The Arquiteto passed to assign_story_modules the first 8 characters of the story's id, the api responded 400 "storyId must be a UUID" and, after eight attempts, no story got a module (loja-teste-2, 10/02). Every agent tool that receives a story or task id — assign_story_modules and create_task (story_id), assess_implementability (storyId) and propose_execution_plan (tarefas[].taskId) — passes the id through Engine.Harness.IdDoBacklog before calling the api: A full UUID goes on without a query. A prefix of at least 8 hexadecimal characters is resolved against the PROJECT backlog (list_backlog): a single id starting with it becomes the UUID; none is a named refusal ("nenhuma história do projeto tem id começando com …"); more than one is a named refusal ("o prefixo … é ambíguo"). The refusal goes back to the model as the tool result (RN-163). What is neither a UUID nor a prefix goes on as it came, and the api refuses it. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/id_do_backlog.ex:21 (resolver), :43 (resolver_em); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools.ex:176 (resolver_tarefas) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/id_do_backlog_test.exs (a unique prefix resolves; ambiguous and nonexistent refuse by name) Origin: AT-390
documents.s: RN-721 — A shortened story or task id is resolved within the project

documents.t: Owner decision on 10/02 (ADR 0208), revising the literal none network of the start on acceptance of RN-671. The Infra's election uses the network of the most recent artifact.project_image emitted by the Arquiteto (actor_id: "arquiteto", any session of the project), read locally by the engine; without a decision of his, or with a value outside none/egress, it stays none. It applies to the server's start on acceptance and to the propose_container_start tool without network. The seeded autonomy does not change: egress starts without a click, and the price (the egress network reaches the machine's published ports, ADR 0189) is declared in the ADR. Code: apps/engine/lib/engine/session_events/event.ex:139 (rede_do_arquiteto), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:740 (rede_herdada) Tests: apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_server_test.exs — "RN-723: a subida herda a rede egress que o Arquiteto declarou" and "RN-723: rede do Arquiteto fora do vocabulário — a subida segue none" Origin: AT-392
documents.s: RN-723 — The Infra inherits the network the Arquiteto declared for the project

documents.t: Context: in the real use of loja-teste-2 (10/02) the PO created twelve stories without a linked rule, read in listar_regras_de_negocio that seven of the eight rules were WITHOUT coverage, wrote that it had no tool to edit a story and called offer_handoff to the Arquiteto anyway — asserting in the thread that coverage was complete and that the system would accept on its own. The automatic acceptance of RN-660 did not happen (the criterion did not hold), and the story it recreated triggered the semantic duplicate notice (RN-681). The rule: The PO has complete_story: it completes an EXISTING draft story of the project — the given business_rule_ids are ADDED to those already linked (completing never unlinks a rule; an id that is not an artifact.business_rule is 400), given non-empty lists replace the current ones and omitted ones stay. A story that is not draft is 409; from another project, 404. After writing, promotion follows the SAME criterion as create_story (isPromotable; auto goes to ready, manual sets proposedReady), and the write records backlog.story_completed. The PO's offer_handoff to the Arquiteto is REFUSED, without creating an offer, while there is a rule without a story or an incomplete draft story (without proposedReady) — and the result lists both, with id and title, and says to complete with complete_story. Coverage is the api's (computeCoverage, the same as the automatic acceptance), never a second count in the engine; a read failure does not become a refusal. The other agents and targets do not go through the check. When the PO's business_rule emit_artifact comes back with the similarity notice (status: warned), the result adds that the rule seems to ALTER an existing one and that it should ask the user (ask_structured_questions) which one holds before going on (AT-389: the user said "taxa fixa de R$ 10", the Criativo recorded "R$ 10 por pedido" and the PO emitted "R$ 10 por torrefador"). The already recorded rule is not undone; the notice stays a notice. The PO's kickoff says all three things. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/backlog/complete-story.use-case.ts:52 (CompleteStoryUseCase); apps/api/src/interfaces/http/internal/internal-sessions.controller.ts:541 (completeStoryRoute); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/complete_story.ex:47 (run); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/offer_handoff.ex:52 (recusa_por_cobertura); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/emit_artifact.ex:188 (pergunte_antes) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/complete-story.use-case.spec.ts (links the rule and proposes promotion; auto goes to ready; nonexistent rule, another project and ready story refused); apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/offer_handoff_test.exs (describe "cobertura (RN-720)": refusal with the list, complete coverage offers and the automatic acceptance follows); apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/complete_story_test.exs; apps/engine/test/engine/harness/duplicata_semantica_test.exs (the notice in the PO says to ask; outside the PO or without a notice, it does not) Declared gap: the PO's server still offers on its own at the end of the turn through RN-700, which already required coverage; the refusal here is the TOOL's. Whether the semantic duplicate warned in the real loja-teste-2 case was not measured in this change (that run's database was not read). Origin: AT-388, AT-389
documents.s: RN-720 — The PO completes the story that already exists, and does not offer the handoff to the Arquiteto with an uncovered rule

documents.t: Rule (Anamnese): (1) a round that EVALUATED the window and ended without a profile (skip_proficiency) records anamnese_runs with zero profiles, and the next one starts at window_to — revising the clause of RN-680/the moduledoc "a round that does not conclude does not record": a round that FAILS (ceiling, budget, provider) still does not record, and one that never reaches the LLM (no subject, triage, daily ceiling) closes nothing; (2) the events the Anamnese itself writes (anamnese.* and every event of actor agent/anamnese) and those of actor system stay out of the window and of the triage count; (3) owner decision of 10/02: a subject is whoever has at least 5 NEW own interactions (events of actor_kind: "user" plus decisions, in the window that already starts at the end of the last attempt) — revising the "at least ONE" of RN-680 —, and the project has at most 4 paid rounds per UTC day (concluded, failed or run_skipped written by the model; the no-subject skip does not count). Below either of the two, no LLM or RAG call; the reason goes to the log and, only in a manually requested round, to anamnese.run_skipped (causa: "teto_diario" or "sem_sujeito_elegivel"). Rule (gate rescue, revises RN-140): the GateRescuer (a) considers alive the cycle whose TASK is in flight in the lead, by asking it ({:em_voo?, task_id}), and no longer the project's process — an idle lead does not hold the rescue; a lead too busy to answer counts as alive; (b) does not restart a cycle whose session has a PENDING proposed_action from a gate actor (qa*, secops*, appsec) — it only logs; (c) owner decision of 10/02: a cycle stalled for more than 2 h since its LAST ACTIVITY (updated_at) is PARKED (parked_at) with gate.rescue_parked in the session log (task, gate, age, reason), is resumed neither at boot nor on the tick, and resuming requires a human gesture (GateRescuer.retomar_estacionado/3). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/anamnese_worker.ex:189 (fechar_janela), apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/anamnese_worker.ex:104 (dentro_do_teto_diario?), apps/engine/lib/engine/session_events/event.ex:194 (project_window_query), apps/engine/lib/engine/session_events/event.ex:202 (count_anamnese_rounds_since), apps/engine/lib/engine/anamnese/elegibilidade.ex:67 (min_interacoes_proprias), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/anamnese/record-proficiency.use-case.ts:160 (fecharJanelaSemPerfil), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/gate_rescuer.ex:336 (task_em_voo?), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/gate_rescuer.ex:360 (aguardando_humano?), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/gate_rescuer.ex:283 (estacionar), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/gate_rescuer.ex:320 (retomar_estacionado), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:95 (handle_call) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/workers/anamnese_worker_test.exs (describe "a janela avaliada fecha (RN-722)": "skip_proficiency grava a rodada vazia; a segunda começa em window_to e, sem interação nova, não chama o LLM"; failures: "falha ao fechar a janela não vira falha da rodada", "rodada que FALHA não fecha a janela"; describe "piso de interações e teto diário (RN-722)"), apps/engine/test/engine/anamnese/elegibilidade_test.exs, apps/engine/test/engine/session_events/event_window_test.exs ("dez eventos da Anamnese sozinhos não passam a triagem"), apps/engine/test/engine/gates/gate_rescuer_test.exs ("lead do projeto vivo e OCIOSO não segura o resgate de uma task perdida", "ciclo com ação PENDENTE de ator do gate espera o humano", "ação pendente de OUTRO ator não segura o resgate", "ciclo parado há mais de 2 h é ESTACIONADO", "ciclo parado há MENOS de 2 h segue sendo resgatado"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/anamnese/record-proficiency.use-case.spec.ts (describe "fecharJanelaSemPerfil (RN-722)") Declared gap: resuming a parked cycle had no screen nor route — it was an operator call (bin/engine rpc); it closed in RN-724 (route and button on the gate.rescue_parked event). The human pending item is read through the cycle's SESSION (the proposed_action has no task_id) (ADR 0207). Origin: AT-391 (real use of 10/02: ~US$ 8.90 of Anamnese in a day without anyone asking; a gate cycle restarted with a pending action and another one 8 h without rescue), owner decisions of 10/02
documents.s: RN-722 — The Anamnese closes the window it evaluated and only runs with new interaction; gate rescue asks about the task, respects the pending human decision and parks the old cycle

documents.t: Rule: the gate cycle PARKED by the rescue (RN-722, ADR 0207) is resumed through POST /projects/:projectId/tasks/:taskId/gates/:gate/resume, with the SAME minimum role as whoever decides the PR (developer). The api only authorizes and asks the engine (POST /internal/projects/:id/tasks/:taskId/gates/:gate/resume), which delegates to GateRescuer.retomar_estacionado/3: a cycle that does not exist, is not parked or a gate outside qa/secops is 409 gate_nao_estacionado and nothing is dispatched. In the session thread, the gate.rescue_parked event becomes a notice with the "Retomar gate" button, inert with the reason in text when the role does not reach developer; the refusal shows the api's sentence. No new poll: the resumed gate's progress arrives through the session log. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine_web/controllers/gate_command_controller.ex:15 (resume), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/gates/resume-parked-gate.use-case.ts:18 (execute), apps/api/src/infrastructure/http-clients/api-to-engine-client.ts:351 (resumeParkedGate), apps/api/src/interfaces/http/gates/gate-resume.controller.ts:40 (resume), apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.tsx:59 (RetomarGateEstacionado) Test: apps/engine/test/engine_web/controllers/gate_command_controller_test.exs ("ciclo estacionado: 202 e despacha o gate de novo"; failure: "ciclo NÃO estacionado: 409 nomeado e nada despachado"), apps/api/test/interfaces/http/gates/gate-resume.controller.spec.ts (happy, 409 gate_nao_estacionado, role below developer), apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.test.tsx (the click calls the route; the refusal becomes a toast with the api's sentence; an insufficient role leaves the button inert) Origin: AT-397, closing the gap declared in RN-722

documents.t: Rule: (1) the OPTIMISTIC bubble of the message sent to an agent leaves the thread as soon as the chat.message with the mensagemId the api returned on acceptance is in the log — matching by id, never by text, and without waiting for the end of the turn; its name comes from the SAME autorDaMensagem as the log bubble (RN-652), with the token's e-mail only as a fallback. Before, the two coexisted during the turn, one with the name and the other with the e-mail. (2) On the card "passou o bastão ao Dev Lead", accepting the handoff is the primary gesture and "Ativar execução" is SECONDARY, with the notice of what it skips: without a plan, the devs pick up the tasks as they are (RN-677). Where: apps/web/src/lib/mensagem-otimista.ts:14 (otimistaJaNoLog), apps/web/src/lib/mensagem-otimista.ts:22 (nomeDaMensagemOtimista), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.tsx:790 (otimistaJaNoLog), apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:609 (handleActivateExecution) Test: apps/web/src/lib/mensagem-otimista.test.ts (happy: the id in the log removes the optimistic one; failure: an absent id or one of another type keeps it; the name is the member row's), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.cancelar-turno.test.tsx ("com o turno em curso, a otimista sai quando o chat.message do aceite chega ao log"), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.handoff-devlead-e-colapso.test.tsx ("o aceite é o primário; "Ativar execução" é secundário e diz o que pula") Origin: AT-409 and AT-410 (TP-01 of 10/03); the card's shape is the owner's decision ("Secundário com aviso")
documents.s: RN-728 — The user's message has a single bubble, and the Dev Lead card has a single primary

documents.t: Context: in TP-01 (10/03, Claude Haiku 4.5) the PO recorded story titles with the LITERAL unicode escape (código): the normalization of RN-719 only decoded array/object fields. Recreated with the right title, the stories went through the duplicate refusal (RN-720/RN-081), which did not match the escaped one with the normal one. And the "exige X" refusals did not say what had arrived: the PO spent 28+ steps (48% of the test's cost) up to the ceiling, and complete_story replied "ainda faltam RF, DoD, DoR ou business_rule_ids" without saying which. The rule: At the same point as RN-719, a string with a LITERAL \uXXXX (surrogate pair included) is decoded, and with it \n, \t, \" and \\ of the SAME string. A string without \uXXXX comes back byte for byte — code in a content with a literal "\n" does not change. This revises RN-719's "a string field is never touched" only in this case. The EXACT duplicate of a story (api) and of a rule (engine) compares the title with the escape decoded, before the usual case folding and NFD. A tool refusal that says "exige X" gains, at the same point, the KEYS that arrived (names, never values), or that a string/list arrived instead of an object. emit_artifact with a key missing in the payload states the missing keys and the received ones, instead of {:missing_keys, …}. complete_story names exactly what is missing (falta: business_rule_ids), by the same yardstick as the api's missingForReady, read from the returned story. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:88 (decodificar_escapes), :135 (chaves_recebidas), :152 (com_chaves_recebidas); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/complete_story.ex:80 (faltam); apps/api/src/domain/backlog/story-overlap.ts:39 (decodificarEscapesLiterais), :25 (normalizarTitulo); apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/artifact_dedupe.ex (normalizar) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta_test.exs (describe "RN-725": escape decoded, text without \u and list intact; refusal with the keys and without the values; complete_story names the field); apps/api/test/domain/backlog/story-overlap.spec.ts (escaped title matches the normal one; a different title stays different) Origin: AT-405, AT-408
documents.s: RN-725 — Text with a literal escape is decoded, and the argument refusal says what arrived

documents.t: Rule: when the model's provider refuses for lack of CREDIT (HTTP 402, or OpenRouter's text "available credits"/"add credits"), the dev agent's turn is not "stopped without concluding": the task is blocked with the reason "crédito do provider esgotado" and origin infra (never codigo), the automatic stop counter (RN-047) does NOT advance, and the agent does NOT claim the next task — it stays in idle_tripped and emits dev.credit_exhausted (motivo: credito_esgotado), never dev.idle_tripped. Resumption is the Rearmar that already existed in the team panel, after topping up the credit; the blocked task comes back through the usual unblock. The Executores screen shows the agent travado with "crédito do provedor do modelo esgotado — recarregue e rearme para retomar", and the bell says the same. The same recognition makes FalhaDeTurno.origem/1 return infra for the credit final frame (it applies to the gate agents, like QA). The session counts dev.credit_exhausted as pending work, like dev.idle_tripped. Since RN-730 the 402 arrives with its own code (insufficient_credit) and it is that which decides; recognition by text remained only as a safety net. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:134 (credito_esgotado?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:906 (handle_outcome), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:271 (pausar_por_credito), apps/web/src/lib/agent-status.ts:198 (breakerReasonFor), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-pending-work.use-case.ts Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs ("402 do provider: origem infra, pausa sem idle_tripped e sem queimar a próxima task"; failure: "erro que não é de crédito segue como antes: parou sem concluir, conta no disjuntor"), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/falha_de_turno_test.exs ("402 do provider é infra e é reconhecido"), apps/web/src/lib/agent-status.test.ts ("RN-726: dev.credit_exhausted é travado com motivo de crédito…") Origin: AT-407 (TP-01 of 10/03: OpenRouter's 402 became three tasks blocked with origin codigo and the automatic stop)
documents.s: RN-726 — The provider's exhausted credit pauses the dev agent, with origin infra, without burning the following tasks

documents.t: Rule: the LLM provider's HTTP 402 is normalized as insufficient_credit (before it fell into upstream), in the same status table of ADR 0041 — the other statuses stay as they were. The code travels to the engine as errorCode next to error, in the llm-turn body and in the final frame of llm-turn/stream (null without an error or with an error that is not the provider's, like budget and missing binding). In the engine, FalhaDeTurno.credito_esgotado?/1 decides first by the code (insufficient_credit is credit; another code is not, even with the sentence), and the conversational agents' {:final, texto, code} frame gives origin infra by the code. RN-726's text recognition stays only as a SAFETY NET: an api older than the field, and a path that only carries the message. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/llm-provider-errors.ts:38 (LLMInsufficientCreditError), :81 (normalizeHttpStatus), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/run-llm-turn.use-case.ts:207 (streamErrorCode), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/stream-llm-turn.use-case.ts:219 (streamErrorCode), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:83 (credito_esgotado?), :71 (origem), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tool_loop.ex:148 (last_error_code), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:906 (handle_outcome) Test: apps/api/test/contract/llm-provider.contract.ts (erro_402 vira chunk de erro com code "insufficient_credit"; failure: erro_500 stays upstream), run by all provider contract suites; apps/engine/test/engine/agents/falha_de_turno_test.exs ("insufficient_credit é crédito esgotado e origem infra, sem frase nenhuma"; failure: "outro code não é crédito, mesmo com a frase; sem code, o texto é a rede") Origin: AT-416 (the declared gap of RN-726)
documents.s: RN-730 — The provider's 402 has its own code, and it is that which decides exhausted credit

documents.t: Rule: four clauses measured in TP-01 (10/03). (1) The infra PR (open_infra_pr) follows RN-664: the branch feature/infra-setup is born from dev and the PR targets dev — the dev agent's worktree is born from dev, so the Dockerfile merged into main never reached it. A repository without dev fails named by the provider, without falling back to the default. The PR carries the author <agente>[bot] (infra[bot] when the actor is not an agent), the same identity as RN-705. In Aprovações, each infra PR under review gets "Mergear na aba PRs", which switches the frame to the PRs tab (where merge lives). (2) Opening a project COLLAPSES the others in the sidebar and scrolls the list to it; on the Dashboard none is forced expanded; the chevron still toggles by hand. (3) The text fields of the "Novo projeto" wizard (name, path, adopted repository) carry SEM_AUTOFILL, the same set as RN-693. (4) Deciding a merge in the PRs tab invalidates the project's whole pending queue, so the sidebar's "PRs" counter does not keep showing the already executed merge until the next poll; and the QA (or SecOps) lead stops saying "trabalhando" when, after the last verdict, a subagent of the area records delegation.failed — it becomes falhou. No new query or poll. documents.t: Rule: a draft story WITHOUT a task in execution (in_progress or in_review) can have its title corrected and can be ARCHIVED — by the PO (tools update_story, which also corrects the description, and archive_story) and by the user in the Backlog tab ("Editar título" and "Arquivar", with confirmation). Both doors go through the SAME yardstick (recusaDeCorrecaoDeHistoria), and the refusal is a NAMED 409: historia_arquivada, historia_nao_draft or historia_com_tarefa_em_execucao, with the sentence the model and the toast show. Archiving does NOT delete: the stories row gets archived_at/archived_reason (migration 0069, ADR 0212), the tasks stay, and the NEW event backlog.story_archived keeps who, why and which tasks; the edit records backlog.story_updated with the previous title. The archived story leaves the backlog (listar_backlog included — the PO does not see it so as not to complete it again), the coverage (computeCoverage reads only the non-archived ones), the promotion queue, the Dev Lead's plan and the claim, and its tasks go with it, through the story; transition, complete_story and create_task refuse an archived story. The user's minimum role is that of the other backlog writes (promote/return, RN-048): developer; below it the buttons stay inert with the reason in text, and the same applies to a story outside draft or with a task in execution. Each story shows how many tasks it has. documents.t: Rule: the number of what a conversational agent recorded in a turn is a SERVER FACT, never model text (RN-163). The Criativo, the PO and the Arquiteto count, in the turn's process, each write tool that came back ok (emit_artifact by type — business rule, decision, note, other —, create_epic, create_story, update_story, archive_story, create_task), and the closing of agent.response gains, AFTER the model's text and without rewriting it, the line "Gravado neste turno: N …". A refused tool and a read do not count; a turn without writes gets no line; the count dies with the turn. The line comes out in the turn's language (RN-622): the author's, otherwise the project's; pt* in Portuguese ("Gravado neste turno: 1 regra de negócio"), any other language — or none resolved — in English ("Recorded this turn: 2 business rules"), with singular and plural in both. documents.t: Rule: the text the model writes in a conversational agent's turn — the content (closing) and each passos of agent.response — goes through the SAME decodificar_escapes/1 of RN-725 before being recorded: a literal ã becomes ã. One yardstick only, without a copy, and with the same limit: it only acts when there is a literal \uXXXX, so text without escapes — including code with a literal "\n" in a fenced block — comes back byte for byte. The streaming agent.delta is NOT decoded: an escape may arrive split between two deltas, and the recorded bubble replaces the in-progress text at the end of the turn. A rule of its own, and not a clause of RN-725, because the surface is different (model response, not a tool argument) and the decision about the delta is this one's. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/texto_do_turno.ex:65 (payload_do_turno), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:88 (decodificar_escapes) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/texto_do_turno_test.exs (happy: the five measured escapes, in the closing and in a step; intact: text without escapes and a code block with a literal \n) Origin: AT-417 (TP-01 of 10/03, 2nd round: the Criativo's final answer recorded with "colisão", "usuário" and three more escapes in the bubble)
documents.s: RN-732 — The turn's text goes through the same escape yardstick as the arguments

documents.t: Rule: the description of choose_project_image and its RESULT say that, with network none, no package manager (npm, pnpm, pip, mix, cargo, go mod...) installs a dependency in the container, and that the Infra inherits that network (RN-723). With none, the result asks the model to call the tool again with egress if the stack installs dependencies. It is a NOTICE, never a refusal: the api does not guess the stack, and the broker's containment (ADR 0130) does not change.
