documents.t: Rule: the api reads the stop reason in both dialects — finish_reason: "length" in OpenAI-compatible (OpenRouter included) and stop_reason: "max_tokens" in Anthropic — and, only when the answer was cut by the output ceiling (RN-734), returns truncated: true in the llm-turn response and in the final frame of llm-turn-stream (additive field; absent in the normal case). The engine notes the signal in the turn's process, on every LLM call: (a) the tool call of a cut answer is NOT executed — it goes back to the loop as a named error ("a resposta foi cortada pelo limite de tokens… Reenvie o argumento em partes menores"), which the model reads and fixes (RN-163); (b) the cut text closing gains, AFTER the model's text and without rewriting it, the line in the turn's language (RN-622, mold of RN-731): pt* "Resposta cortada pelo limite de tamanho.", any other — or none — "Response cut off by the length limit.". Ollama does not read the stop reason (out of scope, declared). Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.ts:257 (cortadaPeloTeto), apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/anthropic-provider.ts:198 (finalMessage), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/run-llm-turn.use-case.ts:204 (truncated), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/stream-llm-turn.use-case.ts:217 (truncated), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/resposta_cortada.ex:43 (registrar), :89 (descarregar), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:26 (executar), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/texto_do_turno.ex:65 (payload_do_turno) Test: apps/api/test/contract/llm-provider.contract.ts ("resposta cortada pelo teto de saída emite o sinal truncated" and "resposta normal não traz o sinal de corte", run with a fake server by the OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic harnesses), apps/engine/test/engine/harness/resposta_cortada_test.exs (a tool of a cut answer does not run and returns a named error; a normal answer runs; a cut closing gains the line in pt-BR without rewriting; a normal closing intact; pt/en) Origin: AT-423 (gap declared in RN-734)

documents.t: Rule: the reason recorded in the agent.error of the conversational agents, the Infra Lead and the ToolLoop (dev agent) is the TEXT of the final frame when there is one — never the inspected {:final, …} tuple; other shapes keep inspect/1. With the provider's credit exhausted (errorCode: insufficient_credit, RN-730, or the text recognition of RN-726), the bubble's mensagem is short and actionable in the turn's language (RN-622): pt "Crédito do provedor do modelo esgotado — recarregue a chave e tente de novo.", any other language "The model provider's credit is exhausted — top up the key and try again."; with no resolved language, pt-BR. The provider's JSON stays only in the reason (diagnosis). The other errors keep the usual sentence. documents.t: Rule: every chat call through the /chat/completions dialect (the providers born from OpenAICompatibleProvider, OpenRouter included) carries the output ceiling field — max_tokens or max_completion_tokens, according to maxTokensField — even when the caller does not set maxTokens. Without a setting, the value is MAX_TOKENS_PADRAO (4096), the SAME DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS as anthropic-provider.ts, so the agent has the same ceiling in both dialects. The reason is the credit RESERVATION: without the field, OpenRouter reserves per call the model's MAXIMUM output and refuses with 402 ("would exceed your available credits given your current in-flight requests") with a balance that would cover the real call. Today no caller (engine → llm-turn) sets maxTokens, so the default applies to all agents. An answer cut by the ceiling (finish_reason: "length") is read and narrated since RN-737 (RN-698 narrates the ITERATION ceiling, not the token one). Hypothesis NOT measured with a real key: that the reservation explains TP-01's 402. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.ts:38 (MAX_TOKENS_PADRAO), :484 (flags) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.contract.spec.ts (without maxTokens the body carries max_tokens: 4096; with maxTokens: 123 it carries 123; with maxTokensField: 'max_completion_tokens' the field changes and max_tokens does not go) Origin: AT-419 (TP-01 of 10/03: US$ 1.79 free and a 402 on the Dev Lead's call and on the dev agent's)
documents.s: RN-734 — The OpenAI-compatible path ALWAYS sends the output ceiling

documents.t: Rule: every project container starts with --init — a CONSTANT of the docker run composition in DockerViaCli, never a spec field (the containment is the type, ADR 0130); it applies to the broker and to the runner, which use the same port. The wait command (sleep infinity) was PID 1 with no SIGTERM handler, and the kernel does not deliver a default-action signal to PID 1: docker stop waited the 10 s and killed (Exited (137)). Measured in a disposable container: 10.25 s without --init, 0.20 s with. On the /containers page, deciding the pending action (approve, deny, always allow) invalidates ['containers-overview'] and ['container-lifecycle', projectId] in the finally — also when the call fails or drops —, and returns the promise to the card. No new poll (RN-579/632). Where: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.ts:637 (argsDeCriacao), apps/web/src/routes/ContainersPage.tsx:72 (invalidateContainers), :183 (aprovar) Test: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.spec.ts (run carries --init before the command), apps/broker/src/contencao-do-brabo.spec.ts (both modes start with --init), apps/web/src/routes/ContainersPage.test.tsx (approving rereads overview and lifecycle; a refused approval still rereads) Origin: AT-422 (local installation, 10/03: three executed stops with the row in "rodando" and Exited (137))
documents.s: RN-738 — Stopping a project container is immediate, and the /containers row rereads on deciding

documents.t: Rule: the message of the normalized provider error (ADR 0041) carries the error body up to LIMITE_DO_DETALHE = 4,000 characters (it was 200, and cut OpenRouter's JSON before metadata.reason, which states the nature of the error). That message is the text of the final frame and becomes, verbatim, the reason of agent.error (FalhaDeTurno.diagnostico/1, RN-733). The bubble's sentence does NOT grow with it: outside the credit case (which already has a short sentence), the narrated text enters the bubble cut at 300 characters with "…". Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/llm-provider-errors.ts:159 (LIMITE_DO_DETALHE), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:284 (@teto_da_bolha), :286 (curto) Test: apps/api/test/domain/llm/llm-provider-errors.spec.ts (the 402 carries "metadata":{"reason":"insufficient_credits" whole; a body above the ceiling is cut), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/falha_de_turno_test.exs (RN-739: the reason contains the metadata; a long error is cut in the bubble and not in the diagnosis) Origin: AT-424 (TP-01, 3rd round, 10/03: reason cut at …"code":402,"metadata":{"reason":"in…)
documents.s: RN-739 — The diagnosis carries the provider's whole error body, and the bubble stays short

documents.t: Rule: when the binding's model reasons (models.supports_reasoning, from the catalog), the LLM use cases send reasoning: true to the provider. A provider with campoDeRaciocinio configured (today only OpenRouter) sends an EXPLICIT reasoning budget — reasoning: { max_tokens: ORCAMENTO_DE_RACIOCINIO }, 4096 — and the call's max_tokens becomes the visible output (the RN-734 ceiling) PLUS that budget, so the text and the tool call keep their ceiling. Reasoning is never switched off (exclude/enabled: false are not sent). A model without reasoning, and a provider without the configuration, send the previous body, byte for byte. The direct anthropic-provider does not send thinking, so the model does not reason through it and the hole does not exist — declared, without change. The field's shape was read from OpenRouter's doc (Reasoning Tokens: reasoning.max_tokens; the call's max_tokens has to be greater than it). Revised by RN-782/RN-783 (AT-467): the measurement with a credential on 10/10 showed that Haiku 5.5 IGNORES reasoning.max_tokens; the field stopped being sent and the slack in max_tokens remained. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.ts:48 (ORCAMENTO_DE_RACIOCINIO), :490 (controla) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.contract.spec.ts (raciocínio com orçamento próprio (RN-741): budget and summed ceiling; without reasoning the body does not change; a provider without the field does not invent a budget) Origin: AT-427 (TP-01, 10/08: anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 with output_tokens = reasoning_tokens = 4096 in two consecutive PO calls)
documents.s: RN-741 — Reasoning has its own budget and does not eat the visible output

documents.t: Rule: revises the "own interaction" count of RN-680/RN-722. Only these count toward making someone a subject of the round: (a) an actor_kind: "user" event of the member themselves whose type is in tipos_de_evento_com_conteudo/0 — chat.message (a message written by them) and chat.structured_question_answered — and (b) an action decision with a written refusal reason (non-empty rejectionReason, a correction). Approval, handoff acceptance, a click and any other user event do NOT count: they are not evidence of competence. The floor of 5 (RN-722), the daily ceiling and the no-subject outcome (reason in the log; anamnese.run_skipped only in a manually requested round) do not change, and triage stays LOCAL, before the LLM and the RAG. Code: apps/engine/lib/engine/anamnese/elegibilidade.ex:61 (avaliar), :102 (recusa_com_motivo?), :108 (tipos_de_evento_com_conteudo) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/anamnese/elegibilidade_test.exs (só interação com conteúdo técnico conta (RN-756, AT-439): a message and a structured answer make a subject; only approvals, handoff and refusal without a reason do not) Origin: AT-439 (TP-01, 10/08, project c1dc053d: two rounds during execution, US$ 0.20, both skip_proficiency with "o usuário apenas aprovou propostas")
documents.s: RN-756 — The Anamnese only runs with the subject's technical-content interaction; approving does not count

documents.t: Rule: every non-streamed HTTP call from the engine to the api (post_returning/3 and the GETs of EngineApiClient.Live) runs in a disposable Task; a response that arrives after the receive_timeout lands in a process that has already ended, never in the caller's mailbox, and an exception inside the request comes back as {:error, _}. And a dev agent that CRASHES (an exit that is neither :normal nor :shutdown) is not treated as finished: Engine.Dev.Monitor records a DURABLE agent.error with origin infra (reason: processo_do_dev_caiu, religado, taskId) and RESTARTS it from its own dev_agent_states row, up to 3 times per agent; the resume goes through the handle_continue({:restart_recovery, _}) that already existed, which blocks the interrupted task with a diagnosis (origin infra) and tries the next claim. Without a row, or at the ceiling, the row is removed and the error says there was no restart. llm_turn_stream/6 stays out of the isolation (the into: writes into the caller's dictionary); the conversational agents already call it from inside the turn's Task (TurnoAssincrono), so the "HTTP inside the GenServer" pattern does not reach them — declared. The web did not change: the Executores tab now sees the recovery's agent.error and dev.blocked. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/engine_api_client.ex:2073 (isolado), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/monitor.ex:69 (ao_terminar), :107 (registrar_e_religar) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/sessions/engine_api_client_isolado_test.exs (a late message does not reach the caller; an exception becomes {:error, _}), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/monitor_test.exs (a crash records an infra agent.error and restarts; :normal deletes the row; without a row it does not restart) Origin: AT-428 (10/08: CaseClauseError in Finch.HTTP1.Conn.receive_response/8 after the npm install timeout)
documents.s: RN-742 — The dev agent does not die silently, and a late HTTP response does not stay in its mailbox

documents.t: Rule: before blocking a task (any origin, including the taskBudgetMicros budget ceiling, whose VALUE does not change here), what the dev agent left in the worktree becomes a commit on the task's own branch, with the identity <agente>[bot] (git add -A + commit --no-verify). The dev.blocked carries trabalhoPreservado ({branch, commit} or null) and the diagnosis STATES where the work was left — or that it could not be preserved, with the reason; a failure to preserve never prevents the block. The SAME agent's next task (therefore, of the same module) is born from that branch (create_from/4) instead of dev, once only. A clean worktree produces no commit. Declared: the pointer lives only in memory (an engine restart loses the pointer, not the commit), and in runner mode the worktree is on the user's machine and the engine preserves nothing. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:72 (preservar_em), :55 (create_from), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:491 (preservar_trabalho), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:321 (base_preservada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/worktree_manager_test.exs (preservar_em/3 e create_from/4: commit with dev-api[bot] and the next task sees the file; clean is :nada; a folder without a repository is an error), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/bloqueio_preserva_trabalho_test.exs (the dev.blocked states the branch; a failure to preserve does not prevent the block) Origin: AT-429 (10/08: feature/task-86dade03 without a commit, package.json and src lost after the budget block)
documents.s: RN-743 — Blocking the task preserves the worktree's work, and the next one starts from it

documents.t: Rule: the terminal tool's description says the container's shell is sh (dash), not bash — no brace expansion, no [[ ]], no arrays, no source — and gives the form that works. Each dev agent task's kickoff gets a second pinned message with the worktree's SNAPSHOT: the branch and the files that already exist (tracked + untracked not ignored), with a ceiling of 80 lines and the real total when it cuts (ADR 0060); it is the server that assembles it, with no parameter from the model. A folder the engine cannot reach (runner mode) says that the snapshot is unavailable and says to list through terminal. Declared and NOT fixed: the dev's worktree may be born before the infra PR's merge, so what the Infra delivered through a PR may not be on the dev it starts from. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/terminal.ex:12 (spec), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:108 (retrato), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:595 (retrato_do_worktree) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/worktree_manager_test.exs (retrato/2: branch and files; an unreachable folder says unavailable; the terminal description says sh) Origin: AT-444 (TP-01 of 10/08: mkdir -p src/{a,b} in dash and the dev recreating what already existed)
documents.s: RN-744 — The dev knows the shell is sh and starts by seeing its own worktree

documents.t: Rule: when the model's answer comes cut by the output ceiling (truncated: true, RN-737), only the LAST tool call of the answer is treated as incomplete and refused with the named error (which now says "the last one of the answer", that the earlier ones were executed and asks for "one per call"). The earlier calls of the same answer execute normally — measured in the code: the OpenAI-compatible stream assembles the calls in order, the cut falls on the last one, and the api's parseArgumentos returns {} for the broken JSON. The call is identified by name and arguments. A cut answer without a known call still refuses every tool (RN-737's yardstick). The description of propose_adr steers one ADR per answer. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/resposta_cortada.ex:44 (registrar), :64 (incompleta?), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:26 (executar), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/propose_adr.ex:27 (spec) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/resposta_cortada_test.exs ("só a última chamada da resposta cortada é recusada; as completas executam"; "ferramenta de resposta cortada NÃO executa", without a known call) Origin: AT-430 (10/08: the Arquiteto sent 5 propose_adr in a cut answer and all five were refused; 0 ADRs)
documents.s: RN-745 — In a cut answer, only the incomplete call is refused

documents.t: Rule: the factual line "Gravado neste turno: …" of RN-731 now counts the Arquiteto's writes (proposed ADR, module map, module assignment, decided image, C4 diagram, routing to infra, module contract, insight), the Staff's RFC and the UX Designer's prototype, and counts separately the refused WRITE calls ({:error, _}) of the turn: "…; N chamadas de escrita recusadas". A turn that tried to write and recorded nothing closes with "Gravado neste turno: nada; N chamadas de escrita recusadas." (en: "Recorded this turn: nothing; N write calls refused."). The Criativo now notes refusals too; Staff and UX Designer now note them. A read never counts. The model's text is not rewritten (RN-163: the agent does not announce as done what the server refused — the reader sees the fact next to it). Out, declared: Dev Lead (the plan suspends the turn, RN-284) and Infra Lead. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/gravado_no_turno.ex:77 (anotar), :96 (descarregar), :141 (classe), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/arquiteto_server.ex:323 (dispatch_tool) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/gravado_no_turno_test.exs ("Arquiteto com as cinco propose_adr recusadas fecha com nada gravado"; "escritas do Arquiteto contadas, leitura e ferramenta desconhecida não") Origin: AT-431 (10/08: with the 5 propose_adr ok: false, the Arquiteto closed with "✅ ADRs Propostas (5 decisões críticas)" and no factual line)
documents.s: RN-746 — The Arquiteto's closing states what it recorded, and refused writes are counted

documents.t: Rule: approving propose_execution_plan activates execution (RN-677), and the activation starts ONE dev agent per module; the plan's per-module agentes is a recommendation. The approval card says "sobe N dev agent(s), um por módulo" and, when the plan asks for more than that, that the extra agents only start if the user accepts parallelizing later — parallelizing is an RN-154 ceiling and is never auto-approved nor bundled into the plan approval. The tool result that goes back to the Dev Lead says the same, and the description of agentes asks not to promise a parallelism gain. The model's quote marks at the ends of the summary are removed before the sentence cites it, so no coberto." is left over. Where: apps/web/src/lib/aprovacoes.ts:317 (propose_execution_plan), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools.ex:254 (sobem), :245 (classificar), :97 (spec) Test: apps/web/src/lib/aprovacoes.test.ts ("plano com 2 agentes num módulo único diz que sobe 1…"; "plano sem agente a mais não fala de paralelizar"), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools_test.exs ("agente a mais no plano é dito como NÃO subindo") Origin: AT-437 (10/08: the approved plan promised "2 agentes no módulo único… ~40% de ganho" and execution started 1 dev)
documents.s: RN-747 — The Dev Lead's plan says how many dev agents start, not how many it asks for

documents.t: Rule: when the agent suspends the turn waiting for human approval (agent.status: awaiting_approval, today the Dev Lead in propose_execution_plan, RN-284), the Session screen treats that as END of turn also through the CHANNEL — not only through the log read (turnoTerminouNoLog, which already did): the activity strip leaves, and with it "Pôr na fila" and "Parar". And, when a NEW wait appears in the log (the seq of the most recent wait changes after opening), the thread scrolls to the end WITHOUT the 120px guard of RN-173, because the approval card is what the person needs to see. Reopening the session with an old wait scrolls nothing beyond the usual opening. Where: apps/web/src/lib/session-channel.ts:232 (awaiting_approval), apps/web/src/lib/session-turno.ts:418 (awaiting_approval), apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem.ts:30 (seqDaEsperaPorAprovacao), :141 (esperaPorAprovacao) Test: apps/web/src/lib/session-channel.test.ts (onAgentStatus repassa awaiting_approval (RN-748)), apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem.test.ts (seqDaEsperaPorAprovacao (RN-748): most recent wait; without a wait, null) Origin: AT-432 (TP-01: the Dev Lead in awaiting_approval with the "Montando o plano de execução" strip active and the card out of view)
documents.s: RN-748 — Waiting for approval closes the turn strip and brings the card into view

documents.t: Rule: the agent bubble whose closing ends with the line the engine appends to an answer cut by the output ceiling (RN-737, in both languages) shows, with the session active, the "Continuar de onde parou" button. The click sends to the SAME agent the text "Continue de onde parou." (in the interface language) through the same send as the composer — with a turn in progress, it enters its queue (RN-673) —, and the draft the person is writing is not touched. Only the closing has the button; the turn steps do not. The screen recognizes the line by the text, and the two sentences are the contract with Engine.Harness.RespostaCortada. Where: apps/web/src/lib/resposta-cortada.ts:14 (respostaCortada), apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:889 (respostaCortada), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.tsx:447 (continuarRespostaCortada), :686 (enviarMensagem) Test: apps/web/src/lib/resposta-cortada.test.ts (respostaCortada (RN-749): both lines recognized; a whole answer and the sentence in the middle of the text are not) Origin: AT-434 (TP-01: the cut answer offered no action, and the user had to guess "continue")
documents.s: RN-749 — An answer cut by the ceiling offers continuation in one click

documents.t: Rule: the per-agent message collapse after it passes the baton (RN-138) never folds that agent's LAST message in the thread — the closing, which in the handoff is the summary the person just read. What came before it in the same sequence is folded, and only with two or more entries (a single one does not become a header, RN-138's usual yardstick). Earlier sequences of the same agent, separated by another utterance, collapse as before. The thread's cut (RN-644) does not change: it runs over the already grouped list. Where: apps/web/src/routes/session-fio.tsx:155 (fechoDeCadaAgente), :181 (fechoPorAgente), :190 (indiceDoFecho) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.handoff-devlead-e-colapso.test.tsx (duas mensagens consecutivas do PO colapsam...: two folded and the closing open; RN-750: com duas mensagens, o fecho fica aberto e a outra, sozinha, não vira grupo) Origin: AT-435 (TP-01: at handoff the thread folded the Criativo's whole answer, "Criativo · 2 mensagens", hiding the summary)
documents.s: RN-750 — The per-agent collapse leaves each agent's closing open

documents.t: Rule: four layout fixes, each a screen rule. (1) The composer does not squeeze the field during the turn: the buttons do not shrink nor wrap text, and move down a line when they do not fit. (2) Without the project frame mounted, the tab the sidebar marks is the one the ROUTE implies — on the Session screen, Chat —, and only outside that the default. (3) The model catalog's batch action bar OVERLAYS the list, pinned to the bottom of the window, and the section gets breathing room at the end while it is open; inserted in the flow, it pushed the list and the checkbox ran away from the cursor. (4) The thread "follows the end" (RN-173) also when the person WAS at the end before the height changed — the intent is measured on the scroll gesture, and a clamped scroll with content smaller than the window does not change it. The 120px guard remains: whoever scrolled up is not dragged. The cause of the top on accepting the Infra's handoff was not reproduced in the browser; the fix covers the class (content that shrinks and comes back). Where: apps/web/src/routes/project-tabs.ts:383 (abaDaRota), apps/web/src/routes/Shell.tsx:510 (abaDaRota), apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem.ts:16 (estaPertoDoFim), :82 (estavaNoFimRef), :120 (aoRolarOFio), apps/web/src/components/ModelCatalogSection.module.css (.barraDeLote), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.module.css (.composer) Test: apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem-fim.test.ts (estaPertoDoFim and abaDaRota: happy path and failure), apps/web/src/routes/Shell.test.tsx (sem a moldura montada (ex.: tela de Sessão): Chat marked), apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.ordenacao-e-avisos.test.tsx (não arrasta quem rolou pra cima) Origin: AT-442 (TP-01, visual survey)
documents.s: RN-751 — The Session and the catalog do not jump: composer, active tab, batch bar and scrolling

documents.t: Rule: the GET .../infra-artifacts read (the "PRs de infra em revisão" section of the Aprovações tab) does not return the infra artifact whose PR has already been merged. The artifact's gate ends in awaiting_user and nothing moves it after the merge; instead of a new column, the yardstick is DERIVED: the artifact's PR is the pullRequestId of the result of the open_infra_pr that opened it (prActionId), and it is merged when an executed git_merge of the project returned state: 'merged' for that id — the same matching by pullRequestId that closes the tasks (RN-628). A merge that failed or is still pending removes nothing from the list. The "infra PR ready to merge" notice in the thread or in the "needs you" panel was NOT done here. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/list-infra-artifacts.use-case.ts:26 (execute) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/list-infra-artifacts.use-case.spec.ts (an executed merge removes the PR; a failed or pending merge keeps it) Origin: AT-436 (TP-01: after "Merge" → "Aprovar" in the PRs tab, the PR stayed with Dev ✓ QA ✓ SecOps ✓ and "Você" pending)
documents.s: RN-752 — A merged infra PR leaves "PRs de infra em revisão"

documents.t: Rule: in the ApprovalCard (the same on the four surfaces), the "Modo automático" button records the agent's wildcard (RN-153) and does NOT decide the card's own action: it stays pending, with "Aprovar" as the main action. Wherever the button appears, a note appears with it saying so before the click ("Ligar o modo automático não aprova esta ação: ela continua esperando o seu Aprovar."). Approving the card along with switching on the mode would be the owner's decision and was NOT done. Where: apps/web/src/components/ApprovalCard.tsx:203 (ApprovalCard) Test: apps/web/src/components/ApprovalCard.test.tsx (ligar o "Modo automático" não aprova o card, e o card diz isso; without the button, the note does not appear) Origin: AT-443 (TP-01: the mode switched on in a pending card did not approve it, and nothing on screen said why)
documents.s: RN-755 — Switching on auto mode does not approve the card where it was switched on

documents.t: Rule: the terminal action the api auto-approves is EXECUTED inside the same propose_action request (api → engine /internal/actions/execute → api container-exec → broker), and the engine waits for that request for TERMINAL_ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS + 120 s — not for the Req default of 15 s. The command ceiling (TERMINAL_ACTION_TIMEOUT_MS) goes from 15 s to 120 s in the three composes and in runtime.exs. The chain becomes broker (T) < api → broker (T + up to 45 s, RN-604) < engine → container-exec (T + 90 s) < engine → propose_action (T + 120 s), and with T = 120 s the outer hop (240 s) stays below the 300 s of headers of Node's fetch. If the wait still overflows, the model receives NAMED text — the ceiling in seconds, that the process may keep running and the suggestion of nohup … & with a log —, never a raw %Req.TransportError{reason: :timeout}. Asynchronous/streaming exec was considered and not done: the smallest change that makes a common npm install fit is the ceiling. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/engine_api_client.ex:1919 (opcoes_do_propose_action) and apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/hooks/action_pipeline.ex:80 (resultado_de_teto_do_terminal) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/sessions/engine_api_client_propose_terminal_test.exs (a fake api that takes 16 s is still waited for; order of the ceilings below 300 s; the overflow text names the ceiling) Origin: AT-440 (TP-01 of 10/08: npm install 2>&1 | tail -50 in a node:22-bookworm-slim container came back "falha no pipeline: %Req.TransportError{reason: :timeout}"; measured on this machine, the same npm install of bcrypt+sqlite3+express took 5.3 s with the image in cache and prebuilds available — the chain, not the command, cut at 15 s)
documents.s: RN-757 — The auto-approved terminal waits for the command, and the command ceiling is 2 min

documents.t: Rule: when the Jev cuts the step's menu (RN-625, P3), the menu gets back the agent's FLOOR: for the PO, create_story and create_task; for the Arquiteto, create_module_map, route_modules_to_infra, declare_module_contracts, propose_adr and create_c4_diagram. Only what is in that step's catalog enters — the floor never adds a tool the agent did not have, and on every fallback the whole catalog goes on as before. The floor is STATIC per agent, and that is declared: the api has no cheap signal of which obligation is pending at that step, so it applies whenever there is a cut. The dev agents stay without a floor, on purpose (their obligation changes at every step; for them only RN-759 applies) — except report_done/report_blocked, which enter their floor since RN-839. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:392 (menuComPiso) and apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.ts:248 (menuComPiso) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.spec.ts (the PO with the menu ["listar_backlog","create_story"] keeps create_task; the Arquiteto with 2 of 9 keeps the five artifact ones) Origin: AT-445 (TP-01 of 10/09: the PO without create_task replied "Não tenho uma ferramenta para criar tarefas" and closed with 8 stories without tasks; the Arquiteto with 2 of 9 closed without routing, contracts, ADR or C4)
documents.s: RN-758 — The Jev's cut never removes the agent's obligation tool

documents.t: Rule: when the Jev's cut is applied (aplicado: true), the call to the provider for THAT step carries, at the end, an EPHEMERAL system message that says how many and which tools the step received, that the others remain available in the next rounds and that the agent must not conclude that it lacks a tool nor end the turn waiting for it. It never enters the agent's history nor the event log, and does not exist without a cut nor on fallback. It is assembled in the api, and not in the engine's facade like RN-622, because only the api knows the menu after the Jev. Not applying the cut on the round that closes the turn was evaluated and not done: the api does not know before the answer that the round will be the last. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:411 (avisoDeRecorte) and apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.ts:263 (avisoDeRecorte) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.spec.ts (the notice arrives as the last message with a cut; without a cut and on fallback, the messages are the request's) Origin: AT-445 (the dev agent blocked a task "sem ferramenta para editar arquivos" while having write_file)
documents.s: RN-759 — The cut step tells the model that the menu is a cut

documents.t: Rule: in the "needs you" panel (RN-467), the pending action proposed by a GATE agent (QA area — qa, qa-* — or SecOps) gets, above the SAME ApprovalCard, the sentence that that gate is STOPPED until the decision; it is one sentence per card, never a sum of queues. And the auto mode batch offer in the Executores tab (RN-661) lists the agents of the QA area (AREAS.qa) from activation, without waiting for them to appear in the roster — before, qa-automacao only entered the offer after its first event, when the first action was already waiting for a click. The default allow of permissions.json does NOT change (owner decision). Where: apps/web/src/lib/precisa-de-voce.ts:256 (gateEsperandoClique) and apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.tsx:63 (agentesDaOfertaEmLote) Test: apps/web/src/lib/precisa-de-voce.test.ts (QA and SecOps gates named; dev agent and human not) and apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.test.tsx (the offer covers the QA subagents before the roster, without repeating) Origin: AT-449 (TP-01 of 10/09: qa-automacao proposed ls; cat; for f in test/*.js…, a segment outside the allow, without auto mode, and stayed pending for 25 min with only the Aprovações counter as a signal)
documents.s: RN-766 — The gate stopped waiting for a click is stated, and the batch offer covers the QA subagents

documents.t: Rule: QA-strategy (test plan, RN-674) and QA-automation receive, besides the story, the task's CUT: title and description, the story's business rules and the OTHER tasks of the same story with their status (siblingTasks in GET .../dev-context). The verdict is about what belongs to THIS task: a requirement that belongs to a sibling task (done or pending) does not fail it — it goes to resumo as an observation, outside itens, and does not prevent approved. The yardstick is PROMPT, not code: emit_qa_verdict still requires only a green suite to approve. Since AT-479, when the task description or a rule quantifies PER item ("por X", "cada", "de todos os" — "por exemplo"/"por padrão" do not count), the cut gains the section "Forma da resposta": check that the answer carries the value of EACH item, not only the total (the dashboard approved with only {totalCliques} over "a contagem… de todos os links"), and that the input refusal names the field — the latter is an OBSERVATION in resumo, outside itens, unless a rule requires it. It remains a prompt yardstick: no new failure in code. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:18 (texto), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:82 (secao_da_forma), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:195 (tarefasIrmas) and apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_automacao_agent.ex:170 apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:82 (secao_da_forma), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:195 (tarefasIrmas) and apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_automacao_agent.ex:204 (com_o_recorte) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs (since AT-479 also "regra que quantifica por item pede a conferência da forma da resposta" and the case without a quantifier) and apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts (the siblings without the task itself). The QA golden-set (ADR 0168) did NOT gain a case: it runs the real model, and proving the verdict without a paid call is not possible — declared. Origin: AT-448 (TP-01 of 10/09: the QA gate of the task "Modelar tabela de usuários e hash bcrypt" failed three times for "RF01: login HTTP com JWT não existe nesta entrega", which belongs to another task, and the task blocked; artifact.qa_verdict of tasks 42bea901 and 762833bd)
documents.s: RN-765 — The QA gate judges the TASK, and a sibling task's RF is an observation

documents.t: Rule: a pending gate remains a NOTICE and does not lock the merge (RN-663). A BLOCKED task (task.blocked) is something else and disables the button; in that case the PR row does NOT show "o merge segue disponível": it says, in text, that the merge is unavailable because the task is blocked (naming the pending gate, if any, or the block's reason). Without a session in the project, the same: the reason goes in text, never only in the title of the disabled button, which does not open in Chromium. Whether a blocked task should or should not lock the merge is the owner's question, not decided here. Where: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.tsx:276 (avisoDaLinha) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.test.tsx ("AT-451: tarefa bloqueada com gate pendente NÃO diz que o merge segue disponível") Origin: AT-451 (TP-01 of 10/09: "O merge segue disponível — a decisão é sua" next to a disabled "Merge")
documents.s: RN-768 — In the PRs tab, the text next to Merge tells the truth about the button

documents.t: Rule: "Encerrar" in a session with active execution (an execution.activated event in the window, or a dev-<modulo> among the activated ones of the whole session — the Dev Lead does not count, he plans before execution) opens a confirmation that says what stops: the session's agents stop immediately, the running command is cut, the turn in progress is not recorded, and a session with execution does not reopen (RN-650). Without execution, the click closes directly, as before. The closed-session sentence in the composer interpolates the TRANSLATED state (pontoDaSessao(...).rotuloKey), never the raw enum (closed). And that is guarded in CODE, not only in the locale: the vocabulary yardstick reads the JSONs, and the enum came in through interpolation at runtime; i18n-enum-cru.test.ts rejects t(…, { status: x.status }). Where: apps/web/src/routes/ConfirmarEncerramento.tsx:13 (useEncerrarComConfirmacao) and apps/web/src/routes/SessionComposer.tsx:473 (statusGenerico) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ConfirmarEncerramento.test.tsx (without execution it closes directly; with execution it only closes on confirming; cancelling does not close) and apps/web/src/lib/i18n-enum-cru.test.ts (it failed SessionComposer.tsx before the fix) Origin: AT-452 (TP-01 of 10/09: "Encerrar" closed the execution session in 3 s with the dev agent in the middle of an npm install, and the bar said "Sessão closed")
documents.s: RN-769 — Closing a session with active execution asks first, and the state appears translated

documents.t: Rule: (1) the ADR PR carries the agent's identity (<agente>[bot], otherwise arquiteto[bot]), like the infra one (RN-729) — the PRs tab stops saying "autor desconhecido"; (2) the Infra Lead's agent.response carries the final frame's modelName, like the other conversational agents — the bubble stops saying "modelo não registrado"; (3) the dev agent's PR title opens with the TASK and then the story (<tarefa> — <história>), so that three PRs of the same story do not look the same with the end cut off; (4) with active execution (the same predicate as RN-769), the session bar says "Execução" instead of the recorded kind (criativa, which does not change — RN-097) and the composer does not offer the Criativo before activation; (5) in the creation confirmation, each path segment is nowrap: wrapping only happens after the slash, never at the hyphen; (6) the Markdown table in the bubble has a floor of 12rem PER COLUMN and grows by fraction, with the container at min-content — with max-content it was as wide as the unwrapped text (measured in Chromium: 2,236px in a 708px bubble) and the last column vanished. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-adr-pr.use-case.ts:96 (openPullRequest); apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:1521 (gravar_texto_do_turno); apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:1164 (propose_pr); apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.ts:210 (agentesEmConversa) and apps/web/src/lib/session-kind.ts:69 (tipoDaSessao); apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.tsx:1122 (quebraPorSegmento); apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.tsx:139 (TabelaMarkdown) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-adr-pr.use-case.spec.ts, apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_server_test.exs ("agent.response carrega o nome do modelo"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs (happy flow), apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.test.ts, apps/web/src/lib/session-kind.test.ts, apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.test.tsx, apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.test.tsx Origin: AT-455 (TP-01 of 10/09, findings 2, 3, 8, 9, 16 and 18)
documents.s: RN-770 — Small things on the project screen: ADR PR author, Infra model, dev PR title, execution badge, path and table

documents.t: Rule: generalizes RN-743. On finishing a task — approved in the gates (nextAction: "done") or blocked for ANY reason, including the "ciclo de correção esgotado (gate)" that the api decides and reaches the engine only as gate_resolved —, the dev agent keeps its branch and the SAME agent's next task (therefore, of the same module) is born from that branch, and not from dev. What was left uncommitted in the worktree is preserved first, as in RN-743; the pointer recorded by block_task/4 is not overwritten. When the previous branch is already an ancestor of the local dev (merged), the next one starts from dev, which already contains it. WHEN the queue moves does not change: the next task is still claimed at the end of the gates, before the user's merge (owner decision). Declared: a squash merge on a remote does not leave the branch an ancestor of dev, so the next one keeps starting from it; the pointer still lives only in memory, and in runner mode the merge check does not run. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:296 (levar_branch_para_a_proxima), :324 (criar_worktree), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:199 (ja_mergeada_volta_ao_trabalho) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/bloqueio_preserva_trabalho_test.exs (levar_branch_para_a_proxima/1 e criar_worktree/2: approved carries the branch to the next one; the block's pointer is not overwritten), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/worktree_manager_test.exs (add_worktree/4 com a branch da task anterior: not merged starts from it, merged starts from dev) Origin: AT-447 (TP-01 of 10/09: tasks 762833bd and 5ebad64b — the second was born from dev without the first's login route, and QA failed it)
documents.s: RN-760 — The dev agent's next task starts from its last not-yet-merged branch

documents.t: Rule: three layers, with the SAME list of directories (node_modules, deps, _build, .venv, venv, __pycache__, vendor, target): the repository bootstrap (the three providers and adoption) gets the commit_gitignore step, which commits a base .gitignore to main BEFORE dev is born, so every working branch inherits it. It is the single point because it is through it that EVERY created or adopted repository passes, before any agent writes; the Infra through the module_map would arrive after the dev's first commit and only in the projects that go through it. The step only CREATES the file: an already existing .gitignore, even a different one, is the user's and does not enter the plan; the dev agent's commit (git_commit) and the commit that preserves the worktree on blocking (RN-743) stage everything EXCEPT those directories, at any depth (pathspec :(exclude,glob)), even without a .gitignore; the SecOps gate flags, as a finding (changes_requested), a directory from the list that appears in the PR's diff, with the file count. The two copies of the list (api and engine) are checked by test. Declared: a dependency file ALREADY tracked before this rule is not removed by the commit (the exclusion does not stage removal); an already bootstrapped project only gets the .gitignore if the bootstrap runs again; in runner mode the commit runs through the same GitExecutor and the same exclusion applies where the engine runs git. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/git/bootstrap-templates.ts:28 (gitignoreContent), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/git/bootstrap-steps.ts:164 (soSeAusente), apps/engine/lib/engine/actions/diretorios_de_dependencia.ex:20 (argumentos_do_add), :28 (commitados), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/secops_agent_server.ex:162 (dependencias_commitadas) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/git/bootstrap-plan.spec.ts (the empty repository plans the 3 files; the user's .gitignore does not enter the plan), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/git/provision-repository.use-case.spec.ts (the local one converges the 6 steps), apps/engine/test/engine/actions/git_executor_test.exs (commit exclui diretórios de dependência mesmo sem .gitignore), apps/engine/test/engine/actions/diretorios_de_dependencia_test.exs (the list is the same as the api's; SecOps flags node_modules) Origin: AT-446 (TP-01 of 10/09: a PR with 1,453 files, 1,437 in node_modules/, approved by QA and SecOps)
documents.s: RN-761 — An installed dependency does not enter the repository: base .gitignore, a commit that excludes it and a gate that flags it

documents.t: Rule: when the gate exhausts the correction ceiling (maxGateCorrections) and the task is blocked with "ciclo de correção esgotado (gate)", the backlog.task_blocked and the task row carry origin: "politica" — the ceiling is a configuration decision, not a real failure (ADR 0020 vocabulary, rule of RN-059). Before it came out origin: null. The infra artifact block for the same reason (infra.artifact_blocked) has no origin field and stays as it is, declared. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.ts:215 (politica) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.spec.ts (the exhausted cycle calls MarkTaskBlockedUseCase with 'politica'; an approved verdict does not block) Origin: AT-450 (TP-01 of 10/09: backlog.task_blocked with origin: null)
documents.s: RN-762 — The block for an exhausted correction cycle records origin politica

documents.t: Rule: closing the session (session.closed/closed_abnormally, through SessionLifecycleWorker, the point every closing goes through) STOPS its dev agents on all nodes and the project's gates (QA lead and SecOps) — the yardstick that already applied to the conversational agents (RN-581). The process is brought down immediately, without recording the turn in progress, and Engine.Dev.Monitor is warned first (esquecer/1): the durable row is removed and the agent is NOT restarted (RN-742). For each dev with a task in progress (working, awaiting_approval or awaiting_gate), the worktree's work becomes a commit on the task's branch (RN-743) and the task is BLOCKED with reason "sessão de execução encerrada", origin politica, and the diagnosis saying where the work was left — it goes back to the queue when a human releases it, never lost. The session's gate_states rows are removed, so the GateRescuer does not reopen a cycle of the closed session. The Executores tab gets "Parar execução" (role developer, that of closing a session), whose mechanism is the SAME closing (closing → closed), without a new state; the confirmation says before the click what remains: the tasks in progress (with the count), the open PRs, the pending approvals and that the session does not reopen. Declared: a dev agent's pending action stays pending; an open PR stays open; a session with execution.activated does not reopen (RN-650), so resuming means activating execution in a new session; the confirmation's task count comes from the tab's event window. The confirmation on the session bar's "Encerrar" belongs to another activity (AT-452). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/encerramento_da_sessao.ex:40 (parar_da_sessao), :74 (parar_processos), :104 (devolver_task), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/monitor.ex:34 (esquecer), apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/session_lifecycle_worker.ex:94 (parar_execucao), apps/web/src/components/PararExecucao.tsx Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/encerramento_da_sessao_test.exs (the dev dies without being restarted, the row is removed, the task is blocked with origin politica; a session without a dev is a no-op and a dev of another session stays up), apps/web/src/components/PararExecucao.test.tsx (the confirmation says what remains and closes closing → closed; the api's refusal stays in the confirmation; without the role the button is inert with the reason) Origin: AT-456 (TP-01 of 10/09: with the execution session closed, the dev-encurtador-api blocked task 3, took 4 and opened a PR; the only brake was stopping the container)
documents.s: RN-763 — Closing the execution session stops the dev agents and the gates, and "Parar execução" in the Executores tab

documents.t: Rule: the Arquiteto has the read listar_adrs_propostas: the PROJECT's open_adr_pr actions, read now from proposed_actions (same Postgres, no HTTP in the loop), with each one's status — pending, approved, auto-approved, executed (with the PR URL), denied (with the reason) or failed. Contained (ADR 0060, RN-164): no parameter, scope closed to the context's project, one count and one query per call, the 20 most recent, and the real total stated when it cuts. A read failure is tool.result ok: false with the reason, never empty text. Since RN-784 it IS in the Jev's floor. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/listar_adrs_propostas.ex:37 (run), :40 (ler), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/arquiteto_server.ex:124 (ListarAdrsPropostas) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/listar_adrs_propostas_test.exs (approved appears approved, executed with the PR, denied with the reason, only those of the project; ceiling with the real total; no proposal; a failing read becomes a named error) Origin: AT-454 (TP-01 of 10/09, session 771131f4: with the 3 ADRs approved, the next closing said "As 3 ADRs seguem pendentes de aprovação")
documents.s: RN-772 — The Arquiteto reads the CURRENT status of the ADRs it proposed

documents.t: Rule: the Arquiteto gains the same listar_backlog as the PO (RN-164), with the task count per story. Its kickoff and the propose_adr result say that the ADRs' status and the tasks change outside the conversation and say to check both reads before asserting them, instead of the snapshot of an earlier result. No team flow is narrated here (RN-711). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/arquiteto_server.ex:125 (ListarBacklog), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/propose_adr.ex:94 (propor) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/listar_backlog_test.exs (the task count per story), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/arquiteto_server_test.exs (both reads are in the Arquiteto's catalog) Origin: AT-454 (TP-01 of 10/09: with 17 tasks in the backlog, the Arquiteto said "faltam as tarefas" and "não consigo verificá-las daqui")
documents.s: RN-773 — The Arquiteto reads the backlog, and checks before asserting state

documents.t: Rule: in the "Contexto da sessão" panel, "Decisões registradas" follows the same declared cut as the rules (RN-701): with events before the window, the counter says "N na janela · há mais antes" and the empty state says there may be decisions in the earlier ones, never "Nenhuma decisão registrada nesta sessão". In the Visão geral, the "Linha do tempo do time" reads the EXECUTION session when it exists (the same as the sidebar's) and says so in the subtitle when it is not the most recent. No extra request: the keys are the ones the sidebar already subscribes to, and useActiveExecutionSession gets a staleTime equal to the interval, so the second subscriber does not redo the fetch (RN-632). Where: apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:393 (trailing), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.tsx:86 (linhaDoTempoNaExecucao) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.painel-e-agrupamento.test.tsx (a decision outside the window does not become 0; a whole session in the window says empty), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.test.tsx (reads the execution session and says so; without execution, reads the most recent), apps/web/src/routes/duas-abas.orcamento.test.tsx (the Visão geral's load stays within the ceiling) Origin: AT-463 (TP-01 of 10/09)
documents.s: RN-788 — Decisions and the team timeline do not assert about what they did not read

documents.t: Rule: the Session screen publishes the tab that the session's TYPE implies — creative in "Criativo" (the list of ideations), consultative in "Chat" —, and the sidebar marks it instead of always "Chat" (RN-751); the click leads to the list where the session appears, which is the way back to it. A session still loading, or a tab published from another project, falls back to "Chat". No new read: the type already came with the session. Where: apps/web/src/routes/project-tabs.ts:383 (abaDaRota), apps/web/src/lib/session-kind.ts:94 (usePublicarAbaDaSessao) Test: apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem-fim.test.ts (creative marks "Criativo"; a tab from another project or an invalid one does not count) Origin: AT-463 (TP-01 of 10/09)
documents.s: RN-789 — On the Session screen, the sidebar marks the tab where the session is listed

documents.t: Rule: revises RN-741. A model with supportsReasoning (in OpenRouter, reasoning in supported_parameters — 341 of 478 models, that is, "accepts the parameter", not "reasons") keeps the SLACK in the ceiling: max_tokens = visible output (RN-734) + ORCAMENTO_DE_RACIOCINIO (4096). What goes away is the reasoning: { max_tokens } field: it is NO longer sent to any model. Paid measurement of 10/10 (AT-467): on anthropic/claude-haiku-4.5, which does not reason without the field, it SWITCHED ON reasoning in 74% of calls at 2.8× the cost; on anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5 it was IGNORED (asked for 1024, spent 8192 on reasoning alone). The decision of what to ask for lives in a single point, opcoesDeRaciocinio, called by the three turn use cases. RN-741's TODO(humano) closes with that measurement. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/raciocinio-do-agente.ts:18 (opcoesDeRaciocinio), apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.ts:490 (controla), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/run-llm-turn.use-case.ts:189 (opcoesDeRaciocinio) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.contract.spec.ts (modelo que raciocina: folga no teto e NENHUM campo de raciocínio (RN-782), body byte for byte), apps/api/test/domain/llm/raciocinio-do-agente.spec.ts Origin: AT-467 (paid measurement of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-782 — Accepting the reasoning parameter is not asking for reasoning

documents.t: Rule: owner decision of 10/10. For a dev-<modulo> agent (the Dev Lead, dev-lead, is conversational and stays out) with a supportsReasoning model, a provider that can say "off" (today only OpenRouter, campoDeRaciocinioDesligado) sends reasoning: { enabled: false }, keeping the slack of RN-782. Measured on Haiku 5.5: 0 of 8 answers cut and −42% cost. Conversational agents and gates do not change (no field), and a model without supportsReasoning sends nothing. It is not silent: the help of the model catalog's "thinking" facet says that in the execution dev agents and, since RN-838, in the Automação QA reasoning goes switched off (the chosen minimum; the selector and the bubble do not change). Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/raciocinio-do-agente.ts:23 (raciocinioDesligadoParaOAgente), apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/openrouter-provider.ts:224 (campoDeRaciocinioDesligadoOpenRouter) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/llm/openai-compatible-provider.contract.spec.ts (dev agent: raciocínio desligado explícito, com a folga (RN-783)), apps/api/test/domain/llm/raciocinio-do-agente.spec.ts (dev-* switches off; criativo and dev-lead only the slack; without supportsReasoning, nothing) Origin: AT-467 (owner decision of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-783 — The execution dev agents run with reasoning switched off

documents.t: Rule: revises RN-758 and RN-772 (owner decision). The Arquiteto's floor gains listar_adrs_propostas and listar_backlog: the Jev's cut never removes them, so the Arquiteto does not assert ADR status nor backlog tasks without being able to check them (RN-773). It still holds that the floor only gives back what is in the step's catalog. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:311 (PISO_DO_MENU) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.spec.ts (Arquiteto recortado pelo Jev: as leituras de estado (ADRs propostas, backlog) continuam no menu (RN-784)) Origin: AT-460 (TP-01 of 10/09: the Jev removed AT-454's reads from the Arquiteto's menu)
documents.s: RN-784 — The Arquiteto's state reads enter the Jev's floor

documents.t: Rule: before creating a task's worktree (first time or resumed), the engine runs git fetch origin in the project's working tree (serialized per project) — it is on the remote that PRs are merged, and the local dev only moved at the checkout of initialization. The tip of dev is origin/dev when the local one fell behind. The task is born: (1) from the previous task's unmerged branch (RN-760), (2) from its OWN branch when it has work that dev does not contain — the task resumed in a new process, which lost the in-memory pointer (RN-743) —, or (3) from the current tip of dev. In cases (1) and (2) the worktree INTEGRATES the tip of dev (merge --no-ff, identity <agente>[bot]) before the first step. A conflict in that integration is a NAMED refusal ("conflito ao integrar a dev atual", with the files), the merge is aborted, the source branch stays intact and the task blocks with its own reason and origin codigo. A failing fetch blocks the task with git's reason, never falls back to the old dev. Readoption after a merge conflict (RN-715) does not integrate on its own. Measured in TP-01: AT-447 FIRED on the 1st claim (reflog: Created from feature/task-b3cc92b8); what lost the base was the reclaim, which reset the branch to the LOCAL dev stuck at the infra merge (Reset to dev). Declared: in runner mode none of this runs (the git is the user's machine's). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:151 (atualizar_remoto), :195 (add_worktree), :227 (ponta_do_trabalho), :225 (retomada), :300 (integrar_trabalho) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/worktree_manager_test.exs (integração da dev atual (RN-779): resumed with an old branch starts from the remote's new dev; preserved work integrates the new dev; a previous one in awaiting_user is the base with dev integrated; a conflict is a named refusal) Origin: AT-458 (TP-01 of 10/09: feature/task-c80daf6c was born from 1fa2241 without the 12 tasks merged afterwards, and the merge conflicted)
documents.s: RN-779 — The worktree of the (re)claimed task starts from the CURRENT dev and integrates it

documents.t: Rule: in the ToolLoop (the path of every execution and gate agent), an answer without text and without a tool call that the api marks truncated: true (RN-737's finish_reason: length) is reasoning that ate the output ceiling. The round is retried ONCE, without the empty answer in the history and counting an iteration — the iteration ceiling and the task budget still apply. If it repeats, the loop stops marking corte_pelo_teto, and the dev agent blocks the task with the reason "resposta só de raciocínio, cortada pelo teto" and origin modelo, instead of "parou sem concluir nem reportar bloqueio". A tool call in between resets the retry. Declared: the engine receives from the api truncated and usage.outputTokens, but NOT the reasoningTokens (they stay only in token_usage), so an empty answer that hits the ceiling without finish_reason: length is not recognized. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tool_loop.ex:219 (parada_sem_chamada), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:1116 (motivo_da_parada), :1119 (stop_diagnosis) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tool_loop_test.exs (corte só de raciocínio: retried once and goes on; repeated stops with corte_pelo_teto), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs (resposta só de raciocínio cortada pelo teto bloqueia com motivo nomeado) Origin: AT-459 (TP-01 of 10/09: task c80daf6c blocked in 40 s with 8,192 output tokens, all of them reasoning)
documents.s: RN-780 — A reasoning-only answer cut by the ceiling is a cut, not giving up

documents.t: Rule: the report_done summary is the dev agent's commit message, and commit, push and PR are done by the system after it. Before proposing the git_commit, the engine cuts from the pending marker ("Pendente", "Pendência", "Pending") to the end when the rest speaks of commit, push or PR, and removes the parenthesis "(ainda sem commit…)"; a pending item that does not speak of that stays. The description of the summary field says it becomes the commit message and that commit, push and PR are not narrated. A summary that ends up empty falls back to the default message <agente>: <task>. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:374 (mensagem_de_commit), :373 (propose_commit), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/tools/report_done.ex:27 (summary) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/mensagem_de_commit_test.exs (cuts the narration; removes the parenthesis; a pending item unrelated to the system stays) Origin: AT-464 item 2 (TP-01 of 10/09: git log feature/task-9d6dcd53 with "Pendente: commit… as ações git_commit, git_push e pr_open não estavam disponíveis neste passo")
documents.s: RN-781 — The dev's commit message does not record a pending item that belongs to the system

documents.t: Rule: besides the sibling tasks (RN-765), the cut that QA-strategy and QA-automation receive brings the NOT concluded tasks of the OTHER stories of the same module, with the story's title (moduleOpenTasks in GET .../dev-context). The module is the task's, otherwise the requested one, otherwise the story's; an archived story stays out. A contained read (ADR 0060): at most 20, with the real total in moduleOpenTasksTotal and the cut stated in the cut. A delivery requirement that depends on what another story has yet to deliver (a route, a screen) goes to the resumo as an observation and does not fail it. The yardstick is PROMPT, as in RN-765. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:210 (tarefasAbertasDoModulo), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts (only the open task of the other story of the same module; archived out; ceiling with the real total) and apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs (the open tasks and the cut in the text). The QA golden-set did not gain a case (the verdict requires a paid call) — declared. Origin: AT-461 (TP-01 of 10/09, session 80e3ce09: the task "middleware JWT" was failed because "não há rotas de criar, listar, apagar links nem de painel no diff", routes of other stories not done yet)
documents.s: RN-785 — A requirement that depends on another story not yet done is an observation in the QA gate

documents.t: Rule: the cut that QA-strategy and QA-automation receive brings the CURRENT contract of the task's module (artifact.module_contracts, RN-684), in moduleContract of GET .../dev-context, as the source of the INTERFACE. The module is the task's, otherwise the requested one, otherwise the story's only one; a story with more than one module and a task without a module is ambiguous and goes without a contract. When the story and the contract diverge on an interface name (route, function, event), a delivery that follows the contract is not failed for that: the verdict names the DIVERGENCE in the resumo (story says X, contract says Y), for the user and the Arquiteto. A PROMPT yardstick, like RN-765. Since RN-792 the Arquiteto checks the contract against the routes cited in the stories when declaring it. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:255 (moduloDoContrato), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:66 Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:255 (moduloDoContrato), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:70 (secao_do_contrato) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts (the contract of the story's module; without a contract or with an ambiguous module, null) and apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs (the contract section with the divergence yardstick; without a contract, no section) Origin: AT-462 (TP-01 of 10/09, session 80e3ce09: the story asked for GET /painel, the contract declared GET /panel, the dev followed the contract and QA failed it by the story)
documents.s: RN-786 — The QA gate reads the module's contract, and a divergence with the story is an observation

documents.t: Rule: (1) the diff that QA and SecOps judge (dev...HEAD, RN-664) uses the NEWEST dev the working tree sees: with a local origin (a path on disk) the gate first runs git fetch origin dev, best effort, and between origin/dev and the local dev the one that contains the other wins. The clone's local dev does not move when the PR is merged at the origin, and the SecOps verdict counted the accumulation of the already merged tasks. With a remote origin there is no fetch in the gate (the credential belongs to Workspace) — declared. The semgrep and gitleaks keep scanning the whole worktree, not only the diff: narrowing what the scanner sees changes what the gate fails, and that is left to the owner. (2) itens and coverageMatrix of the QA verdict reach artifact.qa_verdict always as a LIST: a JSON string of a list is decoded (the mold of RN-719), and a string that is not a list becomes []. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/diff.ex:44 (base_mais_nova), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/hooks/termination.ex:46 (lista) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/diff_test.exs (task B born from A, with A merged at the origin: the diff is only B) and apps/engine/test/engine/gates/hooks/termination_test.exs (a JSON string becomes a list; a list intact; an invalid string becomes []) Origin: AT-464 items 1 and 3 (TP-01 of 10/09, session 80e3ce09: "17 arquivo(s) alterado(s) nesta PR" in a PR of 3 files against dev, and coverageMatrix/itens recorded as "[]" in the last verdicts)
documents.s: RN-787 — The gate counts the PR's diff against the origin's dev, and the QA verdict records a list

documents.t: Rule: the heartbeat does not close the project's CURRENT execution session (the most recent active one with execution.activated) while there is a non-archived story task that is BLOCKED, with a PR in awaiting_user, or returned by a merge conflict (RN-715, backlog.task_merge_conflict in this session) and still in_progress. It is the sixth signal of RN-064, without a ceiling, like the other signals that wait for a person; it comes before the idle conversation signal (RN-581), which remains the only one with a ceiling. An OLD execution session of the same project is not held by the task: the task belongs to the project, and without that cut it would be immortal. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-pending-work.use-case.ts:242 (findPendenteDaExecucao), apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/backlog.repository.ts:252 (findPendenteDaExecucao) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-pending-work.use-case.spec.ts (blocked, PR waiting for merge and conflict hold; with nothing, it closes; an old execution session is not held) Origin: AT-457 (TP-01 of 10/09: the two execution sessions closed 2–8 s after dev.idle, with a blocked task and a PR waiting for the merge)
documents.s: RN-776 — An execution task waiting for someone holds the execution session

documents.t: Rule: task.became_claimable with cause task_unblocked carries as modules the TASK's module (tasks.module, RN-678) when it exists, and the story's only when the task has no module — the claim is by the task's module, so it is its dev that has to wake. A merge conflict already wakes the owner (RN-715); with the execution session up (RN-776), the owner keeps a row in dev_agent_states to be woken. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/unblock-task.use-case.ts:68 (modules) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/unblock-task.use-case.spec.ts (a task with a module wakes that module's dev) Origin: AT-457
documents.s: RN-777 — Unblocking the task wakes the dev of ITS module

documents.t: Rule: at boot, for each non-terminal session, the dev agent whose last dev.* in the session is a waiting one (dev.working, dev.blocked, dev.idle_tripped and the others GetSessionPendingWorkUseCase counts) and that has NO row in dev_agent_states IN THIS session gets a dev.error with origin infra (reason: dev_agent_sem_processo) followed by dev.idle, which takes it out of the pending work yardstick (RN-064). It is the mold of RN-586 for the dev.* vocabulary: it never re-executes, never rewrites an event, and the durable row is the proof of ownership — with it the DevRehydrator restarts the agent, and closing it would be killing a healthy agent. It does not touch the task: a blocked task or one with a PR waiting for the merge keeps holding the current execution session through RN-776 (AT-457), which has a human owner. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_orfao.ex:49 (varrer), apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/rehydrator.ex:81 (varrer) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_orfao_test.exs (the orphan closes with infra dev.error + dev.idle; the one with a durable row and the one already idle do not; a failing read closes nothing) Origin: AT-465 (TP-01 of 10/09: session 63a4e1aa rescheduled by the heartbeat every 30 s by a dev.working without a process)
documents.s: RN-778 — The orphan dev agent closes through a new event at boot

documents.t: Rule: the PO's kickoff instruction says to include, in the DoD of the story that creates the application's entry point (server, CLI, configuration or persistence) — or in a story of its own —, the criterion "README diz como instalar, configurar (variáveis de ambiente obrigatórias e opcionais, com o padrão) e subir a aplicação, e como criar o primeiro acesso, quando houver". The dev agent fulfills the story's DoD, and the gate judges by it. A PROMPT yardstick, like RN-765: no tool refuses a story without that criterion. The other variant — the dev agent updating the README on every task that touches configuration/entry point — was NOT done: it would require classifying the task in AmbienteDoAgente or in report_done, a new code rule — declared. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:560 (kickoff_instruction) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:438 (the kickoff instruction carries the README criterion) Origin: AT-466 (TP-01 of 10/09: encurtador-api came out with a README only with npm test, without the mandatory JWT_SECRET, DB_PATH/PORT, npm start nor how to create the first member)
documents.s: RN-790 — The README on how to start the deliverable is a DoD criterion the PO writes

documents.t: Rule: after declare_module_contracts records the version (RN-684), the tool reads the project's backlog and extracts, deterministically and without an LLM, every MÉTODO /caminho (GET, POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE) from the title, description, RF and DoD of the non-archived stories, and the same pattern from the contract's assinaturas. A route cited by a story and absent from the UNION of the contract's routes (the front story cites the back route) comes back in the result as a DIVERGENCE, with what the contract declares for the same method — loop input (RN-163), for the Arquiteto to fix the contract or record the decision. Parameter (:id, {id}), trailing slash and query string are normalized; a ceiling of 10 lines, with the total. A failing backlog read does NOT refuse the declaration (already recorded): the result says it did not check. Left out, declared: a route only the contract declares (not a divergence), a story edited AFTER the declaration (only checked on the next one), and the contract following a route the DEV renamed (QA names the divergence in the verdict, RN-786, but nothing takes it back to the Arquiteto). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/rotas_do_contrato.ex:37 (divergencias), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/declare_module_contracts.ex:119 (conferencia_com_historias) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/declare_module_contracts_test.exs (GET /painel in the story × GET /panel in the contract flags; an equal route with normalized parameter and slash does not flag; an unreadable backlog says it did not check) Origin: AT-468 (TP-01 of 10/09: the story asked for GET /painel, the contract declared GET /panel, and nobody flagged it in the architecture)
documents.s: RN-792 — On declaring the contract, the Arquiteto receives the stories' routes that the contract does not declare

documents.t: Rule: when the read of the current execution session (RN-139) CONFIRMS there is none and the backlog has a task that is not done (todo — including one returned by the gate —, in_progress, in_review, blocked), the Executores tab and the Execução section of the Visão geral state how many there are and offer "Religar execução", which calls the SAME POST .../execution/activate (ActivateExecutionUseCase) as the "Ativar execução" button, without originSessionId (as the Visão geral always called it: there is no chat session for the api to close, RN-135). The refusal (409 without a repository, consultative session, role) appears with the api's sentence. "Desbloquear" without a current execution warns that the task only runs when execution is restarted — the button is in the same section. In the Executores tab the backlog is only read with the absence confirmed (query switched off with execution up, project pace when switched on, RN-632). Where: apps/web/src/components/ReligarExecucao.tsx:23 (ReligarExecucao), apps/web/src/lib/execution.ts:21 (contarTarefasPendentes), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectExecutorsTab.tsx:99 (semExecucaoVigente), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.tsx:506 (semExecucaoVigente) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectExecutorsTab.test.tsx (restart the execution), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.test.tsx (restart the closed execution) Origin: AT-469

documents.t: Rule: the Visão geral's "Linha do tempo do time" tree reads the EXECUTION session when there is a current one (AT-463), and takes from it the dev agent and QA events by the actor's FAMILY (isExecutorAgentId, the same yardstick as the Executores tab, RN-121) — never by the roster, which is derived from the most recent session. Filtering by the roster erased every agent that only acted in the execution (the Infra Lead whose handoff was accepted there), and with an ideation opened afterwards the tree said "Nenhum agente entrou em ação nesta sessão ainda" about a team working. No new read. Where: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.tsx:267 (overviewEvents) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.test.tsx ("AT-471: agente que só agiu na execução aparece na árvore…"; the case without execution keeps reading the most recent) Origin: AT-471 (TP-01 of 10/10)

documents.t: Rule: the "Nome (opcional)" field of the new session form (Criativo tab and Chat tab) receives the SAME SEM_AUTOFILL as the composer and the wizard (RN-736/RN-740): autocomplete="off", aria-autocomplete="none" and the ignores of 1Password, LastPass, Bitwarden and Proton Pass. The Session composer already had it. The constant has NO NordPass ignore attribute, and none was invented: if NordPass keeps attaching itself, the rest of the gap is the extension's, as in RN-740.
