documents.s: RN-801 — The new session's name does not invite the password manager

documents.t: Rule: the item gitleaks puts in the SecOps verdict carries, besides the path and the line, the rule that flagged it (RuleID) and the flagged excerpt (Match) with the secret (Secret) replaced by *** — never the secret in clear. Without the Secret to mask, the excerpt does not go in. And the execution agent's environment (RN-706) says in one line that a test password, token or key is generated at runtime, never as a literal. No new allowlist. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/actions/gitleaks_detector.ex:121 (mensagem), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/ambiente_do_agente.ex:102 (montar) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/actions/gitleaks_relatorio_test.exs, apps/engine/test/engine/harness/ambiente_do_agente_test.exs Origin: AT-470
documents.s: RN-796 — The gitleaks item states the rule and the excerpt with the secret masked

documents.t: Rule: on report_done, before proposing commit, push and PR, the dev agent asks whether the worktree's branch carries something dev does not have: a clean tree and git diff --quiet <ponta da dev>...HEAD with no difference. It is the case of the reintegrated task (RN-779) whose code already came in through another PR. Without a diff, the task closes as done with the dev.task_already_in_dev event (agent, task, branch, reason) — no commit, no PR, no gates and no click. Any doubt (a folder the engine cannot reach, as in runner mode; git that fails; missing dev ref) is "has a diff": the task goes on to the gates, it never closes on its own. It measures DIFF and not ancestry, so it also covers the squash merge that RN-760 declares it does not see. Declared: the branch's old PR, if it exists, is not closed on the provider. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:246 (sem_diff_contra_a_dev?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:1048 (ja_na_dev) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/tarefa_ja_na_dev_test.exs Origin: AT-474
documents.s: RN-797 — A task whose branch has no diff against dev closes as "already in dev"

documents.t: Rule: when the delivery's diff against dev touches a README, QA checks, without an LLM, that every npm run <s>, npm test, npm start, pnpm [run] <s> and yarn [run] <s> cited in it exists in scripts of the package.json of the same folder (otherwise the one at the worktree root). The check enters consolidation as one more verdict ("Conferência do README"): a divergence is changes_requested with one item per command, naming the missing script; with no divergence, it approves. Without a README in the diff, a diff that failed or an unreachable package.json, nothing is asserted. OUT, declared: the manager's built-in subcommand (pnpm install, pnpm dlx…), a command with a flag before the script (pnpm --filter x test), the project's own CLI flags and a command that is not Node's. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/conferencia_do_readme.ex:28 (conferir), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:776 (conferencia_do_readme) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/conferencia_do_readme_test.exs Origin: AT-475
documents.s: RN-798 — QA checks the commands of the README touched by the delivery against the scripts

documents.t: Rule: while the project's agent_autonomy read has not arrived, the "Ligar para N agentes" of the Executores tab (RN-661) and the agents' checkboxes stay disabled, with the reason in text ("Lendo quais agentes já estão em modo automático…"); a click in that interval records nothing. Before, the list was born with ALL agents as a guess and shrank when the read arrived, and the first click after navigating fell on another element without recording or saying anything. The batch outcome (all, none with the api's sentence, some) is stated even if the reread after the writes fails. Declared: the same symptom on the PRs tab's "Merge", on "Nova ideação" and on "Aplicar a todos os agentes" was NOT reproduced nor fixed here. Where: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.tsx:98 (carregando) Test: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.test.tsx ("AT-477 (RN-803): antes de a leitura de agent_autonomy chegar, o botão fica inerte e diz por quê") Origin: AT-477 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-803 — The auto mode batch offer stays inert until it knows who is already switched on

documents.t: Rule: the ApprovalCard of a pending propose_execution_plan shows, above "Aprovar", the SAME batch offer control as the Executores tab (RN-661): the dev-<modulo> the plan starts (same derivation of devAgentId as the api) plus the gate subagents, all checked, and nothing recorded without the click on "Ligar". Same endpoint (PUT .../agent-autonomy, wildcard *), one PUT per agent, per-agent outcome and the same list of what auto mode does not unlock. Approving activates execution (RN-677) and the dev asks for the first command right after; switching on later does not approve the pending one (RN-755). It only appears where the caller passed the auto mode callback (role maintainer) and there is a QueryClient. The card stays single (AT-322): it is one more block of the type, not an appearance variant. Where: apps/web/src/components/ApprovalCard.tsx:386 (ModoAutomaticoDoPlano), apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoPlano.tsx:17 (agentesDoPlano) Test: apps/web/src/components/ApprovalCard.modo-automatico-do-plano.test.tsx Origin: AT-476 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-804 — The Dev Lead's plan card offers auto mode in batch before approving

documents.t: Rule: emit_plano_de_teste validates the ALREADY normalized arguments (RN-719: criteriosExecutaveis in a JSON string becomes a list), and the hook that ends the QA-strategy's loop reads criteriosExecutaveis through the SAME normalization (Termination.lista/1, that of RN-787). Before, the tool said "plano registrado: 9 critérios", the hook carried the raw string, the artifact was refused (:criterios_vazios), the agent returned {:ok, plano} anyway and the Automação fell into the string's Enum — the QA Lead died and the gate stayed stopped until the rescue (18 min in real use). A refused artifact is now a NAMED failure of the QA-strategy (agent.error, origin codigo) and the review goes on without a plan, as it already did when the plan fails; the Automação also normalizes the criteria it receives. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/hooks/termination_plano_de_teste.ex:23 (criterios_executaveis), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_estrategia_agent.ex:231 (emit_returning) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_estrategia_agent_test.exs ("critérios em string JSON viram lista: o plano é gravado e devolvido como lista") Origin: AT-478 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-805 — The recorded test plan is the one the tool accepted

documents.t: Rule: the overflow of the DockerPort's exec ceiling is decided by the CLOCK (elapsed ≥ ceiling) besides killed, because the docker exec client catches the SIGTERM of execFile's timeout and exits with code 0 — measured: sleep 30; echo FIM under a 3s ceiling came back erro: null, stdout: "", and the adapter returned exitCode: 0. An agent command that exceeded the 120s came back "exit 0", and QA approved a suite that hangs. The overflow now returns exitCode: -1, timedOut: true and the timeout mark. And killing the client does not kill the command: exec wraps the command (which stays as ONE argument, intact) in an sh that records its own PID — group and session leader, because the runtime does setsid on every docker exec — in the container's /tmp; on overflow the adapter kills the GROUP by that PID (SIGKILL), in an internal call, without a new operation on the port (ADR 0130). Measured and refused: busybox's timeout inside the sh -c — the watcher dies with the client and the sleep survives. If killing fails (/tmp not writable, for example), the mark says the process may have survived. Where: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.ts:269 (estourouOTeto), packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.ts:455 (matarExecEstourado) Test: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.spec.ts ("erro nulo depois do teto É estouro"; "no estouro mata o grupo do comando DENTRO do container"; "o comando que estoura volta timedOut e MORRE dentro do container", against real Docker, skipped without a daemon) Origin: AT-482
documents.s: RN-807 — An exec that exceeds the ceiling comes back as an overflow, and the command dies inside the container

documents.t: Rule: the QA Lead runs ONE cycle per task. A {:run, task} request for the task whose cycle is suspended waiting for a decision is ignored, and at the end of a cycle (verdict or block) every {:run, task} that was waiting in the process's mailbox is discarded — it was requested before the verdict existed, and the dev's legitimate correction is only born after it. In real use the rescue (RN-722) fired the cycle twice at the same instant, and the second, running after the approved one, recorded a contrary verdict about the already merged task. OUT, declared: two engine replicas (the mailbox is per process, the same caveat as the GateRescuer) and the cause of the double sweep of the rescue, which was not fixed here. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:106 (handle_cast), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:157 (descartar_pedidos_obsoletos) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_lead_server_test.exs ("pedido repetido que esperava na caixa é descartado ao fim do ciclo"; "pedido para a task com ciclo suspenso não abre um segundo") Origin: AT-478 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-806 — One QA cycle per task: a request prior to the verdict is discarded

documents.t: Rule: extends RN-758 and RN-784. The Arquiteto's floor gains assign_story_modules and choose_project_image, steps 2 and 3 of its kickoff (arquiteto_server.ex): the Jev's cut never removes them, and the Arquiteto does not end saying the tool "não está disponível nesta etapa" with stories without a module and an undecided image. emit_insight (step 8, tension record) and emit_artifact stay out of the floor: they are not obligations of the stage. It still holds that the floor only gives back what is in the step's catalog. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:311 (PISO_DO_MENU) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.spec.ts (Arquiteto recortado pelo Jev sem assign_story_modules/choose_project_image: as duas continuam no menu (RN-809)) Origin: AT-481 (TP-01: the cut left 7 of 11 tools and the Arquiteto did not distribute the stories by module)
documents.s: RN-809 — The Arquiteto's module and image obligations enter the Jev's floor

documents.t: Rule: when the call to the model comes back with a provider NETWORK error — the connection/timeout code the api normalizes (ADR 0041) or, without a code, the transport text (EAI_AGAIN, ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, ECONNREFUSED, ENOTFOUND) —, the ToolLoop retries it up to twice, with waits of 1 s and 3 s, recording toolloop.network_retry each time. It applies to every consumer of the ToolLoop (dev agents and gate subagents). Once the ceiling is exhausted, the outcome's origin is infra, never codigo, and the task's block of the dev agent for that cause does NOT increment the consecutive blocks counter (RN-047): the agent keeps claiming. In real use a 17 s getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN openrouter.ai blocked two tasks as codigo and tripped the dev. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tool_loop.ex:246 (llm_turn_com_retentativa), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:112 (falha_de_rede?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:952 (bloquear_parada), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:228 (finish_task) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tool_loop_test.exs ("falha de rede do provider: retenta e segue quando a rede volta"; "falha de rede que persiste esgota o teto"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs ("erro de rede do provider: origem infra e o disjuntor não conta"), apps/engine/test/engine/agents/falha_de_turno_test.exs Origin: AT-484 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-810 — A transient provider network failure is retried, and its block is infra without counting in the breaker

documents.t: Rule: before the "already in dev" check (RN-797) on report_done, the dev agent updates the remote's dev through the SAME fetch that RN-779 does on claim, serialized per project. Without it the comparison used the dev of the day the worktree was born: the branch of a task whose commits had already entered the remote dev through another task's PR went through QA and SecOps with 0 files. A failing fetch decides nothing — it compares with what there is, and when in doubt the task goes on to the gates. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:267 (sem_diff_contra_a_dev?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/worktree_manager.ex:277 (sem_diff_atualizado?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:892 (handle_outcome) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/tarefa_ja_na_dev_test.exs ("caminho feliz: com a dev atualizada, a branch não tem diff"; "falha: remoto inalcançável não fecha a task sozinha") Origin: AT-486 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-811 — "Already in dev" compares against the remote's updated dev

documents.t: Rule: before opening the PR of a pr_open, the executor asks the provider (listPullRequests, only the open ones) whether there is already an OPEN PR with the same source and the same target. If there is, it is reused: the action closes executed with its URL and id and reaproveitada: true, without opening another — the task's push already updated it. In real use the task reopened after a block opened pr-9 from the same branch with pr-8 open, and the PRs tab showed both. A provider without the listing, or a listing that fails, does not prevent opening: the usual path goes on. The PR of the branch that RN-797 closes as "already in dev" stays as it was: that one is not closed on the provider. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.ts:32 (prAbertaDaBranch), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.ts:204 (prAbertaDaBranch) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-git-action.use-case.spec.ts ("pr_open com PR aberta da mesma branch → reaproveita, sem abrir outra"; "pr_open: listar PRs falha → abre a PR como sempre") Origin: AT-485 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-812 — An open PR from the same branch is reused, never duplicated

documents.t: Rule: the "Parar execução" confirmation (RN-763) counts the tasks from the BACKLOG, read only with the confirmation open, and not from the event window: in_progress and in_review (QA gate running) in separate sentences, each saying what happens to it on stopping — the one in progress is blocked with the work preserved; the one in review has its gate stopped and is blocked with the PR open; both go back to the queue when released. Before, the count came from the dev agents with a task in the window, and the task in review (with no dev working on it) made the screen assert "Nenhuma tarefa está em curso". A backlog loading or with an error is stated in its own text, never as "none". Along with it, the Dev Lead's plan card (RN-804) opens the batch offer with its own text ("Ao aprovar o plano, a execução começa"), because there execution has not started yet (RN-677). Where: apps/web/src/lib/execution.ts:37 (contarTarefasAfetadasAoParar), apps/web/src/components/PararExecucao.tsx:26 (PararExecucao), apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.tsx:73 (ModoAutomaticoDoTime) Test: apps/web/src/components/PararExecucao.test.tsx ("RN-815 (AT-488): a tarefa em revisão de QA conta…"; "RN-815: sem backlog lido não afirma…"), apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoDoTime.test.tsx ("RN-816 (AT-488): no cartão do plano não afirma que a execução começou") Origin: AT-488 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-815 — "Parar execução" counts the tasks in progress AND in review, read from the backlog

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-816. In the PRs tab, the click on "Merge" that creates the git_merge proposed_action shows the decision card with the action the api RETURNED, right away, instead of waiting for the project queue (useProjectPendingActions) to come back. Before, between the proposal's response and the queue's refetch, the button came back with no card at all and the person read "the click did not register". The local action counts by PR id only while the queue has no read NEWER than the proposal (dataUpdatedAt); with a newer read, the queue says whether it is still pending. Deciding (approve, deny, always allow) forgets it. Declared: the cause was measured in the CODE (the card depended on the refetch), not in the browser; that the refetch takes long enough for the click to seem lost is an inference from TP-01. Where: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.tsx:125 (acaoDaPr) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.test.tsx ("RN-822 (AT-493): o 1º clique em Merge abre o cartão sem esperar a fila do projeto voltar" and "RN-822: a fila lida DEPOIS da proposta, sem ela, vence o cartão local") Origin: AT-493 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-822 — The first click on Merge opens the card without waiting for the queue

documents.t: Rule: a block that arrives AFTER the first paint does not stay above the button the person is about to click, and what needs to stay above has its space reserved while it loads. In the Session the pending items from other sessions (RN-626) live ABOVE the thread — between the thread and the composer they squeezed it from below and, with "follows the end" (RN-751), the final card ("Aceitar handoff e iniciar…") moved up under the cursor. In the Executores tab they come AFTER "Parar execução" and the batch offer. In the PRs tab the Merge comes first in the row's column, and the gate pipeline, which depends on the backlog, has a reserved height (skeleton) while it loads. Declared: the pipeline's reservation is the height of a single-line pipeline of stages, not measured in the browser, and jsdom does no layout — the test proves the ORDER and the reservation, not the pixel shift. Where: apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.tsx (PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes before styles.messages), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectExecutorsTab.tsx, apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.tsx:103 (ProjectPrsTab), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.module.css (.reservaDaEsteira) Test: apps/web/src/routes/salto-de-layout.test.ts, apps/web/src/routes/ProjectPrsTab.test.tsx ("RN-816 (AT-480): o Merge não muda de lugar quando o backlog chega") Origin: AT-480 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-816 — The button does not change place when a late block arrives

documents.t: Rule: extension of the cut of RN-765. When the task's title or description touches the entry point, the wiring (routes, migration, registration) or the run README, the QA gate's cut gains the section "Ponto de entrada": require evidence that the REAL entrypoint starts (the project's start/main run, or a test that imports the real entrypoint, not an app assembled in the test itself) and responds on a route or command. Without that evidence, the gap goes to itens. It is a PROMPT yardstick: the gates' external contract (docs/gates.yml) and the emit_qa_verdict code do not change, and no new gate is born. A task that touches none of that does not get the section. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:121 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("tarefa que toca a fiação exige evidência do ponto de entrada real" and "tarefa que não toca entrypoint nem fiação não ganha a seção") Origin: AT-483 (TP-01 of 10/10: server.ts never called the migration of the links table and /:code shadowed GET /links; the 53 tests passed because each one assembled its own database and app)
documents.s: RN-813 — A task that touches the entry point requires evidence that it starts

documents.t: Rule: extension of the cut of RN-765: the QA gate lists in itens ALL the task's gaps it finds in the round, at once, never one per round — each round is a paid correction and a step of the cycle's ceiling. The previous prompt only said to list "which rules are missing", and a gap that was not an uncovered rule was left for the next round. Prompt yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("o recorte pede todas as lacunas numa volta só") Origin: AT-487 (TP-01 of 10/10, task c7ced5a2: two failures for two gaps that already existed in the original delivery)
documents.s: RN-814 — The QA verdict lists all the gaps in one round

documents.t: Rule: extension of the cut of RN-765, for every task. Before running the suite, the QA gate shuts down what the project ITSELF left up (the start's server listening on a project port), only processes from that folder, never outside ones. A test that starts a process must terminate the GROUP (or start node directly, not via npm); one that does not terminate hangs the suite in a clean clone and is a gap in itens. A test that SKIPPED itself due to environment (port in use, missing tool) does not count as green: it goes to resumo as an observation. It is an instruction of the cut, not a harness step: the one who runs the suite is QA itself through terminal, which already goes through the policy and the container routing of the three modes — a pkill in the harness would need a second execution path per mode. Prompt yardstick; the gates' contract does not change. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:178 (secao_do_ambiente_limpo) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-817: pede ambiente limpo, encerrar o grupo e pulado como observação") Origin: AT-496 (TP-01 of 10/10: npm test hung in a clean clone — the test killed npm and the grandchild node stayed on 3000 —, and in the container QA saw exit 0 because the test skipped itself with the port taken by an orphan server)
documents.s: RN-817 — QA runs the suite in a clean state, and a skipped test is not green

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-813. The "Ponto de entrada" section says what COUNTS as evidence in the dev's environment — starting the entrypoint's process in the project folder, running the script in the project container, hitting a route of the running process — and what does NOT fit there: building a Docker image, docker compose, external network. A requirement of that second kind never goes to itens; it goes to resumo as an observation. Prompt yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:121 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-818: com ponto de entrada diz o que conta e o que não cabe" and "RN-818: sem ponto de entrada não traz a régua de evidência") Origin: AT-492 (TP-01 of 10/10, task c708f8b2: the 4th round required building the image from the Dockerfile, the project container has no Docker, and the cycle ran out in a politica block)
documents.s: RN-818 — The entry point evidence is the one the dev's environment produces

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-814. Besides listing all the gaps, the cut asks for a SWEEP BY RULE before emitting: go through each business rule and each criterion of the task, one by one, pointing out where the proof is or that it is missing, and only emit after going through all of them. "List all" alone did not prevent a pre-existing gap appearing in the next round. Prompt yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-819: pede varredura por regra antes de emitir") Origin: AT-490 (TP-01 of 10/10: tasks 2 and 11 brought in the 2nd round a gap that was already in the delivery)
documents.s: RN-819 — QA sweeps rule by rule before emitting

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-819. The execution dev agent's kickoff asks that an HTTP route created or changed go into the README (method, path, body, responses and codes) and that an input error (malformed JSON, invalid field) respond with its own message in the project's format, never the library's raw message. The QA cut checks both things in the sweep by rule, and whatever is missing goes to itens. Prompt yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:604 (initial_message) and apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-846: kickoff pede a rota no README e erro de entrada próprio") and apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-846: confere rota no README e erro de entrada próprio") Origin: AT-515 (TP-01, 12th: the README did not document the API, and malformed JSON responded 400 with the parser's "Expected property name…")
documents.s: RN-846 — The HTTP route goes into the README and the input error is the project's

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-846. The dev agent's kickoff asks that the route go INSIDE the README's "Rotas HTTP" section (created before "Testes" if missing), never at the end of the file, and that the README, which is the user's, not get a process note nor instructions for agents. The QA cut checks both things. Prompt yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:604 (initial_message) and apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-850: a rota vai dentro de Rotas HTTP e o README não leva nota de processo") and apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-850: confere a seção Rotas HTTP e a ausência de nota de processo") Origin: AT-520 (TP-01: each task added routes at the end of the README, after "Testes", and a process paragraph for agents was left over)
documents.s: RN-850 — The route goes into the "Rotas HTTP" section and the README carries no process note

documents.t: Rule: the Infra Lead's kickoff asks for the compose that STARTS THE APP (not only a dev environment): build of each module's Dockerfile with FROM = the decided image (projectImage of the Infra's context; without it, the routing's candidate, stated in the README), port ${APP_PORT:-8080}:<porta interna>, a volume for persistent data, a committed .env.example (never .env) and the section "Rodar na sua máquina" in the README. The agents' WORK container still starts through the broker, and there is no deploy. propose_infra_pr gets the MANDATORY field run (command up to 300 characters; urls from 1 to 5, label up to 60, kind in api_docs | web, url starting with http://localhost: or http://127.0.0.1:; boolean envExample), validated in the engine BEFORE the HALT with a named refusal that enters the loop (RN-163) and passed on in the open_infra_pr payload. Decision in ADR 0213. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/instrucoes_de_execucao.ex:20 (validar), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:1398 (build_kickoff) and :1256 (abrir_pr), and apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/tools/propose_infra_pr.ex:24 (spec) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_server_test.exs (describe "o compose sobe o app e a PR leva run (RN-851)") Origin: AT-517 (the deliverable had no way to be run by the user)
documents.s: RN-851 — The Infra's compose starts the APP on the user's machine, and the PR declares how to run it

documents.t: Rule: at engine BOOT, a RECENT in_progress row of gate_states (below gate_rescue_stale_after_seconds, 15 min, and therefore invisible to the tick) with no live process ON THIS node nor on the OTHER nodes of the cluster is an orphan of the restart, not a slow cycle: the boot resumes it right away (Dispatcher.run_qa/run_secops), without waiting for the threshold. "Alive" is the yardstick of RN-722 (the task in flight in the lead), also asked of the other nodes through :erpc.multicall — a node that does not answer counts as ALIVE, the yardstick of TurnoOrfao (RN-586). The usual guards apply: a pending action of a gate actor does not restart, and an absent dev owner only deletes the row. Before redispatching, the boot records gate.interrupted in the session log (taskId, gate, ultimaAtividadeEm, retomadoEm), and the thread shows it as a notice, in both languages. The periodic tick does NOT change: outside boot, a recent row is a cycle in flight. Declared residue: a node that has not yet joined the cluster at the moment of boot is not asked, and the worst outcome is the usual one (duplicated and cheap work; the second verdict is refused by the api). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/gate_rescuer.ex:191 (run_boot), :209 (interrompido_no_boot), apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.tsx:33 (cicloInterrompido) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/gate_rescuer_test.exs ("boot com ciclo RECENTE órfão do reinício: grava gate.interrupted e retoma já (RN-823)"; failures: "boot com ciclo recente esperando ação PENDENTE do gate: não reinicia nem grava (RN-823)" and the live local process untouched), apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.test.tsx ("cicloInterrompido (RN-823)") Origin: AT-495 (TP-01 of 10/10: the 18:51 restart killed the QA cycle of task 10, and the dev stayed awaiting_gate for 15 min without any screen saying so)
documents.s: RN-823 — The gate cycle the engine restart killed is resumed at boot, and the thread says so

documents.t: Rule: the docker run composed by DockerViaCli carries --restart unless-stopped as a CONSTANT, next to the --init of RN-738 — the spec gains no field, and ADR 0130's containment does not change. A restarted daemon (system update) restarts the project container; an explicit docker stop (the lifecycle's container_stop) is NOT undone, because unless-stopped does not restart what was stopped by hand — never always. Measured: an unless-stopped container stopped with docker stop stays exited with RestartCount=0. Where: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.ts:637 (argsDeCriacao) Test: packages/docker-port/src/docker-cli.spec.ts ("cria o container com rótulo gerenciado, UM bind e as capabilities derrubadas") Origin: AT-494 (the restarted daemon left every project container Exited (143) with the running record)
documents.s: RN-820 — The project container comes back on its own when the daemon restarts

documents.t: Rule: on /containers, the row with a running record and an OBSERVED exited state stops being "already up" and offers the mode's start action (acaoDeSubidaDoModo), without requiring Parar first, with the caveat registrado_rodando_observado_parado in text. Only the observed state unlocks: without an observation, or observed running, the record still holds. The api already accepted it: ExecuteContainerStartUseCase with a running row transitions nothing (ADR 0081's state machine does not change) and the broker does docker start on the stopped container. Where: apps/web/src/routes/containers-subida.ts:125 (caiuPorFora) Test: apps/web/src/routes/containers-subida.test.ts ("AT-494: registrado running e observado exited oferece subir de novo, com a ressalva" and "AT-494: registrado running e observado running (ou não observado) continua já de pé") Origin: AT-494
documents.s: RN-821 — Registered running and observed stopped offers "Subir de novo"

documents.t: Rule: the Infra offer is still a HUMAN click ("Confirmar arquitetura pronta"); what changes is that the screen NOTIFIES. With the Arquiteto active, no turn in progress, his handoff not yet offered and an artifact.module_map recorded in the session, the composer shows in visible text that the architecture can be confirmed for the system to offer the Infra. Without a promoted story, the same place states the reason the button is inert, once, in text (the title of a disabled button does not open in Chromium, RN-102); the enabled button gets the explanation in its title. The derivation reads the events the screen already has — no new query (RN-579). Where: apps/web/src/lib/session-readiness.ts:149 (temMapaDeModulos), apps/web/src/routes/SessionComposer.tsx:365 (hasModuleMap) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.proximo-passo-arquitetura.test.tsx ("mapa gravado + história promovida + Arquiteto parado: o texto aparece"; failures: "com o handoff do Arquiteto já oferecido, o texto some", "com turno em curso (streaming), o texto não aparece", "sem história promovida, o motivo vem em texto visível") Origin: AT-491 (option a: the human gesture is by design, the defect was the screen not notifying)
documents.s: RN-824 — After the module map, the composer says the next step is confirming the architecture

documents.t: Rule: the dev agent neither has nor needs git_commit, git_push or pr_open: commit, push and PR happen when it calls report_done. The description of report_done, that of report_blocked ("missing git tool" is not a reason to block), the dev agent's kickoff and the environment message (RN-706) say so — the environment one said, until now, to use the typed git actions, which the dev does not have. The kickoff and the environment also say that, if the package.json's test script lists files one by one, every new test file goes into it. Text only: no new code rule, and the Jev stays without a floor for dev agents (RN-758) — until RN-839, which put report_done/report_blocked in their floor. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/tools/report_done.ex:16 (spec), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/tools/report_blocked.ex:12 (spec), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:604 (initial_message), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/ambiente_do_agente.ex:102 (montar) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("caminho feliz: report_done, kickoff e ambiente carregam as duas instruções"; failure: "o ambiente não manda mais usar as ações tipadas de git") Origin: AT-499 (TP-01, 11th: a task blocked with the suite green for "git_commit não existe"; four QA rounds for a test outside the test script)
documents.s: RN-832 — The dev agent knows report_done does commit, push and PR, and that a new test goes into the test script

documents.t: Rule: above the session thread, next to the pending items from other sessions (RN-626), the "PRs prontas para merge" queue lists the project's OPEN PRs whose task had its gates approved (gateStatus: awaiting_user) or that have no task (ADR, infra), and that have no git_merge pending from ANOTHER session (that one is already in "Merges de PR"). "Mergear" PROPOSES the merge in this session, through the same endpoint as the PRs tab, and the approval card appears in the PR's row with the action returned by the api (RN-822); the merge stays manual (RN-418). Each queue has its own title and count, never summed (RN-467), and the reads are the ones the PRs tab and the backlog already make (same queryKeys, backlog at 15 s), with no new tight poll (RN-579). Where: apps/web/src/lib/prontas-e-bloqueadas.ts:30 (prsProntasParaMerge), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.tsx:112 (prontas) Test: apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.test.tsx ("a PR com os gates aprovados aparece, a com gate pendente não, e Mergear mostra o cartão ali") Origin: AT-497 (TP-01 conducted through the Criativo's chat)
documents.s: RN-825 — The chat shows the PRs ready for merge and proposes the merge there

documents.t: Rule: in the same area, the "Tarefas bloqueadas" queue lists the backlog's blocked tasks with title and reason (blockedReason, or "sem motivo registrado"), and "Desbloquear" calls the same unblock as the Visão geral (RN-794) with the open session. The result is stated on the task's row: success in text, and the refusal with the api's sentence. A role below developer sees the queue with the button inert and the reason in text. Where: apps/web/src/lib/prontas-e-bloqueadas.ts:53 (tarefasBloqueadas), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.tsx:180 (desbloquear) Test: apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.test.tsx ("CASO DE FALHA: desbloquear com erro diz o erro da api na linha da tarefa") Origin: AT-497
documents.s: RN-826 — The chat lists the blocked tasks and unblocks there

documents.t: Rule: the agent's streaming bubble and the persisted response bubble (agent.response) draw the SAME avatar, AvatarDoAgente, by the agent's id. Before, the in-progress bubble showed the agent's icon and the persisted one the model icon, and the avatar switched in front of the person when the turn closed. The model that generated the answer stays only in the chip next to the name. An agent outside the roster (or without an id) degrades to the generic icon, never to an empty box. Where: apps/web/src/components/ui/AvatarDoAgente.tsx:22 (AvatarDoAgente), apps/web/src/routes/SessionFio.tsx:284 (BolhaDoStreaming), apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:120 (montarTimeline) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionFio.at503.test.tsx ("a bolha persistida usa o avatar do agente, não o do modelo; o modelo segue no chip", "a bolha em streaming usa o MESMO avatar"; degradation: "sem agente identificado, degrada para o avatar genérico") Origin: AT-503 (TP-01 11th, chat UX note §2.1)
documents.s: RN-829 — The avatar of whoever speaks in the thread is the agent's, during streaming and after it

documents.t: Rule: Enter only sends when there is no composition in progress (nativeEvent.isComposing) — in the middle of an accent via IME or dead key, it confirms the character. The thread container is role="log" (with a name), and the turn activity strip (RN-460) is role="status" with aria-live="polite": the screen reader announces the new answer and what the agent is doing without interrupting whoever is reading. The check lives in the composer, not in the page, which is at its line ceiling (ADR 0176). Where: apps/web/src/routes/SessionComposer.tsx:81 (ignorarComposicaoIme), apps/web/src/components/TurnActivityStrip.tsx:41 (TurnActivityStrip) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionFio.at503.test.tsx ("Enter sem composição chega ao handler de envio", "a faixa do turno é uma região de status educada"; failure: "Enter no meio da composição de acento NÃO envia") Origin: AT-503 (chat UX note §3)
documents.s: RN-830 — The composer respects accent composition, and the thread talks to the screen reader

documents.t: Rule: when sending the message to the agent fails (except the refusal for a closed session, which returns the text to the field — AT-154), the optimistic bubble does not vanish: the text stays in the thread with the "não enviada" badge and the "Tentar de novo" button, which resends the SAME text to the SAME recipient through the usual path. There is only one at a time; a new send (or the resend itself) replaces it. The toast with the reason remains. Where: apps/web/src/lib/mensagem-nao-enviada.ts:29 (marcarMensagemNaoEnviada), apps/web/src/routes/SessionFio.tsx:52 (SessionFio) Test: apps/web/src/routes/SessionFio.at503.test.tsx ("mostra o texto com "não enviada" e reenvia ao clicar em tentar de novo", "um envio novo (otimista acesa) substitui a não enviada"); apps/web/src/routes/SessionPage.turno-preso.test.tsx (failure: "CASO DE FALHA: erro no envio desarma o turno e a mensagem fica "não enviada" (RN-831)") Origin: AT-503 (chat UX note §3)
documents.s: RN-831 — A message that was not sent stays in the thread, with "try again"

documents.t: Rule: every web Phoenix socket is born through criarSocket and dies through descartar(), which does disconnect() and removes the three listeners that the phoenix@1.8.9 constructor registers on window (pagehide, pageshow, visibilitychange) — disconnect() alone left them, and the visibilitychange reopened the old socket. In the session channel each conectar() is a GENERATION: the previous one is disposed of (leave, descartar() and ITS ping) before the new one is born, and every callback of an old generation is a no-op — the onClose of a replaced socket does not schedule a reconnection, does not clear the current one's ping and does not mark the live channel dead. The live channel (RN-579) is a COUNT of connections per session, not a boolean. The neutralization of auto-reconnect (RN-108) stays mandatory in the type of criarSocket. Where: apps/web/src/lib/socket-phoenix.ts:31 (criarSocket), apps/web/src/lib/session-channel.ts:92 (descartarGeracao), apps/web/src/lib/session-channel.ts:136 (ehAtual), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.ts:70 (marcarCanalDaSessao) Test: apps/web/src/lib/socket-phoenix.test.ts (real Phoenix: "50× criar + descartar deixa saldo líquido 0 nos três ouvintes de window"; failure: "socket só desconectado (sem descartar) deixa os três ouvintes"), apps/web/src/lib/session-channel.test.ts ("gerações (AT-500, RN-833)"), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.test.ts Origin: AT-500
documents.s: RN-833 — Every web Phoenix socket gets disposed of, and the replaced one does not act

documents.t: Rule: the creation wizard's "Nome do projeto" field uses id/name projeto-slug, which match no contact data token (name, nome, title, first, last, company, contact). The project-title of RN-736 removed the "name", but "title" is an honorific (Mr./Mrs.) in contact autofill, and NordPass kept opening the contact list over the field. The visible label "Nome do projeto" (linked by htmlFor) and the SEM_AUTOFILL of RN-740 stay. It is a HEURISTIC, not measured: NordPass documents no ignore attribute, and none was added to SEM_AUTOFILL; the proof is TP-01. Where: apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.tsx:746 (projeto-slug) Test: apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.test.tsx ("RN-834: id e name do nome do projeto não parecem dado de contato…") Origin: AT-501 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-834 — The project name in the wizard is not called "title"

documents.t: Rule: the NUMBERS of the "Contexto da sessão" panel — business rules, recorded decisions and artifacts per agent — come from an aggregate of the WHOLE session counted on the server (GET .../sessions/:sessionId/context-summary, viewer, a read without a new table), ADDED to the window of events the screen already loaded in the mold of RN-568: the counts are monotonic, so the greater of the two holds. The DETAIL (the rule's card, the decision, the backlog tree) is still the window's, and the cut notice ("Mostrando N de M") only appears in the section whose detail is partial; an agent whose artifacts were all before the window gets the group with the total. An ABSENT aggregate (loading or failed) is "I did not read": the panel falls back to the declared cut of RN-180/RN-701, and an empty "Arquivos tocados" says it did not read, never "Nada ainda". The aggregate does NOT poll (RN-579, RN-632): it is reread when the window sees a new artifact or a new commit/PR action (the query's key), on focus and on remount. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.ts:22 (resumir), apps/web/src/lib/contexto-da-sessao.ts:15 (useContextoDaSessaoInteira), apps/web/src/lib/contexto-da-sessao.ts:34 (totalDaSessao), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:174 (resumo) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.spec.ts ("conta a sessão INTEIRA, além de qualquer cauda de 200…"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-context-summary.use-case.spec.ts (failure: "sessão de outro projeto é 404 e não lê nada"), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.sessao-inteira.test.tsx ("com o agregado maior que a janela, mostra o total da sessão…"; failure: "sem o agregado, os arquivos dizem "não li"…") Origin: AT-498 (TP-01 of 10/10: a 301-event session showed 0 rules out of 11 and 2 decisions out of 6)
documents.s: RN-827 — The context panel counts the whole session, and the window only gives the detail

documents.t: Rule: the aggregate's list of touched files (RN-827) joins the git_commit/git_push of the requested session and of the EXECUTION session linked to it — the one the Dev Lead's plan approved IN THIS session activated (executionResult.sessaoDeExecucao of an executed propose_execution_plan), of the same project. A session without that link does not enter. The list goes from the most recent to the oldest, cut at 100 (TETO_DE_ARQUIVOS_TOCADOS), and the total states the real number; the screen declares the cut when it cuts. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.ts:31 (ligadas), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:366 (filesTouched) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.spec.ts ("…e soma os arquivos da execução ligada"; failure: "corta a lista de arquivos no teto e devolve o total real; não lê sessão sem ligação") Origin: AT-498
documents.s: RN-828 — "Arquivos tocados" includes the linked execution session, with a ceiling and the real total

documents.t: Rule: the visible label of the creation wizard's name field is "Projeto" (en: "Project"), not "Nome do projeto"/"Project name": with the id/name projeto-slug of RN-834 NordPass kept opening "Contact info" over the field (TP-01, 12th), and the <label> text was the signal that remained. The label stays visible and linked by htmlFor, the field stays outside a <form> and with the SEM_AUTOFILL of RN-740. It is a HEURISTIC: the search (NordPass's help center, the extension store, forums) found no ignore attribute documented by NordPass (nothing like data-np-ignore), so none was added to SEM_AUTOFILL. Already tried before: removing autoFocus (RN-736), aria-autocomplete/data-protonpass-ignore (RN-740), id/name without a contact token (RN-834). The proof is TP-01. Where: apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.tsx:749 (projeto-slug), apps/web/src/locales/pt-BR/newProject.json (nameLabel) Test: apps/web/src/routes/NewProjectWizard.test.tsx ("RN-842: o rótulo visível do campo não traz "nome"…") Origin: AT-511 (TP-01 of 10/11)
documents.s: RN-842 — The project name label does not say "Nome"

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-816 and RN-794. In the Visão geral's execution section, the list of blocked tasks comes FIRST, before "Religar execução" (which depends on reading the current execution) and the dev agents grid (which depends on the events) — blocks that arrived after the first paint and pushed the button under the cursor. Unblocking has feedback PER TASK: in flight the button stays inert and says "Desbloqueando…" (one click, one call), success says "Tarefa desbloqueada" until the reread backlog removes the row, and the refusal shows the api's sentence on the row itself. Without a session read, the button stays inert with the reason in text — before, the click returned silently. Declared: what stays ABOVE the section (the team and the activity tree) has no reserved height, and jsdom does no layout — the test proves the ORDER, not the pixel shift; which of the two causes (jump or unread session) made the 1st click of TP-01 get lost was not measured in the browser. Where: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.tsx:485 (desbloqueio), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.tsx:611 (blockedTasks) Test: apps/web/src/routes/ProjectOverviewTab.test.tsx ("RN-835 (AT-502): o desbloqueio chama uma vez, fica em voo e diz quando terminou"; failure: "RN-835: a recusa do desbloqueio mostra a frase da api na linha"), apps/web/src/routes/salto-de-layout.test.ts ("RN-835 (AT-502): Visão geral — as tarefas bloqueadas vêm antes…") Origin: AT-502 (TP-01 of 10/10)
documents.s: RN-835 — The Visão geral's "Desbloquear" does not move and says what happened

documents.t: Rule: with the person far from the end of the thread (the 120px guard of RN-173) and the thread having gained a message or approval card since they left the end, a floating button at the bottom of the scrolling area offers the jump to the end, counting the new messages ("3 mensagens novas", i18next plural with _zero/_one/_other). A new approval card does not add to the number: it HIGHLIGHTS the button and swaps the label for "Há uma aprovação esperando". The button has its own accessible label, disappears on reaching the end and never appears for someone at the end — there RN-173's automatic scrolling still rules, and the button only observes. Where: apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem.ts:206 (estadoDoIrAoFim), apps/web/src/lib/session-rolagem.ts:227 (useIrAoFimDoFio), apps/web/src/routes/IrAoFimDoFio.tsx:10 (IrAoFimDoFio) Test: apps/web/src/routes/IrAoFimDoFio.test.tsx ("caminho feliz: fora do fim e com mensagens novas, mostra o contador…", "aprovação nova realça o botão"; failure: "no fim, conteúdo novo não mostra botão") Origin: AT-506 (Chat UX improvements, item 1.3)
documents.s: RN-836 — The thread offers "go to the end" when content arrives for someone who scrolled up

documents.t: Rule: the chat's light Markdown (its own parser, no dependency) also recognizes horizontal rules (---, ***, ___; right after paragraph text it stays text), blockquotes (consecutive > lines, the inside reprocessed by the same parser), the #### heading, a nested list of ONE level (an item indented by 2+ spaces goes into the previous item; deeper is flattened) and checklists (- [ ]/- [x], a visual-only, disabled box). In stream mode (MarkdownMessage with emCurso), the text first goes through fecharMarcadoresAbertos, which closes pending fences, backticks and ** and removes a loose marker at the tip — no prefix throws nor shows a raw marker. The final text never goes through it. Still without dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Where: apps/web/src/lib/markdown.ts:122 (HR_RE), apps/web/src/lib/markdown.ts:123 (CITACAO_RE), apps/web/src/lib/markdown.ts:124 (TAREFA_RE), apps/web/src/lib/markdown.ts:374 (fecharMarcadoresAbertos), apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.tsx:298 (MarkdownMessage) Test: apps/web/src/lib/markdown.blocos-e-stream.test.ts ("checklist marca cada item…"; failure: "--- logo depois de texto continua texto"), apps/web/src/components/ui/MarkdownMessage.stream.test.tsx ("nenhum prefixo lança nem mostra marcador cru"; failure: "o texto final (sem emCurso) não é alterado") Origin: AT-507 (Chat UX improvements, 10/10, item 1.2-a)
documents.s: RN-837 — Thread Markdown: new blocks and a stream prefix without raw markers

documents.t: Rule: extends RN-783 (owner decision of 10/10). The qa-automacao gate now gets the same treatment as the execution dev agents: with a supportsReasoning model, a provider that can say "off" sends reasoning: { enabled: false }, keeping the slack of RN-782. QA-strategy (qa-estrategia) and the other gates do not change. The measurement that motivated it: the gates' reasoning rose from 44 thousand to 211 thousand tokens per round, and their cost from US$ 0.15 to US$ 0.55. The execution dev agents (dev-<modulo>, never dev-lead) stop being without a floor ONLY for the two task outcome tools: the Jev's cut never removes report_done nor report_blocked. The rest of their step stays cuttable, with RN-759's cut notice. Like every floor, it only gives back what is in the step's catalog. documents.t: Rule: extends RN-758 and RN-839 to the GATE agents. The Jev's cut never removes from each one its VERDICT tool, and only its own: qa-automacao → emit_qa_verdict, qa-performance-seguranca → emit_perf_seguranca_verdict, qa-estrategia → emit_plano_de_teste, appsec → emit_threat_model. Without it the gate ran the suite and stopped without a verdict, with the delegation failing with origin modelo and the ready task blocked. An agent outside the gates gets no verdict tool, and the floor only gives back what is in the step's catalog. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:311 (PISO_DO_MENU) Test: apps/api/test/domain/llm/tool-router-piso-dos-gates.spec.ts (ids and tools checked against the engine's .ex; a cut that leaves only terminal/read_file ends with the verdict; failure: criativo, dev-api and dev-lead get no verdict tool; the floor does not add a tool outside the catalog) Origin: AT-509 (TP-01, 12th run)

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-825. The list of open PRs still has no poll of its own, and is reread at two moments: (1) when the backlog read the chat already does at 15 s brings some task with a status or gateStatus different from the previous read (the dev's PR is born in the EXECUTION session, whose channel the chat does not listen to, and the gates approving show up there); and (2) when this session's channel announces adr.pr_opened, infra.pr_opened, action.pr_open, action.git_merge or action.failed, through the invalidator with a 2 s window (RN-579, RN-632). The first read and an equal read reread nothing: the cost is zero new polls. Left out, declared: an infra PR opened in another session without changing a task nor going through this channel only shows up on the next read triggered by another reason. Where: apps/web/src/lib/prontas-e-bloqueadas.ts:66 (assinaturaDoBacklog), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.tsx:91 (assinaturaAnterior), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.ts:134 (alvosDoEvento) Test: apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.test.tsx ("RN-841: a tarefa que entra em awaiting_user relê as PRs…" and "CASO DE FALHA RN-841…"), apps/web/src/lib/acoes-da-sessao.test.ts Origin: AT-510

documents.t: Rule: on the row of an executed ADR, listar_adrs_propostas (RN-772) no longer asserts "PR aberta" from the ACTION's status: it crosses the result's pullRequestId with the EXECUTED git_merge of the same project (the action every merge goes through, RN-418) and says "PR MERGEADA em <data da decisão>" or "PR aberta (nenhum merge dela registrado no Brabo)". A result without a PR id, or a merge query that fails, becomes "estado da PR: NÃO CONSEGUI LER" — never "aberta". Contained (ADR 0060): one extra query, only over the listed ids, in the same Postgres. Declared limit: a PR closed without a merge OUTSIDE the Brabo (on the remote provider) is not seen, and keeps being read as open — asking the provider would be HTTP in the agent's loop. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/listar_adrs_propostas.ex:88 (cruzar_com_merges), :102 (merges_por_pr), :155 (estado_da_pr). Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/listar_adrs_propostas_test.exs ("PR mergeada aparece como mergeada…", "estado da PR ilegível diz que não leu, nunca aberta"). documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-845. documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-822. The PENDING git_merge that the pending block draws on the PR's row ("PRs prontas para merge") is its ONLY ApprovalCard on screen: the block registers the ids it draws in a light client registry, and the session thread, while the action is pending and registered, shows only a line pointing to the queue. Once decided, the thread goes back to the card (history); without the block mounted (another screen, PR outside the queue), the thread shows the full card. The registration only holds while the card is MOUNTED: with the block collapsed (the Disclosure unmounts the content), the thread shows the card. No endpoint or ceiling changes. Where: apps/web/src/lib/acoes-no-bloco.ts:48 (useAcaoEstaNoBloco), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.tsx:460 (useRegistrarAcoesNoBloco), apps/web/src/components/CartaoOuReferenciaNoFio.tsx:11 (CartaoOuReferenciaNoFio), apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:1137 (CartaoOuReferenciaNoFio) Test: apps/web/src/components/CartaoOuReferenciaNoFio.test.tsx, apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.test.tsx ("a PR com os gates aprovados aparece…") Origin: AT-512

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-827 and RN-828. The aggregate GET .../sessions/:sessionId/context-summary returns, besides the numbers, the ITEMS: the business rules (itensDeRegras: title, description and how many sources it cites) and the recorded decisions (itensDeDecisoes: choice and context) of the session, most recent first, up to 50 of each (TETO_DE_ITENS_DO_CONTEXTO); the total stays in regras/decisoes. With the aggregate, the panel lists these items instead of the 200-event window — a rule that fell before the window keeps appearing — and the cut says "Mostrando as N mais recentes de M". "Arquivos tocados" now includes the files of the PRs (executed pr_open/open_adr_pr/open_infra_pr, with pullRequestId) of the session and of the linked execution session, read from the SAME diff as the PRs tab (ReadProjectCodeUseCase.pullRequestDiff), before the commit payload files, within the ceiling of 100 with the real total. A contained read (ADR 0060): no free parameter, at most 20 diffs per call (TETO_DE_PRS_LIDAS); a PR beyond the ceiling or whose diff failed goes into prsNaoLidas, and the screen says how many were left out. With the aggregate and nothing to list, the empty state says what there was not (no file in a PR nor commit of this session or of the linked execution), never "Nada ainda". The use case lives in the git module because it is that one that reads the repository; a session of another project is still 404 without reading any PR. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.ts:140 (itensDeRegras), apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.ts:184 (prsDasSessoes), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/git/resumir-contexto-da-sessao.use-case.ts:37 (prs), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:197 (businessRules), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.tsx:222 (decisoes) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/session-context-summary.repository.spec.ts ("RN-844: devolve os ITENS de regra e decisão fora de qualquer cauda, com teto de 50"; "RN-844: lista as PRs executadas da sessão e da execução ligada…"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/git/resumir-contexto-da-sessao.use-case.spec.ts ("lê os arquivos das PRs das sessões lidas…"; failures: "corta no teto de arquivos, conta PR fora do teto e diff que falhou em prsNaoLidas" and "sessão de outro projeto é 404 e não lê PR nenhuma"), apps/web/src/routes/ContextAside.sessao-inteira.test.tsx ("…lista os itens do servidor (RN-844)"; "agregado sem arquivo diz O QUE não houve…") Origin: AT-513 (TP-01 of 10/11: 9 rules without a list, "mostrando 1 de 4" decisions and "Arquivos tocados: Nada ainda" with 12 merged PRs)

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-844. In the LOCAL git provider, the diff of a PR was target...source also after the merge — and then the merge base is the source's own tip, so the merged PR returned ZERO files (measured in a test: [] for fast-forward and for a merge commit), and the "Contexto da sessão" panel said "Nenhum arquivo nas PRs" with 14 merged PRs, with nothing in prsNaoLidas (the diff did not fail, it came empty). Now the merge records in the PR's store the merge base and the source tip at the moment of the merge (mergedBaseSha/mergedHeadSha), and the merged PR's diff is mergedBaseSha...mergedHeadSha. A PR merged before those fields falls back to the target's merge commit (first parent) whose second parent is the source tip; one merged by fast-forward without the fields cannot be reconstructed and stays empty (declared gap). GitHub and GitLab already return the merged PR's diff through the platform itself. On screen, the context summary is reread on the SAME triggers that reread the PR list (RN-841): the channel's prs target (with its 2 s window, no extra fetch) and the change of the backlog signature, by prefix ['session-context-summary', projectId]. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.ts:374 (mergedBaseSha), apps/api/src/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.ts:862 (rangeDoDiff), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.ts:221 (prs), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.tsx:101 (invalidateQueries) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/git/local-git-provider.contract.spec.ts ("PR mergeada por fast-forward devolve os arquivos que mudou"; "PR mergeada por commit de merge devolve só os arquivos dela"; "PR mergeada antes de os SHAs serem gravados acha o commit de merge"), apps/web/src/lib/contexto-da-sessao.test.tsx ("o merge que chega pelo canal relê o resumo"; "CASO DE FALHA: evento que não mexe em PR não relê o resumo"), apps/web/src/components/PendenciasDeOutrasSessoes.test.tsx ("RN-841: a tarefa que entra em awaiting_user relê as PRs…"). The read failure adding to prsNaoLidas stays covered by apps/api/test/application/use-cases/git/resumir-contexto-da-sessao.use-case.spec.ts ("corta no teto de arquivos, conta PR fora do teto e diff que falhou em prsNaoLidas"). Origin: AT-518 (TP-01, 13th: "Nenhum arquivo nas PRs nem nos commits" with 14 merged PRs, and the tab not rereading the summary)

documents.t: Rule: extension of RN-579 (AT-157). The api does not notify the channel of a write that came from the engine (/internal/*), because its facade notifies the event IT asked to record. What the api records on its own as the EFFECT of an auto-approved action executed inside that request (infra.pr_opened, adr.pr_opened, action.*) no facade notifies, and now it is notified: ProposeActionUseCase executes the action under the mark runComoEfeitoDeAcao, and the notifier only stays silent with engine origin WITHOUT that mark. The event the engine asked for (including proposed_action.created) stays without a notice from the api, so it does not go out twice. Where: apps/api/src/application/efeito-de-acao.ts:18 (ehEfeitoDeAcao), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/propose-action.use-case.ts:314 (runComoEfeitoDeAcao), apps/api/src/infrastructure/http-clients/session-channel-notifier.ts:73 (ehEfeitoDeAcao) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/sessions/aviso-ao-canal-da-sessao.spec.ts ("AT-516: efeito de ação executada dentro de /internal avisa o canal, uma vez"; failure/regression: "escrita vinda do engine (/internal) não é avisada de novo pela api") Origin: AT-516 (the auto-approved infra PR only entered the chat's "PRs prontas" ~5 min later, through the fallback poll)
documents.s: RN-848 — The effect of an action executed inside an internal request notifies the session channel

documents.t: Rule: part of ADR 0213. When the task touches the entry point or routes (the SAME yardstick as the QA cut, toca_ponto_de_entrada?, never a copy), the dev's kickoff gets the clause: a module that exposes HTTP serves /openapi.json (OpenAPI 3) and /docs (Swagger UI); without network or without the package, /docs is an HTML page that loads swagger-ui from a CDN; a web module serves the home page; the URL goes into the "Rodar na sua máquina" section of the README. A task that does not touch routes does not pay the clause (the message is pinned and comes back on every iteration). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:636 (clausula_de_openapi), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:113 (toca_ponto_de_entrada?) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-853: tarefa que toca rotas pede /openapi.json e /docs"; failure: "RN-853 falha: tarefa sem rota nem entrypoint não paga a cláusula") Origin: AT-517
documents.s: RN-853 — The dev exposes OpenAPI and Swagger when the task touches routes

documents.t: Rule: part of ADR 0213. In the entry point section of the cut (RN-813), QA starts the app with the README's command in the background INSIDE the container, hits localhost:<porta interna>/openapi.json and /docs (curl, wget or node -e fetch) and terminates the process group (RN-817). A failure goes to itens; the real docker compose up stays in resumo as "proven only on the user's machine". Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:121 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("tarefa que toca rotas pede /openapi.json e /docs, compose em resumo"; failure: "falha: tarefa sem rota não recebe a seção") Origin: AT-517
documents.s: RN-854 — QA proves /openapi.json and /docs inside the container

documents.t: Rule: open_infra_pr REQUIRES run = {command, urls, envExample} (ADR 0213): command non-empty text up to 300 characters; urls from 1 to 5 items {label (up to 60), url, kind}, with url starting with http://localhost: or http://127.0.0.1: and kind ∈ api_docs | web; boolean envExample. The api refuses on PROPOSAL with 400 run_invalido (text that goes back to the Infra Lead) and revalidates on EXECUTION, which fails named without committing. With the PR opened (or fixed), the api emits artifact.run_instructions {command, urls, envExample, prUrl, version} — versioned, without a table, the highest version is the current one (the design of artifact.project_image), and projected into docs/ like the other versioned ones. GET /projects/:projectId/run-instructions (viewer) returns the current one (+ version, eventId, declaredAt) or null. It is DECLARED by the Infra, never verified on the reader's machine (RN-468). And the Infra's context (/internal/.../infra-context) now carries projectImage, the current image, network and resources decision, null without a decision. Where: apps/api/src/domain/infra/run-instructions.ts:44 (recusaDoRun), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/propose-action.use-case.ts:155 (recusaDoRun), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/actions/execute-infra-pr.use-case.ts:111 (recusaDoRun), :328 (EVENTO_INSTRUCOES_DE_EXECUCAO), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-run-instructions.use-case.ts:26 (execute), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-infra-context.use-case.ts:89 (projectImage) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/propose-action.use-case.spec.ts ("sem run: 400 run_invalido, sem proposta"; "URL fora de localhost: 400 nomeando o campo"; "run válido: a proposta nasce"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-infra-pr.use-case.spec.ts ("PR aberta emite artifact.run_instructions com prUrl e versão seguinte"; failure: "run inválido na execução falha sem commitar nem emitir"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-run-instructions.use-case.spec.ts ("devolve o vigente — o de maior version"; "null sem artefato, e o de outro projeto não vaza"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-infra-context.use-case.spec.ts ("RN-852: projectImage é a decisão vigente…"; "…null sem decisão de imagem") Origin: AT-517 (the TP-01 deliverable did not say how to run it on the user's machine)

documents.t: Rule: the Visão geral gets the "Rodar na sua máquina" card, right below the first steps one, with what the Infra declared in its PR (artifact.run_instructions, RN-852): the command in a code block with a "Copiar" button, the URLs as links that open in a new tab (target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer") — only http://localhost:<porta> and http://127.0.0.1:<porta>; another URL does not become a link, even though the api already refuses it —, the reminder of cp .env.example .env when envExample and the note "Declarado pela Infra na PR, não verificado na sua máquina" (RN-468: never green, never "running"). Without a declaration (null) the card does not appear, as the first steps one disappears when there is nothing to say. The read is a configuration one (FRESCOR_DA_CONFIGURACAO_MS, no poll) and the session channel's infra.pr_opened notice rereads it. documents.t: Rule: three halves of a single defect (TP-01 measured 1 s between "Desbloquear" and the dev's claim, and the heartbeat closed the session in it). (1) The sixth signal of RN-064 (RN-776) also counts, in the current execution session, a todo task of a ready story whose module belongs to a dev agent of THIS execution (an actor of a dev.* event in the session) and an in_progress task assigned to one of them — without a ceiling, like the others. (2) The claim resumes, BEFORE the todo queue, the in_progress task that already belongs to the agent (same assigned_to, outside a gate, not blocked); its branch, if it exists and is not merged, is the worktree's starting point (the WorktreeManager's resumption). (3) Closing the execution session (RN-763) also blocks an in_progress task owned by a dev-* that no dev_agent_states row holds, with the same reason and origin politica; the list only comes for an EXECUTION session, so closing a consultative one of the same project blocks nothing. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/backlog.repository.ts:252 (findPendenteDaExecucao), :403 (claimNext), :221 (listEmCursoDeDev), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-pending-work.use-case.ts:49 (em_curso_de_dev), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/encerramento_da_sessao.ex:133 (bloquear_orfas) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/sessions/get-session-pending-work.use-case.spec.ts ("tarefa recém-desbloqueada (todo) do módulo de um dev da execução segura a sessão"; "tarefa todo de módulo SEM dev na execução não segura"; "tarefa in_progress atribuída a dev da execução segura a sessão"; "listEmCursoDeDev lista a in_progress de dev só para sessão de EXECUÇÃO"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/claim-next-task.use-case.spec.ts ("retoma a in_progress que já é DELE antes da fila todo"; "não retoma a in_progress dele que está em gate"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/encerramento_da_sessao_test.exs ("bloqueia a task em curso ÓRFÃ…"; "sem nenhuma linha, a órfã também é bloqueada…") Origin: AT-522 (TP-01, 14th: session 538a0ba5 closed 1 s after the unblock, an in_progress task stuck on dev-api without a process)

documents.t: Rule: when the Jev's cut (RN-625) decides the menu of an execution dev agent (dev-<modulo>, never dev-lead) and the LAST user message of the step is the correction verdict the engine assembles — a gate asking for correction ("pediu correção nesta PR") or a merge refused due to conflict (RN-715) —, the menu gains write_file and terminal besides the outcome floor (RN-839). The criterion is the text the api already receives, without a new field; the fixed floor of every step does not widen (RN-759), another agent does not gain it, and the floor only adds what is in the step's catalog (P3). Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/tool-router.ts:368 (PISO_DA_CORRECAO_DO_DEV), :379 (ehPassoDeCorrecao), :392 (menuComPiso), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/llm/decidir-ferramenta-do-passo.use-case.ts:248 (menuComPiso) Test: apps/api/test/domain/llm/tool-router-correcao-do-dev.spec.ts ("dev agent em correção recebe write_file e terminal"; "passo comum de leitura do dev não alarga"; "outro agente com a mesma mensagem não ganha"; "as marcas existem no texto que o engine monta") Origin: AT-523
documents.s: RN-857 — The dev agent's correction step has write and terminal in the Jev's cut

documents.t: Rule: the doubt an agent leaves for the user becomes the artifact.open_question event (append-only, in the log of the session where it is born) with {questionId (uuid), pergunta (até 500), sugestao (até 300, opcional), afeta: {regras, historias, tarefas}, autor, sessionId} — the events funnel refuses with 400 a payload outside that shape, whether it comes from the engine or the api. It closes with open_question.answered {questionId, resposta, aceitouSugestao, decisionEventId, respondidaPor}; the STATUS comes from the log (open = without answered), never from a table. GET /projects/:projectId/open-questions?status=open|answered|all (viewer, default open) lists the most recent first, with a ceiling of 50 and the total (RN-180), and states in autorDaSessao who can answer. POST .../open-questions/:questionId/answer with {resposta} or {aceitarSugestao: true} is only accepted from the AUTHOR of the originating session (403 so_o_autor_da_sessao); already answered is 409 pergunta_ja_respondida, a question from another project is 404 and an empty answer (or a suggestion that does not exist) is 400. Answering records, in one transaction, an artifact.decision_record with the user as actor (context = the question, choice = the answer, consequences = what it affects, plus questionId and afeta) and the open_question.answered, notifies the session channel (through the funnel, RN-579) and asks the engine to resume the PARKED QA gate of each affected task (the RN-724 path) — best effort: a gate that was not parked or an engine that is down does not undo the answer. ADR 0214. Where: apps/api/src/domain/open-questions/pergunta-em-aberto.ts:44 (validarPerguntaEmAberto), :112 (respostaEscolhida), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/sessions/append-session-event.use-case.ts:101 (EVENTO_PERGUNTA_EM_ABERTO), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/backlog/perguntas-em-aberto.use-case.ts:72 (listar), :106 (responder), :189 (resumeParkedGate), apps/api/src/interfaces/http/backlog/open-questions.controller.ts:51 (list), :81 (answer) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/perguntas-em-aberto.use-case.spec.ts ("o autor responde: decision_record (ator usuário, com questionId) e answered, e o gate é religado"; "aceitar a sugestão grava a sugestão como escolha"; failures: "quem não é o autor da sessão recebe 403 so_o_autor_da_sessao, sem escrever"; "já respondida é 409 pergunta_ja_respondida"; "pergunta de outro projeto é 404"; "o funil de eventos recusa com 400 antes de qualquer escrita") Origin: AT-521 (TP-01: four questions from the Criativo vanished from the field of view and the flow went on without answers)
documents.s: RN-858 — An agent's open question is a durable record, and only the session author answers it

documents.t: Rule: GET /internal/sessions/:sessionId/dev-context returns decisoes: the project's artifact.decision_records whose afeta touches the task, its story or a rule the story cites — most recent first, at most 10, with the question and the decision cut at 1,500 characters each ({id, questionId, pergunta, decisao, decididaEm}). A decision without afeta does not enter. They win over RF/DoR when they conflict (the dev's kickoff and the QA cut show them — engine). And the story correction yardstick (RN-727, recusaDeCorrecaoDeHistoria) is revised (ADR 0214, over ADR 0212): a ready story is also correctable when the request cites a questionId the user HAS ALREADY answered — an open or nonexistent question unlocks nothing, and the in_progress/in_review task lock still applies. Both PO doors accept the questionId: update_story (title/description, the event carries it) and complete_story (RF/DoD/DoR; the story stays ready, without a new promotion, and backlog.story_completed carries the questionId). Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:122 (decisoesDaTarefa), :374 (decisoesDoContexto), apps/api/src/domain/backlog/correcao-de-historia.ts:33 (recusaDeCorrecaoDeHistoria), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/backlog/corrigir-historia.use-case.ts:126 (respostaDoUsuario), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/backlog/complete-story.use-case.ts:82 (corrigindoReady) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts ("devolve só as que afetam a tarefa, a história ou uma regra dela, mais recentes primeiro"; "decisão sem afeta não entra; teto de 10 e texto cortado em 1 500"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/corrigir-historia.use-case.spec.ts ("história ready citando pergunta RESPONDIDA é corrigida, e o evento a cita"; failures: "história ready citando pergunta AINDA ABERTA segue recusada"; "história ready com tarefa em revisão segue recusada mesmo com a resposta"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/complete-story.use-case.spec.ts ("história ready com pergunta respondida tem RF/DoR corrigidos e segue ready"; "história ready com pergunta ainda aberta é recusada") Origin: AT-521 (QA failed three times reading the DoR of a ready story nobody could correct, after the user had already decided)
documents.s: RN-859 — The user's decision reaches whoever works, and unlocks correcting the ready story

documents.t: Rule: the gate verdict (POST /internal/sessions/:sessionId/gates/verdict) accepts the verdict needs_user_decision, only from the qa gate, with pergunta (up to 500) and sugestao (up to 300) or an openQuestionId that already exists — without either it is 400. The state machine keeps the SAME gate and does NOT increment the correction counter, not even at the ceiling, so the cycle does not reach the politica block of RN-762. Without openQuestionId, the api records the artifact.open_question (actor and author qa-agent, in the execution session, affecting the task and its story), the pr.gate_changed goes out with esperandoUsuario: true and the openQuestionId (it is through it that the screen shows the task as "waiting for you"), and the response returns nextAction: "await_user" with the openQuestionId — the engine parks the cycle (ADR 0207) and the answer to the question restarts it (RN-858). No outbox row is born in that outcome. ADR 0214. Where: apps/api/src/domain/execution/pr-gate-state-machine.ts:63 (nextGateStatus), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.ts:135 (esperaUsuario), :171 (nextAction) Test: apps/api/test/domain/execution/pr-gate-state-machine.spec.ts ("needs_user_decision mantém o gate e NÃO incrementa o contador, nem no teto"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.spec.ts ("needs_user_decision no teto: grava a pergunta, não conta correção, não bloqueia"; failure: "needs_user_decision sem pergunta nem openQuestionId é recusado") Origin: AT-521 (the Automação QA failed four times "not confirmed by the user" until the cycle ran out)
documents.s: RN-860 — The QA gate waits for the user without spending the correction cycle

documents.t: Rule: the Criativo, the PO, the Arquiteto and the Dev Lead declare every doubt left for the user with declare_open_question (pergunta up to 500, sugestao up to 300 optional, afeta: {regras, historias, tarefas}), which records artifact.open_question with questionId (uuid), autor and sessionId; an invalid payload is a named refusal and records nothing. The instruction is ONE central sentence, in the flow text of the four (RN-711), never per server. In the QA gate, a requirement "not confirmed by the user" (or contradicted by a current decision) is needs_user_decision, never changes_requested: emit_qa_verdict accepts it only with pergunta or openQuestionId, the QA Lead consolidates it above approved, the verdict goes to the api with the question and the cycle stays PARKED (ADR 0207, gate.rescue_parked, without automatic rescue) until the api asks for resumption through the RN-724 route. The dev-context decisoes enter the dev's kickoff and the QA cut as "Decisões do usuário — vencem RF/DoR quando conflitam" (pergunta → decisao); empty writes nothing. The recorded question counts in the turn's closing (RN-731), and the PO passes question_id in update_story/complete_story when it corrects the story from an answer (ADR 0214). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/declare_open_question.ex:54 (run), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/fluxo_do_time.ex:113 (frase_da_pergunta), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/tools/emit_qa_verdict.ex:77 (run), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead.ex:89 (consolidar_decisao), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:569 (estacionar_por_decisao), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/context_builder.ex:121 (secao_de_decisoes) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/perguntas_em_aberto_test.exs ("válida grava artifact.open_question…"; "inválida é recusa nomeada…"; "consolidação: needs_user_decision vence approved"; "o recorte diz a régua…"; "ContextBuilder: a história leva as decisões…"), apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_lead_server_test.exs ("grava a pergunta na api, estaciona o ciclo e só o gesto humano o retoma") Origin: AT-521, ADR 0214
documents.s: RN-862 — The open question on the engine side: tool, verdict and decision in the context

documents.t: Rule: an HTTP module ALWAYS declares /docs in run.urls (the Swagger UI, kind: "api_docs") even before it exists, and a web module the home page — never a business route; the Infra's kickoff says so in the README step (extends RN-851). The run validation refuses, named and with the SAME yardstick on both sides, an api_docs whose URL does not end in /docs (extends RN-852). The dev's clause says that EVERY HTTP route created or changed in the task enters /openapi.json — path with method, body and responses (extends RN-853).
