In the QA cut, each route of the README's "Rotas HTTP" section must be in paths of the served /openapi.json; a missing route is an item that fails it, never an observation (extends RN-854). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/instrucoes_de_execucao.ex:52 (url), apps/api/src/domain/infra/run-instructions.ts:44 (recusaDoRun), apps/engine/lib/engine/infra/infra_lead_server.ex:1398 (build_kickoff), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:636 (clausula_de_openapi), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/infra/infra_lead_server_test.exs ("run api_docs em rota de negócio é recusado com motivo, sem propor"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-run-instructions.use-case.spec.ts ("recusaDoRun (RN-852)"), apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-853: …"), apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-854: …") Origin: AT-524, ADR 0213
documents.s: RN-863 — api_docs is always /docs, every route enters the OpenAPI, and QA fails the missing one

documents.t: Rule: the chat's pending block gains the "Perguntas em aberto" queue, with its OWN title and count (the api's total, never summed with the other queues — RN-467) and a declared cut when the list comes with a ceiling (RN-180). Each card states the question, the agent that asked, what it affects, the suggestion with "Aceitar sugestão" and a short field with "Responder"; the task the QA gate parked because of the question (RN-860) appears on the card itself as "esperando sua resposta". Only the author of the originating session (autorDaSessao) has the controls; the others see the card with the control inert and the reason in text (ADR 0064). The refusal shows the api's sentence; success rereads the queue and the question leaves. The read does NOT poll: the channel rereads the queue on artifact.open_question, open_question.answered and pr.gate_changed (target perguntas, 2 s window). Next to "Estou pronto" and "Confirmar arquitetura pronta", the composer notifies "N perguntas em aberto" with a shortcut to the queue, reading the SAME query — it only notifies, the buttons stay enabled (ADR 0214). Where: apps/web/src/components/PerguntasEmAberto.tsx:47 (PerguntasEmAberto), :117 (eAutor), :282 (AvisoDePerguntasEmAberto), apps/web/src/lib/canal-vivo.ts:135 (alvosDoEvento) Test: apps/web/src/components/PerguntasEmAberto.test.tsx ("fila própria com contagem própria; o autor responde e aceita a sugestão", "o aviso do composer diz N e não bloqueia nada; some sem perguntas"; failure: "a recusa 409 mostra a frase da api", "quem não é o autor da sessão vê o cartão com o controle inerte e o motivo em texto") Origin: AT-521
documents.s: RN-861 — Open questions are their own queue in the chat, and the readiness notice does not block

documents.t: Rule: a task blocked by the dev agent with origin infra for a TRANSIENT network/provider failure — an explicit allowlist: DNS (EAI_AGAIN, ENOTFOUND, getaddrinfo), ECONNRESET, ETIMEDOUT, aborted, the provider's HTTP 5xx/429 (codes rate_limit/upstream, connection/timeout) — is RESUMED on its own up to 3 times, after 1, 3 and 10 min (owner decision), by an Oban job that calls the SAME unblock as the human (UnblockTaskUseCase, through the internal route .../tasks/:taskId/unblock, actor system, a no-op if the task is no longer blocked). The block's reason says which resumption was scheduled; after the 3rd resumption the next failure stays blocked as before, and the reason says the 3 have already been tried. And the agent PAUSES 1 min instead of taking the next task (the wake is ignored during the pause). Exhausted credit (402, RN-726/730) and code errors do NOT enter: they block right away. The resumption counter is only in memory: restarting the engine resets it. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:133 (passageira?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:982 (bloquear_passageira), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:293 (pausar_por_rede), apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/retomada_de_tarefa_worker.ex:33 (agendar), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/unblock-task.use-case.ts:33 (ator) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs ("falha passageira: agenda a retomada, pausa e não queima a fila", "fim da pausa volta a reivindicar"; failure: "falha passageira depois de 3 retomadas fica bloqueada pedindo o clique", "402 não agenda retomada"), apps/engine/test/engine/workers/retomada_de_tarefa_worker_test.exs Origin: AT-525
documents.s: RN-864 — A transient network failure comes back on its own in up to 3 attempts, and the dev pauses

documents.t: Rule: POST /internal/sessions/:sessionId/gates/verdict with needs_user_decision and openQuestionId checks, BEFORE any write (comment on the PR, gate state, event), that the question exists in the project and is open. Nonexistent or from another project: 404 reason: "pergunta_nao_encontrada". Already answered: 409 reason: "pergunta_ja_respondida" with the user's decision in decisao — without a write and without pr.gate_changed. The state comes from the log (RN-858). Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.ts:85 (exigirPerguntaAberta), apps/api/src/domain/open-questions/pergunta-em-aberto.ts:154 (estadoDaPergunta) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/record-gate-verdict.use-case.spec.ts ("pergunta aberta: estaciona sem gravar outra"; failure: "inexistente ou de outro projeto: 404 nomeado, sem escrita", "já respondida: 409 com a decisão, sem escrita nem pr.gate_changed") Origin: AT-526, ADR 0215
documents.s: RN-870 — The verdict only waits for a question that exists and is open

documents.t: Rule: in the events funnel, an artifact.open_question whose afeta.regras carries the exact TITLE of a project artifact.business_rule is recorded with the rule's id (the most recent, if the title repeats); whatever is neither an id nor an exact title is refused with 400 naming the values. In the dev's context, decisoes also matches by the titles of the story's rules, for the decisions recorded before this rule. Where: apps/api/src/domain/open-questions/pergunta-em-aberto.ts:179 (resolverRegrasDoAfeta), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/sessions/append-session-event.use-case.ts:117 (resolverRegrasDoAfeta), apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:134 (decisoesDoContexto) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/perguntas-em-aberto.use-case.spec.ts ("título exato é convertido para o id da regra"; failure: "texto que não é id nem título de regra: 400 sem escrita"), apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts ("decisão legada com TÍTULO de regra em afeta.regras casa pelo título") Origin: AT-526, ADR 0215
documents.s: RN-871 — afeta.regras accepts the rule's exact title and stores the id

documents.t: Rule: GET /internal/sessions/:sessionId/dev-context returns, besides decisoes (those touching the task, RN-859), decisoesDoProjeto: the other artifact.decision_records of the project, most recent first, in the same format. The ceiling of 10 is SHARED — the task's come first and consume the ceiling before. It revises ADR 0214's sentence "a decision without afeta does not enter" for this list. The field is additive (an engine that does not know it ignores it). Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.ts:134 (decisoesDoContexto), apps/api/src/interfaces/http/internal/dto/internal.response.dto.ts:237 (decisoesDoProjeto) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/execution/get-dev-task-context.use-case.spec.ts ("as que não tocam a tarefa vêm em decisoesDoProjeto; teto de 10 somado, as da tarefa primeiro") Origin: AT-526, ADR 0215
documents.s: RN-872 — The project's other decisions reach the dev and QA, in their own section

documents.t: Rule: the single yardstick of "the task touches the entry point/routes" (toca_ponto_de_entrada?, used by the QA cut and by the dev's clause of RN-853) also matches "endpoint" and an HTTP verb followed by a path (POST /links). Without it, a task described as "Endpoint protegido…" received neither the OpenAPI clause (dev) nor the /openapi.json check (QA) — that is how POST /links and GET /panel stayed out of the OpenAPI with both tasks approved in TP-01. The QA check now requires in paths of the served /openapi.json, besides the routes of the README's "Rotas HTTP" section, every route the CODE registers; a missing one is an item that fails it (extends RN-863). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:103 (@ponto_de_entrada), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:114 (toca_ponto_de_entrada?) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-865: tarefa que diz só endpoint ou verbo com caminho recebe a seção"; failure: "falha: tarefa sem rota não recebe a seção") Origin: AT-527
documents.s: RN-865 — Endpoint and HTTP verb with a path also switch on the OpenAPI check, and it covers the code's routes

documents.t: Rule: gate.rescue_parked has two emitters: the rescue by time (GateRescuer, RN-722), which records idadeSegundos, and QA parked waiting for the answer to an open question, which does not record it. The thread tells the two apart by the PRESENCE of idadeSegundos (the motivo is fixed pt-BR text and is not read as a key): "parado mais de 2 h" only in the rescue by time; in the other, the notice says the gate is waiting for the answer and points to the "Perguntas em aberto" card (RN-861). The "Retomar gate" button (RN-724) stays in both. Where: apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.tsx:18 (cicloEstacionado), apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx (gateEstacionado.avisoPergunta) Test: apps/web/src/routes/RetomarGateEstacionado.test.tsx ("o resgate por tempo grava idadeSegundos e lê como tempo"; failure: "a pergunta em aberto não tem idadeSegundos e não fala em 2 h") Origin: AT-528
documents.s: RN-867 — The parked gate notice states the recorded reason, and the open question points to its card

documents.t: Rule: GateRescueSchedulerWorker reschedules its own successor with the SAME uniqueness as kickoff/0 (states available/scheduled/retryable, without executing, a window of two intervals). Before, only kickoff/0 was unique: the job in execution does not count, so the boot's kickoff with the previous tick in flight, or a retry that reruns perform/1, opened a SECOND chain, and they never merged. Measured in real use (10/14): 11 jobs scheduled at the same time and the RN-722 "espera decisão humana" line 11 times per tick for ONE gate_states row. It was not a data defect. With uniqueness on rescheduling the duplicate chains collapse into one on the next tick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/workers/gate_rescue_scheduler_worker.ex:42 (unicidade) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/workers/gate_rescue_scheduler_worker_test.exs ("o tick se reagenda e mantém a corrente viva"; failure: "com um sucessor já agendado, o tick não abre uma segunda corrente") Origin: AT-529
documents.s: RN-868 — The gate rescue tick is a single chain

documents.t: Rule: every PO turn carries, as an EPHEMERAL system message appended by the EngineApiClient facade right after the team flow (RN-711) — never in state.messages nor in the server's prompt —, the user's decisions (artifact.decision_record, choice and context) and the STILL open questions of the project (artifact.open_question without open_question.answered with the same questionId), from ALL sessions. The text says to write the decided ANSWER into the story, rule, DoR, DoD and task, never "pergunta em aberto N"; a still open question is cited by its questionId, without inventing an answer. The read is LOCAL (direct Postgres, without HTTP in the loop), of the 200 most recent events of those types, with a ceiling of 10 decisions, 10 questions, 240 characters per item and 3,000 in the text. Without a decision or an open question, or with the read failing, the turn goes on without the message, never crashes. Only po receives it. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/decisoes_do_projeto.ex:34 (anexar), :49 (texto), apps/engine/lib/engine/session_events/event.ex:224 (list_types_for_project), apps/engine/lib/engine/sessions/engine_api_client.ex:707 (DecisoesDoProjeto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/decisoes_do_projeto_test.exs ("o turno do PO leva a decisão e só a pergunta AINDA aberta", "custo de entrada tem teto"; failure: "sem decisões nem perguntas não acrescenta nada", "leitura que falha deixa o turno sem a mensagem, sem queda")
documents.s: RN-874 — The PO receives in the turn the user's decisions and the project's open questions

documents.t: Rule: the QA gate only PARKS (gate.rescue_parked) when the api accepts the needs_user_decision verdict with nextAction: "await_user". If the api REFUSES (400, 404, or the 409 pergunta_ja_respondida), the refusal goes back to the Automação QA's loop as a new message (RN-163: an error is loop input), resuming the SAME context in which it emitted — on the 409, with the decision already taken for QA to apply instead of asking again. The other delegations do not run again. The return counts toward its own loop's iteration ceiling; once exhausted, the task is blocked with the reason and origin modelo (RN-059), never silently parked. Before, the api's return was discarded and the gate parked without a question in the thread (measured: openQuestionId: "1", a 400 from @IsUUID). The emit_qa_verdict tool refuses, INSIDE the loop and before the api, an openQuestionId that is not a uuid. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:575 (devolver_ao_qa), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:308 (devolver_ao_qa), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_lead_server.ex:671 (texto_da_recusa), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_automacao_agent.ex:77 (devolver), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/tools/emit_qa_verdict.ex:75 (uuid) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_lead_server_test.exs ("400: nada estaciona, o QA recebe o motivo e uma nova volta acontece"; "409 no laço: a volta seguinte do QA lê a decisão"; failure: "teto esgotado depois da recusa: bloqueio narrado, nunca estacionamento"), apps/engine/test/engine/harness/perguntas_em_aberto_test.exs ("AT-526 (RN-876): openQuestionId que não é uuid é recusa nomeada; uuid passa") Origin: AT-526
documents.s: RN-876 — A needs_user_decision refused by the api goes back to QA, and only acceptance parks the gate

documents.t: Rule: the QA cut's instruction says that, before needs_user_decision, it checks the listed decisions; a requirement that one of them already answers is not a question and the decision applies. openQuestionId only with the uuid of an OPEN question; without it, the new question goes in pergunta/sugestao. It is a reading reminder: it does not change the verdict yardstick. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("AT-526 (RN-877): manda conferir as decisões antes de needs_user_decision"; the instruction's failure is covered by the RN-876 test of the tool) Origin: AT-526
documents.s: RN-877 — The QA cut says to check the decisions before asking for a decision

documents.t: Rule: when the task touches the entry point or routes, the dev's clause says that an absolute URL returned by the deliverable's API (e.g. the short link) comes from PUBLIC_BASE_URL or from the request's Host WITH the port — never a fixed http://localhost nor the hostname without a port —, and that the same error case responds with the same code on all routes. The QA cut checks both things and treats the divergence (e.g. not_found × link_not_found) as an ITEM. Owner decision of 10/14: a general rule. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:644 (clausula_de_openapi); apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:122 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-879/880: tarefa que toca rotas leva URL com porta, code único e CORS" and the failure "RN-879/880 falha: tarefa sem rota não recebe CORS nem PUBLIC_BASE_URL"); apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-879/880: URL, code de erro e CORS") Origin: AT-531
documents.s: RN-879 — The deliverable's absolute URL with the port, and the same code for the same error

documents.t: Rule: in the same clause, the deliverable's API answers CORS with origins from CORS_ORIGINS (default http://localhost:<porta> and http://127.0.0.1:<porta>), OPTIONS 204 and Access-Control-Allow-* with Authorization and Content-Type; /openapi.json declares servers only relative (/) — an absolute URL would create the CORS error when the page is opened through another host —, and swagger-ui from a CDN goes with an exact version, never @5. The QA proves it with a preflight from another origin (curl -X OPTIONS) and fails it without the headers, with absolute servers or with the floating CDN. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:644 (clausula_de_openapi); apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:122 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: the same as RN-879 (happy path and failure in both files) Origin: AT-532
documents.s: RN-880 — The deliverable answers configurable CORS, with relative servers and a pinned swagger-ui

documents.t: Rule: the decisoesDoProjeto the api returns in dev-context (RN-872, ADR 0215, already with a ceiling) becomes the section "Outras decisões do projeto", separate and AFTER the task's decisions, in the dev's story unit and in the QA cut. Empty or absent writes nothing; the engine applies no ceiling of its own. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/context_builder.ex:133 (secao_de_decisoes_do_projeto); apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:20 (texto) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/context_builder_test.exs ("RN-881: decisoesDoProjeto vira a seção..." and "RN-881 falha: sem decisoesDoProjeto a seção some"); apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-881: outras decisões do projeto") Origin: AT-526 (slice F4, engine side)
documents.s: RN-881 — The engine prints the project's other decisions for the dev and QA

documents.t: Rule: revises RN-880 (which still holds for the rest). The default of the deliverable's CORS_ORIGINS uses the PUBLISHED port — APP_PORT, which the compose passes to the app —, never the internal PORT: in TP-01 (16th) the default came out with PORT=3000 and, with the compose publishing 8080, no real origin received Access-Control-Allow-Origin (measured with curl: :3000 receives, :8080 does not; in Chrome, Failed to fetch). QA runs the preflight against the PUBLISHED port, once for http://localhost:<APP_PORT> and again for http://127.0.0.1:<APP_PORT>, and fails it without the Access-Control-Allow-Origin header — a 204 alone is not enough, and CORS only on the internal port is an ITEM. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:644 (clausula_de_openapi); apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa.ex:122 (secao_do_ponto_de_entrada) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/report_done_instrucao_test.exs ("RN-885: o padrão do CORS usa a porta PUBLICADA, nunca a interna"; failure: "RN-879/880 falha: tarefa sem rota não recebe CORS nem PUBLIC_BASE_URL"); apps/engine/test/engine/gates/recorte_da_tarefa_test.exs ("RN-885: o preflight é na porta PUBLICADA, nas duas origens, e confere o header") Origin: AT-535
documents.s: RN-885 — The deliverable's CORS uses the PUBLISHED port, and QA checks the header on both origins

documents.t: Rule: OpenRouter's 403 with Budget limit exceeded / limit_source: openrouter_guardrail_budget (the key's monthly guardrail) is NOT a rejected credential: the api normalizes it into the SAME insufficient_credit as the 402 (RN-730) — without a new code in the contract — and the rest of the credit path applies the same: origin infra (RN-726), a pause without automatic resumption (never transient, RN-864). The short sentence, in the turn's language (RN-733), states the limit, the spend and the reset read from the body (limit_usd, spend_usd, resets_at, whatever comes) and asks the OpenRouter admin to raise the budget; the dev blocks the task with that sentence in the reason, instead of "parou sem concluir nem reportar bloqueio" with origin codigo. A 403 without the marker stays auth. Where: apps/api/src/domain/llm/llm-provider-errors.ts:81 (normalizeHttpStatus), :135 (pareceOrcamento); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:205 (orcamento_esgotado), :219 (frase_de_orcamento), :163 (credito_esgotado?); apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:961 (motivo_de_credito) Test: apps/api/test/domain/llm/llm-provider-errors.spec.ts ("o 403 de orçamento vira insufficient_credit com o corpo inteiro"; failure: "403 sem marcador de orçamento continua credencial rejeitada"); apps/engine/test/engine/agents/falha_de_turno_test.exs ("RN-886: o 403 de orçamento do OpenRouter") Origin: AT-534
documents.s: RN-886 — OpenRouter's budget 403 is exhausted credit, with limit, spend and reset

documents.t: Rule: in the execution agents' turns WITHOUT a human author (dev-*, qa-*), RN-622's language guidance says it applies from the FIRST sentence, including the narration before each tool, and loses the caveat "unless the user asks" (there is no user in the turn). Measured in session 6c68fbc0 (pt-BR project, anthropic/claude-haiku-5.5): the guidance arrived, and even so iteration 0 of qa-automacao and of dev-encurtador-api opened in English ("I'll start by running…"). The path is still ONE (the facade, RN-622): nothing in a server prompt, agent_instructions or tool description (RN-667). The 50-token ceiling (AT-169) holds: measured with gpt-tokenizer, pt-BR 32/26, en 19/19 and the generic one with a short-form code in the worst case 30/30 (cl100k/o200k); a code outside the short form falls back to the usual guidance, which already fit. A turn with an author and the conversational agents do not change. Without a resolved language, nothing is added. Effectiveness is measured in the next TP-01. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/idioma_da_resposta.ex:164 (orientacao_de_execucao), :154 (agente_de_execucao?) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/idioma_da_resposta_test.exs ("agente de execução: vale desde a primeira frase, dentro do teto"; failure: "agente de execução sem idioma resolvido: nada é acrescentado") Origin: AT-530
documents.s: RN-878 — The execution agent's language applies from the first sentence

documents.t: Rule: the composer field owns ITS OWN value while typing: the drawn value is the local state, updated in onChange, and the page's draft receives each value (send, queue and buttons keep reading from it). A late draft that comes back as a prop NEVER rewrites the field — only a value the field did not emit is adopted (clearing after sending, the text returned on failure, the invitation's example). Before, the <textarea> was controlled directly by the SessionPage's draft, and the page's late re-render rewrote the field with an older value: 991 of 1,010 characters in TP-01, with an ordinary textarea on the same page receiving 249/249. Enter, Shift+Enter and accent composition (RN-830) do not change. Where: apps/web/src/components/CampoDoComposer.tsx:21 (CampoDoComposer); apps/web/src/routes/SessionComposer.tsx Test: apps/web/src/components/CampoDoComposer.test.tsx ("digitação rápida com a página atrasada não perde tecla nenhuma"; failure/edge case: "a escrita de fora (esvaziar depois do envio) é adotada pelo campo") Origin: AT-533
documents.s: RN-882 — The Session composer does not lose keystrokes during fast typing

documents.t: Rule: with the session active and with execution (sessaoTemExecucao), the chat shows the SAME batch offer as the Executores tab (RN-661) — the same component, the same endpoint (one PUT per agent), the same text about what auto mode does not unlock, and nothing is recorded without the click. The agents are the dev-<modulo> that joined the whole session plus the gate subagents (agentesDaOfertaEmLote); role maintainer (the endpoint's). Without execution, nothing appears and agent_autonomy is not even read. It disappears when all are already in auto. Where: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoNoChat.tsx:41 (ModoAutomaticoNoChat), :18 (agentesDoChat) Test: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoNoChat.test.tsx ("caminho feliz: com execução, a oferta aparece e só o clique grava"; failure: "sem execução, nada aparece e nem a leitura acontece") Origin: AT-537
documents.s: RN-883 — The auto mode batch offer also in the Session chat

documents.t: Rule: a question answered through the chat's "Perguntas em aberto" panel (RN-861) stays as an answered card until dismissed, and each story of afeta.historias that the backlog brings gets "Corrigir a história" when it is still correctable by RN-727's yardstick (draft, no in_progress/in_review task, role developer) — the link leads to the Histórias tab with it open (?historia=). It does not trigger the PO (owner decision, 10/14). Not correctable: the link does not exist and the reason is stated in text (RN-102). The yardstick is the SAME function as the Histórias tab's, moved to lib/. Where: apps/web/src/components/PerguntasEmAberto.tsx:222 (CartaoRespondido); apps/web/src/lib/correcao-de-historia.ts (motivoDeCorrecaoInerte); apps/web/src/routes/ProjectBacklogTab.tsx:398 (useHistoriaInicial) Test: apps/web/src/components/PerguntasRespondidas.test.tsx ("caminho feliz: história draft sem tarefa em execução ganha o link para a aba Histórias"; failure: "com tarefa em execução o botão não existe e o motivo é dito em texto") Origin: AT-538
documents.s: RN-884 — The answered question offers "Corrigir a história"

documents.t: Rule: a blocked task stays todo/in_progress with tasks.blocked = true (and blocked_reason/blocked_origin) — there is no blocked status in the enum, by owner decision (10/14). Whoever COUNTS or SHOWS a task reads both fields, and blocked wins over status: the Histórias tab shows the "Bloqueada" badge (danger tone) with the reason in text, and the others by status (to do, in progress, in review, done); the backlog task list that the Dev Lead reads marks the row with | BLOQUEADA: <motivo, até 120 caracteres>, and the task stays in the list. Claim, unblock and resumption do not change. Where: apps/web/src/lib/execution.ts:10 (estadoDaTarefa); apps/web/src/routes/ProjectBacklogTab.tsx (the task list badge); apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools.ex:410 (bloqueio) Test: apps/web/src/lib/execution.test.ts ("blocked vence o status"; failure: "sem bloqueio, o status"); apps/web/src/routes/ProjectBacklogTab.test.tsx ("a bloqueada mostra "Bloqueada" e o motivo, sem o selo "a fazer""); apps/engine/test/engine/agents/dev_lead_tools_test.exs ("a tarefa bloqueada diz BLOQUEADA e o motivo; a todo normal não") Origin: AT-536
documents.s: RN-887 — The task block is orthogonal to the status, and whoever shows it reads both

documents.t: Rule: extends RN-883. Approving the Dev Lead's plan creates the EXECUTION session, separate from the Criativo's, and it is in the Criativo's chat that the user drives. The batch offer (RN-661) appears in the chat of every ACTIVE session when the PROJECT has execution — roster.executionActivated of the projects summary (the most recent session, the execution one), the SAME read and queryKey the chat already made (useAtivosNoProjeto, RN-633), with no new query nor new poll. The dev agents from there (roster.activatedAgents) add to this session's. Same component, same endpoint, same text, nothing recorded without the click, it waits to know who is already switched on (RN-803) and disappears with the whole team in auto. Without execution in the project, nothing appears and agent_autonomy is not even read. Declared gap: the signal is the most recent session's roster.executionActivated, which says it HAD execution.activated, not that it is still open; with the execution session already closed, the offer still appears in the Criativo's chat — declared, not fixed, because telling them apart would require a new read (the request budget). Where: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoNoChat.tsx:29 (ofertaDoChat); apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.ts:174 (useExecucaoNoProjeto) Test: apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoNoChat.test.tsx ("caminho feliz: execução ativa noutra sessão do projeto, time em manual — a oferta aparece no chat do Criativo"; failures: "time todo já em automático: nada aparece", "sem execução no projeto: nada aparece e nem a leitura acontece") Origin: AT-540
documents.s: RN-889 — The auto mode batch offer appears in the chat of any active session of a project in execution

documents.t: Rule: the Automação QA's instruction says to check, in the test that proves a command-line command of the delivery (CLI, package.json script), the exit code 0 on the happy path and non-zero when the command refuses the input; a test without that check on refusal is a rule without coverage and goes to itens. The QA-strategy instruction asks, in criteriosExecutaveis, for these two criteria for every command that refuses input. It is an agent instruction: no new gate, no change of verdict or structure. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_automacao_agent.ex:142 (instrucao_de_codigo_de_saida), apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/qa_estrategia_agent.ex:129 (instrucao_de_codigo_de_saida) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_automacao_agent_test.exs ("a instrução cobra código de saída 0 no feliz e diferente de 0 na recusa"); apps/engine/test/engine/gates/qa_estrategia_agent_test.exs ("os arquivos da entrega entram na mensagem") Origin: AT-542 (TP-01, 17th: npm run user:create refused the password and exited with 0)
documents.s: RN-890 — QA demands the command-line exit code, on refusal too

documents.t: Rule: the interface language (users.locale) accepts pt-BR, en, ru and zh-Hans, and refuses any other; the account default stays pt-BR. In the web, pt-BR is the default and the fallbackLng (revises RN-432, which made en the web default). The choice recorded in the account always wins; without it, the browser suggests: pt* → pt-BR; zh, zh-CN, zh-SG, zh-Hans* → zh-Hans; ru* → ru; en* → en; the rest (German, traditional Chinese…) → pt-BR. A locale without a catalog in locales/ does not break boot: the screen falls back to pt-BR and the Account selector, with the native labels, says "tradução em andamento". <html lang> follows the active language. Key parity compares each existing locale with the pt-BR source. Where: apps/api/src/domain/iam/user.entity.ts:8 (USER_LOCALES), apps/web/src/lib/idioma.ts:65 (resolverIdiomaDoNavegador), apps/web/src/lib/i18n.ts:72 (fallbackLng) Test: apps/api/test/interfaces/http/iam/user-preferences-locale.dto.spec.ts ("aceita pt-BR, en, ru e zh-Hans"; "recusa idioma fora da lista"); apps/web/src/lib/idioma.test.ts ("idioma sem catálogo cai no pt-BR, nunca no inglês"); apps/web/src/lib/i18n-paridade.test.ts Origin: AT-548, ADR 0216 (items 1–4)
documents.s: RN-891 — The interface has four languages, with pt-BR as default and fallback

documents.t: Rule: the PO's kickoff instruction (with or without an event log) carries a third obligation: every RF that receives a value provided by the user (date, number, text, list, limit) declares, in the RF and the DoD, whether the edge — past/future, zero, empty, negative, the limit itself — is ACCEPTED or REFUSED (with the HTTP status/error); the example is an expiration in the past. When unsure, the PO calls declare_open_question with afeta.historias and a suggestion, never inventing or omitting. A PROMPT rule, in the mold of RN-790: no tool refuses a story without an edge. The PO does NOT start rewriting business_rule; Creative, QA, schema and gate do not change. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:649 (obrigacoes) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:438 (the kickoff instruction carries the edge obligation) and :460 (without an event log, the kickoff still carries it) Origin: AT-541 (TP-01 of 10/14: the deliverable accepted expiresAt in the past and the link was born expired, 410; the story's RF only said the expiration is optional), owner's decision of 10/15
documents.s: RN-893 — The PO declares the edge of the provided value in the RF and the DoD

documents.t: Rule: create_epic refuses (400) an epic whose normalized title equals that of another epic in the SAME project, and the refusal returns the existing id to the model: "Já existe o épico «título» (id …) neste projeto — use este id em epic_id". The rule is the SAME as the story's (finding R, tituloDuplicado), with no second copy. The SEMANTIC duplicate check (RN-681) does not apply to epics: only an equal title. Nothing is created or written to the event log when it refuses. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/backlog/create-epic.use-case.ts:25 (tituloDuplicado) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/backlog/create-epic.use-case.spec.ts:41 (creates without an equal title) and :49 (refuses the equal title with the existing id) Origin: AT-581
documents.s: RN-894 — An epic with the same title as another in the project is refused

documents.t: Rule: revises RN-719 and RN-725. A field declared array/object that arrives as non-JSON text, or as a number/boolean/wrong type, is refused before the tool with "the field X arrived as ; send ", with an example (["item 1","item 2"], {"chave":"valor"}), never with the value. The emit_plano_de_teste sentence now puts the keys in backticks, so the refusal carries the received keys. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta.ex:80 (coagir); apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/tools/emit_plano_de_teste.ex:73 (run) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta_test.exs:193 and :201 (the format and the received type) and :210 (the received keys) Origin: AT-583 (TP-01 18th and 19th: dod arrived as a markdown checklist and the test plan was refused 4 times without saying what came)
documents.s: RN-895 — The argument refusal says what arrived and the expected format

documents.t: Rule: create_story refuses an epic_id that is not a UUID ("epic_id inválido; …"). When the PO already created epics in this process (epicos_conhecidos) and the id is not among them, it rereads the backlog ONCE (list_backlog): if the id is there, it accepts; otherwise it refuses listing the backlog's id=title (cap of 20 lines, stating the total if truncated, ADR 0060). An empty map or a failing backlog read means "unknown" and does not refuse — the api decides. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/create_story.ex:57 (epico_valido) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/argumentos_de_ferramenta_test.exs:224 and :233 Origin: AT-584 (qwen sent EPIC_ID_PLACEHOLDER_NAO_USAR_AQUI and the api answered with the DTO name)
documents.s: RN-896 — The epic_id is validated before the api

documents.t: Rule: the agent.error of the qa-estrategia, qa-automacao, qa-performance-seguranca and appsec gates classifies "Tool calls cutoff by max_tokens" as modelo (the reasoning ate the cap, RN-059); any other LLM error stays infra. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/gates/origem_do_erro.ex:10 (de_llm) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/gates/origem_do_erro_test.exs:7 Origin: AT-586 (BaseTen 502 recorded as infra)
documents.s: RN-897 — A provider cut by max_tokens in a gate is origin modelo

documents.t: Rule: a conversational agent turn whose last LLM response was cut by the output cap (RN-737) and wrote no text in any round does NOT close silently: the line "Response cut off by the length limit." becomes the closing agent.response with modelName, and the bubble shows "Continue where it left off" (RN-749). It covers the seven conversational agents. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/texto_do_turno.ex:65 (payload_do_turno) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/resposta_cortada_test.exs:104 Origin: AT-570 (TP-01 18th)
documents.s: RN-898 — A response cut by the cap with no text closes the turn, stated

documents.t: Rule: a conversational loop closing with no text, no tool and no cut records agent.error with origin modelo and "the model returned no response" (FalhaDeTurno), in the seven servers. It is an agent utterance for the heartbeat (RN-581); per-tab project presence does NOT enter (RN-064). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/falha_de_turno.ex:63 (origem), apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:303 (gravar_texto_do_turno) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:194 and apps/engine/test/engine/agents/texto_do_turno_test.exs:96 Origin: AT-572 (TP-01 18th, finding 4)
documents.s: RN-899 — An empty response without a cut becomes an agent.error of origin model

documents.t: Rule: write_file replaces the whole file. When the path is a README (README*), the current file has the ## Rodar na sua máquina section and the new content does not, the tool refuses with a named error and writes nothing. Changing a fragment requires rewriting the full README, keeping the section. The title is one constant (titulo_secao_de_uso/0), also used by the Infra and dev prompts, so the refusal and the instruction do not diverge. It is not a gate: the refusal belongs to the tool itself and does not cover writes by terminal (cat >, sed -i). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/write_file.ex:62 (recusa_de_secao_perdida) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/write_file_test.exs:41 (a rewrite without the section is refused and the file stays intact); the happy path is covered by the first two tests in the same file Origin: AT-571 (TP-01 18th run of 10/19: the dev agent rewrote the README while fixing a QA finding and the usage section the Infra had written was lost; no gate noticed)
documents.s: RN-900 — write_file refuses to rewrite the README and drop the Infra's usage section

documents.t: Rule: extends RN-889. roster.activatedAgents of the project summary NEVER carries a dev agent: the dev does not record agent.activated, only dev.started. The chat's batch offer (RN-883/889) read only that list and did not list the dev-<module> of the active execution, which the user had to turn on from the Executors tab. The project execution (execucaoDoRoster) now adds, only with roster.executionActivated, the dev-<module> of roster.moduleNames (the current module_map), through the SAME devAgentId the Executors tab uses (RN-661, rosterFromFacts), with no new derivation. Without an active execution no dev enters. Declared gap: the list comes from the CURRENT module_map; if the approved plan used a subset of the modules, the offer inherits that divergence. No ceiling moves and nothing is written without the click. Where: apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.ts:194 (execucaoDoRoster), called by useExecucaoNoProjeto (apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.ts:175) Test: apps/web/src/lib/session-destinatario.test.ts ("CAMINHO FELIZ: execução ativa soma o dev- do module_map aos ativados"; failure: "sem execução ativa, o módulo do plano NÃO vira dev agent"), and apps/web/src/components/ModoAutomaticoNoChat.test.tsx (fixture derived from the real roster, "caminho feliz") Origin: AT-573 (TP-01 18th, 19/10: the 1st task stopped at dev.awaiting_approval because the dev was not in auto mode)
documents.s: RN-901 — The auto mode batch offer in the chat includes the dev agents of the approved plan

documents.t: Rule: the removed → provisioning and failed → provisioning transitions RE-READ the current image decision and rewrite imageVersion and resources on the project_containers row (before, only creating the row froze them, and the Image column stayed on the old version after Remove → Start). With no current decision it is a 409 (RN-105). stopped → running does NOT change the version: the reused container is the old one. The /containers page gains decisaoVigente and imagemDesatualizada per row — the divergence compares CONTENT (image, network, resources), never the version number, because the Infra election writes v+1 with the same content on every start — and, with a diverging running/stopped/provisioning container, the row says in text "Stop → Remove → Start again" and says why "Start again" does not apply the new image. The choose_project_image result carries containerDePe and its text warns that the decision only applies once the container is recreated. A one-action "Recreate" does NOT exist; no approval ceiling changes (RN-495). Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/containers/registrar-transicao-de-container.use-case.ts:131 (recongelar), apps/api/src/domain/containers/project-container.ts:342 (containerDivergeDaDecisao), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/choose_project_image.ex:99 (mensagem_de_fixada) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/containers/ciclo-de-vida-do-container.use-case.spec.ts; apps/api/test/domain/containers/project-container.spec.ts; apps/api/test/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/containers-overview.repository.spec.ts; apps/web/src/routes/ContainersPage.test.tsx; apps/engine/test/engine/harness/tools/choose_project_image_test.exs Origin: AT-595 (TP-01 20th: the v3 egress decision did not reach the v2 none container and the Image column stayed on v2)
documents.s: RN-902 — Recreating the container freezes the current image decision, and an outdated image is flagged

documents.t: Rule: a task the dev agent blocks because the model answered 429 (code rate_limit, or text with (429) or "limite de uso") says in the reason "limite de uso do modelo atingido (429)", and the automatic retry says that, if it repeats, the dev agent's model should be changed. It never says "falha passageira de rede" (transient network failure). The origin stays infra and the RN-864 retry does not change (up to 3, after 1, 3 and 10 min; a 60 s pause, which dev.idle names as "depois de limite de uso do modelo"). A network failure keeps its usual text. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:1136 (limite_de_uso?), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:1127 (motivo_da_parada), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/dev_agent_server.ex:997 (bloquear_passageira), apps/engine/lib/engine/dev/agent_io.ex:293 (pausar_por_rede) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/dev/dev_agent_server_test.exs ("429 do provider: o motivo diz limite de uso do modelo, não rede"; failure: "falha de rede continua com o texto de rede, não de limite") Origin: AT-594 (TP-01 20th, 10/19: the 429 of laguna-s-2.1:free blocked the tasks as "falha passageira de rede", while the diagnosis said usage limit)
documents.s: RN-903 — The provider's 429 is the model's usage limit, not a network failure

documents.t: Rule: when Jev restricts the menu and the model answers WITHOUT a tool, the step is repeated ONCE with the full catalog (RN-625) — except when the response was CUT by the output ceiling (truncated). The cut is not a menu error: retrying with the full catalog would only enlarge the prompt and spend another output ceiling. It applies to both facades (llm_turn and llm_turn_stream, the latter only without text already delivered). The RN-780 retry in ToolLoop handles the cut and does not change. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/roteamento_de_ferramenta.ex:126 (repetir_com_catalogo_inteiro?) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/harness/roteamento_de_ferramenta_test.exs:274 (an empty cut response is not repeated, in both paths; without a cut it is) Origin: AT-578 (EP-026, survey of 10/21): the PO's first turn in the 18th round spent two 8192-token output rounds.
documents.s: RN-904 — The output-ceiling cut is not repeated with the full catalog

documents.t: Rule: when a conversational agent stops at the step limit, the ceiling event (toolloop.limit_reached; for the Creative, the agent.error with reason: "limite_de_iteracoes") carries gravado, the RN-731 line read BEFORE the turn text is written (it goes there and not in the agent.response, never in both). The PO also carries regrasSemHistoria, the uncoveredCount that fechar_handoff already reads; a failed read leaves the key absent, never an error. The thread shows the reason without jargon, the recorded line, the rules without a story and the "Continue where you left off" button (RN-749, a user message that the RN-673 queue absorbs while a turn runs) only for the seven conversational agents with the session active; dev-*/qa-* get the text, with no button. The button never continues on its own. Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:257 (run_turn); apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.tsx:976 (conversacional) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:548 (gravado and regrasSemHistoria; without the read, no key); apps/web/src/routes/session-timeline-montagem.falha-de-turno.test.tsx:108 (bubble, button to the same agent; no button for dev-* and inactive session) Origin: AT-590 (EP-031).
documents.s: RN-905 — The step ceiling says what was recorded and what is missing, and offers to continue

documents.t: Rule: when deciding the project image, if the network is none and any module of the current module_map has a stack that matches, as a whole word, the closed list of ecosystems that download dependencies (node, npm, pnpm, yarn, python, pip, elixir, mix, go, rust, cargo, ruby, java, maven, gradle, php, dotnet...), the API answers 400 naming the module, the stack and the term, and asks for egress. Nothing is written and the network is never switched on its own: egress is the user's authorization. It applies to the Architect (choose_project_image) and to the Infra election, which go through the same use case (for Infra, container_start ends failed with the reason, without calling the broker). With no module_map, or a stack that does not match, only the RN-735 warning remains. No configurable exception. Revises RN-735 (warning → refusal in that case). Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/containers/decidir-imagem-do-projeto.use-case.ts:80 (stackQueBaixaDependencias) Test: apps/api/test/application/use-cases/containers/container-do-projeto.use-case.spec.ts; apps/api/test/domain/containers/project-container.spec.ts; apps/api/test/application/use-cases/actions/execute-container-start.use-case.spec.ts Origin: AT-593 (EP-031).
documents.s: RN-906 — The API refuses network none when a module's stack downloads dependencies

documents.t: Rule: the PO kickoff tells the model, in this order: read listar_regras_de_negocio and listar_backlog in the same response, with no write alongside; then all epics in one response; then all stories, using the epic_id returned; then all tasks, using the story_id returned. Never recreate an epic that already exists, and at most about 10 tool calls per response. Measured reason: without the batch request, nemotron makes 1 tool per response and qwen makes 3; with it, 9 each (parallel_tool_calls changed nothing). Reading first is what stops qwen from creating epics without reading the backlog. It does not change the @max_iterations ceiling (RN-166). Where: apps/engine/lib/engine/agents/po_server.ex:614 (build_kickoff) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/agents/po_server_test.exs:518 (read before write; batch by layer: epics → stories → tasks) Origin: probe of AT-591 (21/10), implemented in AT-596 (EP-026).
documents.s: RN-908 — The PO kickoff asks for the backlog in batches, after reading, by layer

documents.t: Rule: the 9router provider talks to a gateway on the owner's machine. The base URL is NINE_ROUTER_BASE_URL (default http://host.docker.internal:20128/v1), read on each use by the provider and by the connection test (GET /models with the key). The credential is mandatory. The provider capabilities are false (only listModels and streaming, required by the contract, are true) until a smoke with a key proves the rest (ADR 0041). Model prices are not discovered: they enter by manual curation and, by the owner's decision, a subscription model records the equivalent API's public price, not zero. The provider sends x-9router-token-saver: off on every call, so 9Router does not compress the tool_result. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/llm/nine-router-provider.ts:83 (nineRouterConfig) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/llm/nine-router-provider.contract.spec.ts:109 (capabilities, URL from the environment, header, connection test, synthetic fixture parse); manual smoke in nine-router-provider.smoke.spec.ts. Origin: AT-576a (EP-026), ADR 0222, owner's decision of 22/10.
documents.s: RN-909 — 9Router is the 10th provider: per-installation URL, mandatory credential, public price curated

documents.t: Rule: LLM credentials, the model catalog (curation, prices, sync and the Hugging Face browser) and the spend report per key have left the project Settings. They live in /providers (the three pieces), and the spend per key also in the Spend tab, only for owner (RN-060). The project keeps only the CHOICE: model per agent and per area, the "apply to all" (RN-476), the routing criterion and "best models". The "Who can approve what" matrix has left Settings and is a section of the Account (/account), for anyone logged in. The "Enable and apply to the N agents" shortcut (RN-694 item 3) no longer exists. An old link ?section=credentials, model-catalog, key-spend or approval-matrix opens the tab at the top, without error. The empty state of "Models per agent", the subtitle of "best models" and the First steps (RN-708) point to /providers. Revises RN-694 (item 3) and RN-708 (destinations). No ADR: it is a screen boundary. Where: apps/web/src/routes/settings/sumario.ts:48 (SECOES_DE_CONFIGURACOES), apps/web/src/routes/ProjectSettingsTab.tsx:62 (ProjectSettingsTab), apps/web/src/routes/AccountPage.tsx:36 (AccountPage) Test: apps/web/src/routes/settings/sumario.test.ts (the four keys do not exist); apps/web/src/routes/settings/SumarioDeConfiguracoes.test.tsx (the tab does not mount the four sections, not even for owner); apps/web/src/routes/AccountPage.test.tsx (the matrix, and the failure case in the language); apps/web/src/routes/configuracoes.orcamento.test.tsx (returning to the tab does not fetch the credential); apps/web/src/components/catalogo-com-busca.test.tsx (no shortcut) Origin: AT-597 and AT-598 (EP-031), owner's requests of 22/10.
documents.s: RN-911 — The provider is global; project Settings only choose a model; the matrix lives in the Account

documents.t: Rule: the "Area model" section no longer exists. The area default (RN-102, the area scope of RN-470) is linked by a box only on the lead's line of each area (dev-lead, qa, infra): "Apply to the whole X area (lead + subagents)". The area binding is one value per area and does not store the source agent, so a box on every line would have two competing for the value. Checked ⇔ the lead's effective value comes from the area (origin: 'area'), read from the batch of RN-654, with no new query. Checking writes the area with the lead's effective value and the lead's routing criterion (PUT .../area-bindings/:area) and THEN deletes the lead's own binding (DELETE .../agent-bindings/:lead; copying it would leave it behind, RN-102). These are two calls and the outcome is per step (RN-469): if the area refuses (including the 422 of RN-040) nothing changed and the toast carries the API's phrase; if the area was written and the DELETE fails, the screen says the area default was written and the lead's own model was not removed (a 404 on the DELETE counts as already removed). Unchecking deletes the area (DELETE .../area-bindings/:area) and writes nothing to the lead; a 404 becomes "already inherited". With the box checked, the lead's selector and routing criterion write the AREA. An agent with its own binding overrides the area (RN-470) and does NOT follow: the screen lists, in plural, the known subagents in that situation (declared scope, RN-180; the dynamic dev-<modulo> ones are not included and the screen says so) and does not delete their decision. The "apply to all" (RN-476) writes its own binding to the 17 and, for that reason, takes the subagents off the area default; its notice says so. Role: the box and, while checked, the lead's selector require maintainer (the minimum of the area endpoint, RN-102), compared by roleAtLeast; below that they stay inert and the reason is said ONCE in text in the section legend (ADR 0064). The other lines remain at developer. The box is born disabled if the lead has no effective value to copy, and it says the reason in text on the box itself (AT-601, key modelsSection.areaBox.needsModel). Revises the UI of RN-040, RN-102 and RN-470; the cascade, the scope and the endpoints do not change (no ADR). Where: apps/web/src/routes/settings/ModelsSection.tsx:94 (podeEditarArea), :428 (areaDoLead), :446 (handleMarcarArea), :486 (handleDesmarcarArea) Test: apps/web/src/routes/settings/ModelsSection.caixa-da-area.test.tsx (AT-601: reason when the lead has no effective value); apps/web/src/routes/ProjectSettingsTab.test.tsx (checking, the area refusing, PARTIAL FAILURE, unchecking with and without a 404, the lead's selector on the area, non-followers, developer inert); apps/web/src/routes/settings/papel-na-tabela-de-agentes.test.tsx (the two minimums); bindings-em-lote.test.tsx (single batch); cascata.test.tsx; heranca.test.tsx; filtro-de-aptos.test.tsx (RN-040); preferencia-de-roteamento.test.tsx (ADR 0166) Origin: AT-600 (EP-031), owner's request of 22/10.
documents.s: RN-912 — The area model is a box on the lead's line, under "Models per agent"

documents.t: These RNs came out of business-rules.md without changing a comma of the content: the single page was over 640 KB and these two sections alone were half of it. The #rn-NNN anchors remain identical — only the file that hosts them changed. First-party auth rules. All of them hold in the api domain, which since 7.2 is also the issuer of access tokens — Keycloak left in an atomic cut, with no coexistence period. Decisions in ADR 0031 and ADR 0032.
documents.s: Authentication

documents.t: Each refresh consumes the presented token and issues a child with the same family_id and the same family_started_at. Presenting a token that was already consumed is the signature of a theft — someone is using a copy — and the response is to revoke every live token of that family, with a security event. The legitimate user is logged out along with it. That is the correct behavior, not a defect: on the server side, a client double-submit and a thief's replay are identical. Where: apps/api/src/domain/auth/refresh-token.ts:50 + application/use-cases/auth/refresh.use-case.ts:98 Test: test/application/use-cases/auth/rotacao-e-reuso.spec.ts Edge case: whoever presents a token from an already revoked family is a downstream victim, not a new theft: it records refresh_revoked and does not fire a second cascade. Without that distinction, each tab of the legitimate user would raise a false alarm during the incident. Origin: ADR 0031
documents.s: RN-030 — Presenting an already-used refresh revokes the whole family

documents.t: A 15-minute sliding window in Postgres, without Redis. Two buckets per attempt and the most restrictive wins: e-mail (5 failures → 30s, 8 → 5min, 12 → 15min) and IP (20 → 30s, 30 → 2min). A successful login clears the e-mail bucket; the IP one drains only over time. The bucket key is the normalized e-mail, never the user id. With the id, the bucket would only exist after finding the account, and the lockout itself would become an existence oracle. Where: apps/api/src/domain/auth/lockout-policy.ts:97 + infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/drizzle-login-throttle.ts:74 Test: test/application/use-cases/auth/lockout.spec.ts Edge case: while locked, the attempt is not recorded. If it were, an attacker would keep the victim's account locked forever just by continuing to try — the lockout would become a denial of service against the one it protects. Why: the IP bucket cannot be cleared on success; whoever has a valid account would reset the window at will and spray guesses without limit. Origin: ADR 0031
documents.s: RN-031 — Login failure is counted per e-mail and per IP, and the lockout escalates

documents.t: Any response other than the uniform failure is only reachable after a successful password check. On login, nonexistent e-mail, wrong password and locked account return the same 401 and spend the same time — the no-account branch verifies against a dummy hash generated with the same parameters as the real one. On registration and on the reset request, known and unknown addresses return 202. Where: apps/api/src/application/use-cases/auth/login.use-case.ts:79 + register.use-case.ts:74 Test: test/application/use-cases/auth/enumeracao.spec.ts Edge case: the per-e-mail lockout check runs after argon2, not before. Exiting earlier is the optimization any reviewer would suggest, and it is exactly the leak — the test turns red if someone introduces it. Edge case: the user MIGRATED from Keycloak (exists in users, with no row in auth_credentials) also gets the uniform 401 — and the "set password" link is sent silently. Answering password_pending would confirm that the address exists and that it is a legacy account. That is why findByEmail is a LEFT JOIN in a single query: two chained queries would make this branch pay one extra round trip to the database, and the clock would reveal what the body hides. Why: what is claimed is "no branch skips the expensive work and none produces a distinguishable response", not constant time. See the consequences in the ADR. Origin: ADR 0031, migrated-user edge case in ADR 0032
documents.s: RN-032 — No response distinguishes an existing account from a nonexistent one

documents.t: Consumption by conditional UPDATE with returning: the UPDATE itself is the guard. Zero rows covers nonexistent, of another purpose, already consumed, invalidated and expired — all with the same response. Requesting a new link invalidates the previous one. Completing a reset revokes all of the user's sessions and issues no tokens. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/persistence/drizzle/account-token.repository.ts:76 Test: test/application/use-cases/auth/tokens-de-conta.spec.ts Edge case: two simultaneous submissions do not both pass. The race is the normal case, not the exception: corporate e-mail scanners open every link of every message, so the robot usually consumes the token before the human clicks. Why: the reset issues no session on purpose — logging in directly from a link received by e-mail would make compromising the e-mail equal to taking over the account, with no second step. Origin: ADR 0031
documents.s: RN-033 — Verification and reset tokens are valid only once

documents.t: The refresh token goes in a brabo_refresh cookie (httpOnly, SameSite=Strict, Path=/auth, Secure in production) and does not appear in the body of any response. The access token, of 15 minutes, stays in memory on the client and travels in Authorization: Bearer. /auth/refresh and /auth/logout require X-CSRF-Token equal to the brabo_csrf cookie, compared in constant time. Where: apps/api/src/interfaces/http/auth/session-cookies.ts:53 + interfaces/http/auth/auth.controller.ts Test: test/interfaces/session-cookies.spec.ts Edge case: a CSRF failure is 403, not 401. With 401 the client would try to renew the session and enter a loop — the credential is fine, what is wrong is the request. Why: also returning the refresh in the body would cancel out httpOnly — an XSS reading the login response would be enough, and it would take the long session instead of the 15 minutes of the access token. Origin: ADR 0032
documents.s: RN-034 — The web session lives in an httpOnly cookie, with CSRF

documents.t: The 32 /internal/* routes are @ServiceRoute(): they stay outside the user JWT and outside the rate limit. What authenticates is the EngineServiceGuard, comparing X-Brabo-Service-Token with BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN in constant time. The same secret holds in both directions, and BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS is accepted only on verification, so that rotation has no unavailability window. Where: apps/api/src/interfaces/http/auth/engine-service.guard.ts:44 + infrastructure/security/service-token.ts + apps/engine/lib/engine_web/plugs/verify_service_token.ex Test: apps/engine/test/engine_web/plugs/verify_service_token_test.exs, test/interfaces/route-surface.spec.ts and, for rotation on the api side (previous accepted only on verification, the caller sends the current one, once the previous is removed the old one fails), test/infrastructure/security/service-token.spec.ts (describe "rotação do BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN") and test/interfaces/engine-service.guard.spec.ts (RN-597) Edge case: the rate limit exemption comes from the route METADATA, not from the guard. The RateLimitGuard is an APP_GUARD and runs before any controller guard — when it decides, the EngineServiceGuard has not run yet. Origin: ADR 0032
documents.s: RN-035 — Internal engine ↔ api traffic requires the service secret

documents.t: The pepper that keys the HMAC of opaque tokens has no _PREVIOUS, and changing it has a consequence, not a procedure: every refresh token in circulation, every open e-mail verification and password reset link, and every personal access token (PAT) can no longer be found, because the hash recomputed with the new pepper does not match the stored one. The refused refresh records refresh_unknown (and not refresh_reuse_detected), the link says "Link inválido ou expirado", and the lockout buckets change key — a locked account unlocks. The PASSWORD survives (argon2id with per-record salt, no pepper): changing the pepper costs a login, never an account, and the api starts normally with the new value. Until RN-613, a pepper without its own value fell back to AUTH_JWT_SECRET, and rotating the JWT was also rotating the pepper, with all the consequences above. Since then the pepper is mandatory in production and never borrowed from the JWT. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/auth-key-material.ts:212 (pepper), :228 (hashDeToken), :247 (baldeDeEmail); apps/api/src/interfaces/http/auth/pat-auth.guard.ts:142 Test: test/application/use-cases/auth/rotacao-dos-segredos.spec.ts, against the test Postgres Edge case: the TARGET of "changing" includes the mistake of whoever separates the pepper from the JWT by generating a new value instead of copying the current one — it is the same change, and logs out the same way (pinned in the same spec, "a ordem errada"). Origin: ADR 0031, AT-196
documents.s: RN-597 — Changing the pepper is a global logout

documents.t: The HMAC pepper of opaque tokens (refresh, account links, PATs, lockout bucket) no longer falls back to AUTH_JWT_SECRET. The silent fallback (AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER ?? passphraseAtual()) turned every "zero-downtime" JWT rotation into a pepper change, and it was the COMMON path: the production and installation composes did not even pass the variable through. In production the api REFUSES to start without it, and the refusal states the fix — "defina com o valor ATUAL de AUTH_JWT_SECRET para não deslogar ninguém" —, because the obvious fix (generating a random one) is the one that logs everyone out. With the pepper equal to the old JWT the hash is byte for byte the previous one, refresh tokens and PATs remain valid, and from then on the JWT rotates on its own. A pepper equal to the JWT is NOT refused: it is the legitimate state of every migrated installation. The JWT rules (RN-114) apply: blank, the two example literals from the repository and fewer than 16 characters bring down the boot. Outside production a development default of its OWN applies (dev-auth-token-pepper-change-me), never the JWT's. The install.sh does the migration: a NEW installation generates a random pepper; if there is a previous .env in the folder, it is READ (never executed) before being overwritten, and its pepper is kept — or, without a pepper, it is born with its AUTH_JWT_SECRET. The terminal says where the value came from, never the value. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/auth-key-material.ts:168 (pepperAtual), :212 (pepper); apps/api/src/main.ts:46 (the boot check); install.sh:702 (valor_no_env_anterior), :734 (gerar_segredos), :831 (dizer_a_origem_do_pepper); the variable in the three composes (docker/docker-compose.yml, docker-compose.prod.yml, docker-compose.install.yml), in docker/smoke.sh and in .env.example Test: test/infrastructure/security/auth-key-material.spec.ts (describe "pepperAtual (RN-613)": refusal without pepper even with JWT, the message, the examples, the floor, equal to the JWT accepted, the dev default); test/application/use-cases/auth/rotacao-dos-segredos.spec.ts (describe "a migração do RN-613": the refresh stored with the OLD formula remains valid with the pepper equal to the old JWT and survives the JWT change; the AUTH_JWT_SECRET describe: without pepper outside production, changing the JWT does not log out); scripts/dev/install-env.spec.ts (describe "o AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER do instalador (RN-613)", against docker compose config, whole value) Edge case: the installer only sees the .env of the folder it runs in. An installation whose .env lives elsewhere, a custom compose and Kubernetes with ExternalSecret do the migration by hand, through the runbook — in Kubernetes the AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER property already existed in the ExternalSecret and in bootstrap.sh, and a provider that lacks it already failed the sync. And the installer migration wipes the volumes (ADR 0150): the refresh only survives for whoever restores the Postgres dump, which is the case that matters. Origin: AT-210 (finding from AT-196), maintainer decision: migration with the current value
documents.s: RN-613 — AUTH_TOKEN_PEPPER is mandatory and its own; whoever migrates sets it with the current AUTH_JWT_SECRET

documents.t: The three zero-downtime rotations (AUTH_JWT_SECRET, BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN, CREDENTIALS_MASTER_KEY) depend on the process seeing the old value in a _PREVIOUS variable during the window. Compose does not pass the host environment through, and none of the three was in the environment: of any compose: setting the _PREVIOUS in .env had no effect, and whoever followed the runbook performed, without knowing, the dry swap that rotation exists to avoid. Now the api receives the three, and the engine and the broker receive BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS, in the dev, production and installation composes, always with an EMPTY default — set means rotation in progress, and a filled default would leave the installation forever in the middle of one. Empty is the same as absent in the three readers. Where: docker/docker-compose.yml, docker/docker-compose.prod.yml and docker/docker-compose.install.yml (services api, engine and broker); the readers are apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/auth-key-material.ts:136 (passphraseAnterior), apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/service-token.ts:92 (tokenDeServicoAnterior), apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/envelope-encryption.service.ts:93, apps/engine/config/runtime.exs:70 and apps/broker/src/config.ts:85 Test: scripts/ci/previous-nos-composes.spec.ts — DERIVES from the code of the three services the list of _PREVIOUS read and fails the one that is missing, or comes with a non-empty default, in any of the three composes; the "ExternalSecret do k8s" block fails the ExternalSecret without dataFrom.extract, a _PREVIOUS in data: and the api/engine Deployment without envFrom: brabo-secrets Kubernetes (AT-220, maintainer decision): the Pods read envFrom: brabo-secrets, and the ExternalSecret (deploy/k8s/base/common/externalsecrets.yaml) pulls the WHOLE brabo object from the store via dataFrom.extract — the _PREVIOUS comes in when it exists and leaves when it is removed, on the next sync. It cannot be listed in data:: ESO has no optional key, and an absent property (the normal state) fails the sync of the whole Secret. Declared cost: EVERY key of the object becomes an api, engine, migrations and backup variable, and a MANDATORY key that is absent no longer fails the sync — the consumer is what flags it. Sync through a real ESO was exercised by hand on a disposable k3d, not in CI Origin: AT-201 (finding from AT-196), same class as RN-540; Kubernetes half in AT-220
documents.s: RN-595 — Every _PREVIOUS a service reads reaches it through the three composes, empty by default

documents.t: During rotation, BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS opens /internal/* just as much as the current one. It goes through ONE rule, the same as the current one (exigirTokenDeProducao), and no copy of it. Surrounding whitespace is discarded, and a value made only of whitespace counts as absent. In production, the public development literal (dev-service-token-change-me) and a value with fewer than 16 characters after the trim BRING DOWN the api boot, with a message naming BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS. Before this, the variable was compared raw: a previous with the example value opened the internal door to anyone who had read this repository, without any error. Mandatoriness is the only part of the current one's rule that is NOT copied, because outside rotation the absent previous is the normal state. A previous equal to the current one (after the trim) still does not count as rotation. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/security/service-token.ts:63 (exigirTokenDeProducao), :92 (tokenDeServicoAnterior); apps/api/src/main.ts:50 (tokenDeServicoAnterior), which runs at boot next to the current one Test: test/infrastructure/security/service-token.spec.ts (describe "tokenDeServicoAnterior (RN-598)") Edge case: this RN is the api side. The engine and the broker apply the same rule since RN-601. Origin: AT-205 (finding from AT-196)
documents.s: RN-598 — The PREVIOUS service token goes through the same rule as the current one

documents.t: The three processes that compare the service token use the same rule as RN-598, each in its own language. Surrounding whitespace is discarded, and a value made only of whitespace counts as absent. In production, an absent BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN, the public development literal (dev-service-token-change-me) or a value with fewer than 16 characters after the trim BRING DOWN the boot, with a message naming the variable. The last two refusals also apply to BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS when it is set. A previous equal to the current one does not count as rotation. Outside production only the trim applies, and an empty current one falls back to the dev default. Before, the engine read both raw in config/runtime.exs: no trim, no floor, and in production it started with the public default when the variable was missing (and with the empty string when the compose passed it empty). Only the api refusing to start protected the installation. The broker already applied the rule to the current one, but to the previous only the trim. Two divergences of form, declared. In the engine, "production" is config_env() == :prod (the release), and not NODE_ENV, which it does not read; the production image is always a :prod release. And the rule stays inline in runtime.exs, not in a lib/ module, because in a release that file runs in a config provider before the application code is loaded. Consequence: every process that evaluates that runtime.exs in a :prod release needs the token, including the migration (bin/engine eval Engine.Release.migrate()). That is why the migrate-engine service of the production and installation composes started receiving BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN and BRABO_SERVICE_TOKEN_PREVIOUS, without default. The CI smoke showed it: without them, the migration died before migrating. The Kubernetes migration Job already received them through the envFrom of brabo-secrets. Where: apps/engine/config/runtime.exs:85 (exigir_token_de_servico_de_producao), :105 (service_token), :121 (service_token_previous); apps/broker/src/config.ts:89 (anterior), :125 (exigirTokenDeProducao) Test: apps/engine/test/engine/runtime_service_token_test.exs (evaluates the real runtime.exs via Config.Reader.read!/2, with env: :prod and :dev); apps/broker/src/config.spec.ts (describe "lerConfiguracao — produção, o token ANTERIOR (RN-601)") Edge case: the rule is copied in the three processes, not shared: they are three languages or runtimes, and no test checks that the three copies remain equal. The floor counts characters (String.length in Elixir, .length in TS), which only differs for a token outside ASCII. Origin: AT-216 (finding from AT-205)
documents.s: RN-601 — The engine and the broker apply the api's rule to both service tokens

documents.t: HttpApiToEngineClient interpolates these values in a template string to build the /internal/* URL — with no DTO/class-validator in between, just like RN-127: they come from @Param/session lookup without a validation pipe at some point of the chain, and nothing guarantees their shape before interpolation. A malicious value could inject an extra path segment or characters that break the built URL — the EngineServiceGuard authenticates the CALLER (RN-035), it does not CHECK what the caller sends in the URL. garantirSegmentoDeUrlInterna reuses the same width as NOME_DE_PASTA_VALIDO (RN-092/109) — hex, hyphen and underscore, 1 to 64 chars — and is called in TWO places, covering ALL the methods that interpolate an id in a URL, not only the ones CodeQL reported: inside postCommand, which most methods already use (startAgent, sendAgentMessage, confirmReadiness, cancelAgentTurn, offerInfraHandoff, invalidateInstructions, startExecution, acceptParallelization, rearmDevAgent, reviseStory) — the caller lists the (nome, valor) tuples it already interpolated into the path, and postCommand validates ALL of them before building the request; directly in reanalyzeSession/runAnamnese, which do not go through postCommand (they need to distinguish 503 from a transport failure) and that is why they were the only two points CodeQL reached. The happy path does not change: sessionId/projectId are always a UUID from the database, and agent/agentId are always a short slug. Where: apps/api/src/infrastructure/http-clients/api-to-engine-client.ts (garantirSegmentoDeUrlInterna, postCommand) Test: apps/api/test/infrastructure/http-clients/api-to-engine-client.spec.ts (a malformed id is refused BEFORE touching the network — proven by pointing ENGINE_URL to a port nothing listens on — and the happy path does make the request) Origin: CRITICAL CodeQL alert (internal request URL built with an unvalidated value) blocking the qa→main promotion, found during PR #256; same pattern as RN-092
documents.s: RN-128 — sessionId/projectId/agent/agentId are validated BEFORE becoming a URL segment of the internal request to the engine

documents.t: The Code tab (GET /projects/:id/code/*, ADR 0060) answers 409 while the project is in sem_decisao — the initial state of every project. sem_decisao becomes decidido only when the Arquiteto emits artifact.project_image through the choose_project_image tool, with an OCI image with an explicit tag (latest refused), rationale and network posture. The check lives in the SAME funnel as the path containment of RN-095 (ReadProjectCodeUseCase.alvo), and not in each of the seven routes (tree, file, search, PR diff, blame, PR list and detailed branches, FASE 26b) — a check duplicated in seven callers is a check that one day diverges in one of them (ADR 0058). Count corrected here: this record said "four routes" since FASE 26, and became outdated when FASE 26b added the last three to the same funnel without anyone revising this number. The artifact has no table: it is the event itself in the event log, versioned (version grows with each emission, the current one is the one with the highest version), the same way as artifact.module_map. Revising the image is emitting a new version, never overwriting the previous one. Where: apps/api/src/domain/containers/project-container.ts, apps/api/src/application/use-cases/containers/decidir-imagem-do-projeto.use-case.ts, apps/api/src/application/use-cases/containers/obter-container-do-projeto.use-case.ts, apps/api/src/application/use-cases/git/read-project-code.use-case.ts (method portaoDoContainer), apps/engine/lib/engine/harness/tools/choose_project_image.ex Test: apps/api/test/domain/containers/project-container.spec.ts, apps/api/test/application/use-cases/containers/container-do-projeto.use-case.spec.ts, apps/api/test/application/use-cases/git/read-project-code.use-case.spec.ts ("o portão do container" block) Edge case: 409 and not 403 — nothing is wrong with the requester or with their permission; the resource does not exist yet IN THIS STATE. And it is not 404: the tab exists, it is just not unlocked. The message says what is missing, so the screen shows the reason instead of a mute error (RN-088). Origin: ADR 0065
documents.s: RN-105 — Without an image decided by the Arquiteto, the container does not start and Code does not open

documents.t: REVISED by RN-418 (ADR 0102, GLOBAL decision of the product owner): the deny this record describes became an ABSOLUTE CEILING (unconditional require_approval) — the rest of this entry is history, faithful to what held until the revision. Inside the project container the agent is free (ADR 0065): the verb allowlist of ADR 0055 does not converge (findings Z and AD — verb, form and invocation are distinct spaces), and the way out is the wall, not a longer list. But three effects cross the wall and reach the world, and the user's decision was verbatim: "agente livre para o que quiser desde que não seja comandos de git ligado ao deploy e ao PR — estas ações ainda devem ser humanas". decide() recognizes git push, git remote add/set-url, git merge, the provider CLIs (gh pr create, gh pr merge, glab mr create/merge, releases and workflow dispatch) and the common deploy commands (kubectl apply, helm upgrade, terraform apply, docker push, npm publish, ...) by token PREFIX, ignoring global flags in between (git -C /tmp push matches). Any segment of the compound command that matches is deny — not require_approval: "always allow" writes the pattern into allow, and one click would be enough for the second door to stay open forever. deny beats allow at any stage, and it is applied BEFORE any permissive stage in decide(). Denying does not take power away from the agent: the message redirects to the TYPED action (git_push, git_merge, pr_open) — which is born a proposed_action, has its own minimum role and records in the event log what was pushed and where. It is the path the dev agent already uses (agent_io.ex proposes git_push); what changes is that it is now guaranteed by deny, not just agreed by convention. Where: apps/api/src/domain/actions/external-effect.ts, apps/api/src/domain/actions/decide.ts ("FRONTEIRA DO CONTAINER" block) Test: apps/api/test/domain/actions/external-effect.spec.ts, apps/api/test/domain/actions/decide.spec.ts (describe "a fronteira do container") Edge case: the boundary does NOT override the merge lock on a protected branch (RN-014, always manual) nor the path scope (RN-095/ADR 0055) — the three rules coexist, each one vetoing for a different reason. Origin: ADR 0065
documents.s: RN-106 — git push, PR and deploy do not go out through the terminal — even within the project scope

documents.t: The three states of RN-088 (loading/error/empty) do not describe sem_decisao (RN-105): it is not loading (the api already answered), it is not error (it answered CORRECTLY) and it is not empty (no data is missing — a DECISION is missing, which is something else). Treating sem_decisao as "empty" would show an editor without files, inviting one to think the repository is empty; treating it as "error" would make the screen suggest "try again" for something only the Arquiteto resolves. The tab asks for the container state BEFORE trying to read code (GET /projects/:id/container), instead of waiting for the first tree or file to return 409 — the same check the api already does in the ReadProjectCodeUseCase funnel (RN-105), only asked first, so the fourth state is born as its own message and not as the footer of a generic error.
